Safety-evidence IS a specific kind of evidence: information and data that supports or undermines safety-related claims and decisions. Law 9: a competent speaker would call safety-evidence a subtype of evidence, specifically the safety domain variant.

safety-training IS a specific kind of safety-competence: the process of building knowledge, skills, and awareness in safety matters. Law 9: a competent speaker would call safety-training a form of competence development. Specific→general, nearest kind is safety-competence.

safety-inspection IS a specific kind of safety-auditing: a systematic examination focused on physical conditions, equipment, and workplaces. Law 9: a competent speaker would call an inspection a type of audit. Specific→general, nearest kind is safety-auditing.

safety-reporting is built for the sake of safety-evidence: incident reports, near-miss reports, and hazard reports are the primary mechanisms by which safety evidence is generated and collected. Law 8d: servant (reporting) → master (evidence). The note shows purpose by design — reporting systems exist to produce evidence.

safety-hierarchy-of-controls IS a specific kind of safety-prevention: a framework that ranks control measures by their effectiveness in preventing harm. Law 9: a competent speaker would call the hierarchy-of-controls a prevention strategy/framework. Specific→general, nearest kind is safety-prevention. This corrects the mistaken DEPENDS_ON direction from the Ezra filing.

safety-warning is built for the sake of safety-management: warning systems exist to support management's hazard identification and risk mitigation efforts. Law 8d: servant (warning) → master (management). Warnings provide the real-time data signal that enables management decisions — a designed purpose, not incidental benefit.

Pre-check: safety-trainer EXISTS, safety-competence EXISTS. safety-trainer is built for the sake of safety-competence: the trainer (person, program, or tool) is designed to develop and maintain safety knowledge, skills, and awareness in individuals and organizations. Per Law 8d: servant (trainer) → master (competence). The teleology is by design — trainers exist to build competence, not the other way around.

Pre-check: safety-awareness EXISTS, safety-culture EXISTS. safety-awareness is built for the sake of safety-culture: awareness initiatives, training, and communication are the mechanisms by which safety culture is cultivated and sustained. Per Law 8d: servant (awareness) → master (culture). Safety culture is the outcome; awareness is the practice that sustains it.

The safety budget is allocated specifically for the sake of enabling prevention measures — its designed purpose is to fund controls, training, and safeguards that prevent harm. Law 8d: servant(budget)→master(prevention).

Status quo persists because power structures maintain the current arrangement. Remove those power structures and the status quo collapses — people reorganize. Per Law 8, the removal test passes: without power to enforce the current state, the status quo ceases to operate.

Status quo persists because power structures maintain the current arrangement. Remove those power structures and the status quo collapses — people reorganize. Per Law 8, the removal test passes: without power to enforce the current state, the status quo ceases to operate.

Law 8d: safety-warning is built and maintained for the sake of safety-communication — its designed purpose is to alert people to hazards, enabling communication of risk. Servant(warning)→master(communication). A warning without a communication channel is inert.

Law 10: safety-moment (the brief safety-focused presentation/discussion at meetings) is a concrete practice contained within the broader safety-culture framework. Culture is the whole; safety-moments are one of its parts.

Safety-reminder is built and maintained for the sake of safety-awareness: its designed purpose is to keep safety top-of-mind through periodic notifications, directly serving the operation of awareness. Law 8d: servant (reminder) → master (awareness). The reminder exists to further awareness's function.

Safety-standard is built and maintained for the sake of safety-compliance: its designed purpose is to establish the criteria and benchmarks against which compliance is measured. Law 8d: servant (standard) → master (compliance). Standards exist to make compliance determinate and achievable.

Tested direction: safety-attitude is a specific kind of mindset — a disposition oriented toward safety matters. A competent speaker would say 'that safety attitude is a mindset.' Precheck confirmed both entries exist.

Safety-attitude is cultivated and maintained for the sake of safety-culture. An organization develops safety attitudes precisely to build and sustain its safety culture — the servant points at the master. Removing safety-attitude would collapse the culture's foundation.

Crowdfunding is a specific kind of crowdsourcing: it applies the crowd-contributions model specifically to financial raising. A competent speaker would call crowdfunding 'a kind of crowdsourcing.' Direction: specific→general tested correct.

Safety-observance (conforming to safety rules) is cultivated and maintained for the sake of safety-management. The designed purpose of observance practices is to serve the broader operation of safety management in an organization. Law 8d direction: servant→master.

Tested direction: traditional contracts existed millennia before smart contracts. Smart contracts are a computerized instantiation of the ancient concept of contract — the older, more general form fed into the newer, specific form.

Law 9: safety-commission is a specific kind of safety-governance — a formal body or authority that oversees safety standards and compliance. A competent speaker would call a safety commission 'a kind of safety governance mechanism.' Direction specific→general correct.

Law 8d: safety-commission is built and maintained for the sake of safety-management. Its designed purpose is to oversee, enforce, and further safety-management operations within organizations. The servant (commission) points at the master (management).

Law 8d: A safety-commission is built and maintained for the sake of safety-compliance. Its designed purpose is to enforce, verify, and further compliance with safety standards. The servant (commission) points at the master (compliance). Purpose is by institutional design.

Safety-engagement is a specific kind of practice: the organized, repeatable behavioral pattern of workers actively participating in safety activities. Direction specific→general per Law 9 — a competent speaker calls engagement 'a practice.'

Safety-engagement is cultivated and maintained for the sake of safety-culture per Law 8d. Its designed purpose is to deepen the shared values, beliefs, and behaviors around safety in an organization. The servant (engagement) points at the master (culture). Parallel to safety-attitude SERVES→ safety-culture and safety-awareness SERVES→ safety-culture.

Safety-engagement serves safety-management per Law 8d: workers' active participation in safety activities is maintained to further the operation of comprehensive safety management. The servant (engagement) points at the master (management).

Law 7: The concept of 'status quo' (the current established state of affairs) was derived from the prior existence of norms or conventions. Norms predate and feed into the notion of an established status — without norms there is no 'status' to be 'quo' in.
A lead-indicator IS a specific kind of indicator: it is a measurable signal used to assess or predict performance. Direction specific→general per Law 9.

Safety-empowerment IS a specific kind of safety-management: it is a practice for managing safety by delegating authority to workers. A competent speaker would call safety-empowerment a form of safety management. Direction specific→general per Law 9.
A freemium model IS a specific kind of business model: it offers basic services free while charging for premium features. Direction specific→general per Law 9.

Subscription models (pay for ongoing access) predate and fed into freemium models. The freemium model is a specific evolution: it takes the subscription concept and adds a free tier to attract users before converting them to paid subscribers. Per Law 7, the which-came-first test: subscription models existed in publishing, media, and software long before freemium was coined as a business term.

Freemium is built and maintained for the sake of marketing: its designed purpose is to attract users and build brand awareness, converting free users into paying ones. The servant (freemium) points at the master (marketing) per Law 8d.

Freemium needs subscription to operate now: the free tier's economic logic only works because a paid subscription tier exists as the conversion target. Remove subscription and freemium stops working as designed.
A control-framework IS a specific kind of governance: it is a structured mechanism for directing and controlling an organization's operations through prescribed guidelines, standards, and controls.

Open-source IS a specific kind of business model: it provides goods or services (software, content) under a licensing model that grants users rights to use, modify, and distribute. The open-source model is a particular business model variant.

Open-source IS built for the sake of transparency — its designed purpose is to make software development visible, auditable, and accessible to all. The servant (open-source) points at the master (transparency) per Law 8d.

Safety-stewardship IS built for the sake of safety-compliance — its designed purpose is to ensure compliance with safety standards through active oversight. The servant (stewardship) points at the master (compliance) per Law 8d.

Safety-reporting is built and maintained for the sake of safety-compliance: its designed purpose is to document, track, and communicate safety-relevant data so the organization can demonstrate and maintain compliance. The servant (reporting) points at the master (compliance) per Law 8d.

Safety-stewardship is a specific kind of safety-management: it is safety-management focused on active oversight and compliance assurance. Per Law 9, a competent speaker calls it 'a kind of safety management'.

Safety-bottleneck IS a specific kind of bottleneck — one that occurs within a safety system and caps overall safety performance. Files against the nearest kind (bottleneck already exists, so this is not a leap).
Sunburst diagram IS a specific kind of chart — a hierarchical visualization using concentric rings. Files against nearest kind (chart). Sense: chart as visual data representation.

Safety-improvement IS a specific kind of safety-management: it is the systematic change process within safety management that focuses on enhancing performance through assessment, intervention, implementation, and sustainment cycles.

Safety-benchmark IS a specific kind of safety-evaluation: it is the use of comparative metrics and standards to assess safety performance against peers, regulations, or best practices. Files against nearest kind.

safety-feedback-loop SERVES compliance: the feedback loop mechanism is built and maintained for the sake of compliance — it channels incident data, near-misses, and audit findings back into procedural updates and training, ensuring ongoing regulatory and policy adherence. Per Law 8d, the servant points at the master.

data-ethics SERVES compliance: ethical data frameworks are built to ensure data handling meets legal and regulatory requirements. The designed purpose includes advancing compliance through principled data governance — collection, processing, and use of data within legal bounds. Per Law 8d, servant points at master.

data-ethics IS built for the sake of accountability: ethical data governance frameworks are designed to ensure that data handling practices are transparent, traceable, and answerable to stakeholders. The purpose of data-ethics is to make data use accountable — not merely to ensure compliance (that's a side effect), but to establish answerability as the core design goal.

safety-feedback-loop SERVES safety-improvement: the feedback loop mechanism is designed and maintained for the sake of driving safety improvement — it channels incident data, near-misses, and audit findings into the improvement process so that corrective actions can be identified, prioritized, and sustained.

whistleblower-protection is designed and maintained for the sake of safety-management: it ensures safety violations and wrongdoing are reported and acted upon, sustaining organizational safety systems.
whistleblower-protection channels reports of regulatory and legal violations into compliance processes. The designed purpose includes ensuring compliance through transparent reporting.

whistleblower-protection IS a specific kind of safety-management: it is a mechanism within safety-management systems that ensures violations and hazards are reported and acted upon. A competent speaker would call whistleblower-protection 'a form of safety management practice.'

Early-warning is designed for the sake of safety-system: it provides the alerting mechanism that makes a safety system operational by detecting hazards before they escalate. The designed purpose is to feed information to the safety system.

Safety-objective is built for the sake of safety-management: objectives provide the targets and standards that safety-management systems use to direct and evaluate their work. The designed purpose is to guide management practice.

automated-decision-making is a specific kind of decision-making where the process is encoded in algorithms, rules, or software to operate with reduced human intervention. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of decision-making' — specifically, machine-executed or semi-autonomous decision-making.

A treemap is a specific kind of data visualization that displays hierarchical data using nested rectangles sized by value. A competent speaker would call a treemap 'a type of data visualization.' Nearest kind check: no intermediate category (like chart type) exists between treemap and data visualization in the accepted record.

Algorithmic audit exists FOR THE SAKE OF compliance. Law 8d: SERVES = designed purpose is to further Y's operation. An algorithmic audit evaluates automated systems to verify compliance with standards; remove compliance as its goal and the audit ceases to function. The audit SERVES the compliance function.

Algorithmic accountability exists for the sake of compliance: it ensures automated systems can be held answerable for outcomes, which serves regulatory compliance operation. Law 8d: servant points at master.

Organizational learning needs knowledge management to operate: without systematic capture and retrieval of organizational knowledge, learning cannot be retained or transferred. The removal test: remove knowledge management and organizational learning loses its retention and transfer mechanisms.

Safety-lagging-indicator IS a specific kind of safety-evaluation. A lagging indicator evaluates past safety performance by measuring recorded incidents and failures — it is an evaluation metric, just one that looks backward rather than forward.

A prompt template IS a specific kind of template. It is a structured, reusable format for creating prompts — the specific application is prompt engineering, but the kind is a template (a reusable structure for content generation).

A prompt template IS a specific kind of template. It is a structured, reusable format for creating prompts — the specific application is prompt engineering, but the kind is a template (a reusable structure for content generation).

A lagging indicator IS a specific kind of safety indicator: it signals past safety performance by measuring recorded incidents. Files against the nearest kind, per Law 9. (The previously struck edge was against safety-evaluation which is wrong kind; safety-indicator is the correct nearest kind.)
An algorithmic audit IS a specific kind of audit: it evaluates automated/algorithms systems for fairness, bias, and compliance. Files against the nearest kind, per Law 9.

A lagging indicator serves safety-management by providing measured past performance data (incident counts, severity distributions) that management uses for reporting, resource allocation, and trend analysis. Per Law 8d: the servant (lagging indicator) points at the master (safety-management). The indicator exists to serve the management function, not the other way around.

A safety-leading-indicator IS a specific kind of safety-indicator: it signals future safety performance by measuring proactive activities (training completion, safety audits, hazard reports) before incidents occur. Files against the nearest kind (safety-indicator), per Law 9. The parallel with safety-lagging-indicator INSTANCE_OF safety-indicator (just accepted) confirms this is the correct rung.

Feedforward is designed to serve risk-management: it anticipates potential disruptions and enables preemptive corrective action before deviations occur. Per Law 8d — its purpose is to further risk-management's operation by shifting from reactive to proactive control.

A safety KPI IS a specific kind of indicator: it quantifies a specific aspect of safety performance against a target. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call a KPI 'an indicator'. Files against the nearest kind.

Feedforward mechanisms are designed and maintained for the sake of safety-management: they provide advance information about potential safety issues so that management can take preemptive action. Per Law 8d, the servant (feedforward) points at the master (safety-management).

Organizational learning is designed and maintained for the sake of risk-management: it captures lessons from incidents, near-misses, and routine operations so the organization can anticipate and mitigate risks. Per Law 8d, the servant (org-learning) points at the master (risk-management).

Safety forecasting provides advance predictions about safety performance trends so that safety-management can act preemptively. Designed for the sake of safety-management; the servant points at the master (Law 8d).

Safety-forecasting draws from feedforward control theory (cybernetics, 1940s) which predates and informed the concept of systematic safety forecasting. Which-came-first: feedforward as a concept is foundational and older; safety-forecasting as a practice came later, building on anticipatory control concepts.

Organizational-learning is a specific kind of learning — the collective, systematic acquisition and sharing of knowledge within an organization. A competent speaker would call organizational-learning 'a kind of learning.' Nearest kind: learning (no intermediate rung between org-learning and learning).

Safety-forecasting needs safety-indicators operating now to produce predictions — it ingests leading and lagging indicators as data inputs. Remove safety-indicators and forecasting has nothing to forecast. Present-tense removal test passes.
Safety evaluation is designed and maintained for the sake of safety-management: it assesses whether safety systems meet standards and identifies gaps so management can act. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Algorithmic transparency IS a specific kind of transparency — the practice of making algorithmic decision processes visible, understandable, and accountable to affected parties. A competent speaker would call it a type of transparency. Law 9: specific→general, nearest kind.

Safety-tracker IS a specific kind of safety-indicator — it monitors and displays safety metrics to make performance visible. A competent speaker would call a safety tracker a type of indicator. Nearest kind is safety-indicator (not safety-evaluation, which assesses rather than indicates).

Safety evaluation feeds organizational learning by identifying systemic gaps and generating corrective insights that become organizational knowledge. Servant→master: eval exists for the sake of learning.
Incident reporting generates the raw data that safety evaluation needs to assess compliance and identify gaps. Designed for the sake of safety-eval: servant→master per Law 8d.

Algorithmic transparency is built or maintained for the sake of accountability — its designed purpose is to make algorithmic decision processes visible, understandable, and accountable to affected parties. Servant→master per Law 8d.

Safety signature IS a specific kind of safety indicator: a measurable signal or marker that reflects the state of safety in an organization or system. Safety indicator is the broader category of measurable safety metrics.
A control tower IS a specific kind of governance mechanism: a centralized function that monitors, coordinates, and directs distributed operations. Specific→general relationship.

best-practice is built and maintained for the sake of safety-management: documented proven approaches exist to further safety-management's operation. Per Law 8d — the designed purpose is to serve the master, not the reverse.
safety-indicator IS a specific kind of indicator: a measurable signal or marker that reflects the state of safety. The specific→general relationship per Law 9.

which-came-first test: not applicable (DEPENDS_ON). Removal test — remove safety-indicators now and safety-eval stops OPERATING: without measurable signals to evaluate, safety evaluation has no data to work with and ceases to function. This is not about sayability; it is about operational capacity. Per Law 8b.

for-whose-sake test (Law 8d): the control tower is built and maintained for the sake of safety-management — its designed purpose is to monitor, coordinate, and direct safety operations so that safety-management can function. The servant (control tower) points at the master (safety-management).

A safety-walk IS a specific kind of safety-evaluation — a structured observation and assessment of safety conditions in the workplace. Specific→general per Law 9: a competent speaker would call a safety-walk 'a safety evaluation method'.

A safety-near-miss IS a specific kind of safety-indicator — a recorded event that signals potential safety problems before harm occurs. A near-miss is a leading indicator of safety performance. Specific→general per Law 9.

which-came-first: data visualization predates treemap. INSTANCE_OF per Law 9: a treemap IS a specific kind of data visualization — it displays hierarchical data using nested rectangles sized by value. A competent speaker would call a treemap 'a data visualization'. Fixes my earlier error (treemap→data was wrong per Law 9a: a visualization is not 'data' but a kind of visualization.)

which-came-first: safety evaluation as a concept predates formalized safety-inspection. INSTANCE_OF per Law 9: a safety-inspection IS a specific kind of safety-evaluation — a physical, on-site examination of conditions and practices to assess safety compliance. A competent speaker would call it 'a safety evaluation.' Files against the nearest kind.

which-came-first: safety evaluation as a practice predates formalized hazard-identification as a distinct activity. INSTANCE_OF per Law 9: hazard-identification IS a specific kind of safety-evaluation — the systematic process of finding and documenting hazards before they cause harm. A competent speaker in a safety context would call it 'a safety evaluation' activity. Files against the nearest kind.

which-came-first: safety-indicator as a concept predates safety-metric. INSTANCE_OF per Law 9: a safety-metric IS a specific kind of safety-indicator — a quantified measure used to track safety performance and trends. A competent speaker in safety management would recognize a metric as an indicator. Files against the nearest kind.

Safety-stop (stop-work authority) IS a specific kind of safety-evaluation. It is an authoritative decision to halt operations, made after evaluating observed conditions against safety standards. The safety-stop process evaluates real-time conditions and renders a judgment — a type of safety-evaluation that carries organizational authority.

Safety-commitment IS a specific kind of safety-governance. It is a formal pledge by an organization or individual to uphold safety standards, objectives, and practices. As a binding promise that shapes governance structure and accountability, it functions as a governance mechanism — a commitment to safety principles.

A best-practice IS a specific kind of practice. It is a method or technique that has been demonstrated through experience and evidence to produce superior results compared to other available approaches. A competent speaker would call a best-practice 'a kind of practice' — it is the optimal or recommended way of doing something within a domain.

A scatter plot matrix IS a specific kind of matrix. It arranges scatter plots in a grid/matrix layout to show pairwise relationships between multiple variables — it IS a matrix structure (a rectangular array) of plots. A competent speaker would call it 'a matrix' of scatter plots. Direction: scatter plot matrix is specific, matrix is general.

Best-practices are codified methods designed to improve an organization's safety-management system. They serve safety-management by providing proven techniques that the management framework can institutionalise. The filer's note argues purpose (best-practices exist to further safety-management outcomes), which is exactly what SERVES captures (Law 8d).

safety-tracker DEPENDS_ON model interpretability because a safety tracker (a system for monitoring safety metrics) needs model interpretability to operate — without the ability to interpret the models generating predictions and assessments, the tracker cannot validate, explain, or act on its outputs. Remove interpretability and the tracker's analytical function ceases to work.

Chain of thought is a reasoning technique deliberately designed to make model decision processes transparent and traceable — its purpose is to further model interpretability's operation. Per Law 8d: the servant (chain of thought) points at the master (model interpretability). The filer tests 'for whose sake?': chain of thought exists to serve the goal of understanding what models do.

Safety barriers (engineered and organizational) exist specifically to support safety-management's operation. Per Law 8d: the designed purpose of barriers is to further safety-management's goal of preventing harm. The test: remove safety-management as an organizing practice, and barriers lose their coordinated deployment — they become ad hoc rather than systematic layers.

Safety-capacity (an organization's ability to prevent and respond to safety issues) IS a specific kind of safety-indicator. It is a measurable attribute of organizational safety posture — the level of capacity signals how prepared the organization is. Like safety-near-miss and safety-signature (both accepted INSTANCE_OF safety-indicator), capacity provides a signal about safety state.

Safety-interval (the measured time between safety events, inspections, or reviews) IS a specific kind of safety-indicator. It is a time-based metric that signals patterns in safety performance — frequent intervals suggest improvement, widening intervals suggest deterioration. This follows the same pattern as safety-tracker (accepted INSTANCE_OF safety-indicator).

Risk-appetite (the level and type of risk an organization is willing to accept) IS a specific kind of safety-indicator. It is a governance parameter that signals the organization's safety posture and tolerance boundaries. Like other safety-indicators (safety-near-miss, safety-signature, safety-tracker all accepted), risk-appetite provides a measurable signal about safety decision-making context.

A safety-budget (the allocation of resources for safety activities) IS a specific kind of safety-governance construct. Governance sets the allocation framework; a budget is the financial instantiation of governance decisions. A competent speaker would call a budget 'a governance mechanism.'

Coaching IS a specific kind of practice. It is a structured, intentional interaction aimed at developing capability in another. A competent speaker would call coaching 'a practice.' This follows the same pattern as best-practice → practice which was accepted.

A safety-review is a specific kind of safety-management activity. It is a structured, periodic examination of safety systems, processes, and performance to identify gaps and recommend corrective actions. Per Law 9, 'is a specific kind of' maps to INSTANCE_OF. Safety-management is the general category of organized activities that maintain and improve safety; a safety-review is one such structured activity within that category.

A safety-inspection is a specific kind of safety-review. It is a systematic, on-site examination of facilities, equipment, and procedures to verify compliance with safety standards. Per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF captures 'is a specific kind of.' A safety-inspection is a more granular, field-oriented review activity within the broader safety-review category.

A safety-monitoring is a specific kind of safety-management. It is the continuous or periodic observation, measurement, and tracking of safety conditions and performance indicators. Per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF captures 'is a specific kind of.' Continuous monitoring is a core safety-management activity within the general safety-management category.

A safety-assessment is a specific kind of safety-management. It is a systematic evaluation of safety risks, controls, and performance to determine adequacy and identify improvements. Per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF captures 'is a specific kind of.' Assessment is a structured safety-management activity within the general safety-management category.

which-came-first: not applicable (SERVES). Purpose test: safety-hierarchy (the hierarchy of controls) was developed and is maintained specifically to serve safety-management by providing a standardized framework for prioritizing risk control measures. Its designed purpose is to further the operation of safety-management systems. The servant (safety-hierarchy) points at the master (safety-management).

safety-knowledge is a specific kind of knowledge — knowledge specifically about safety principles, hazards, controls, and best practices. A competent speaker would call it a kind of knowledge. Nearest kind verified: knowledge exists and is the direct parent category.

safety-suggestion IS a specific kind of mechanism — a structured channel for reporting safety concerns. The hierarchy of controls serves safety management, while the safety-suggestion mechanism serves the same domain by enabling bottom-up safety reporting.

safety-stop (stop-work authority) IS a specific kind of decision — specifically an authoritative decision to halt operations. Direction: specific→general. A competent speaker would call stop-work authority 'a kind of decision.' Avoids my past error of conflating it with evaluation.

Safety-suggestion was designed and is maintained for the sake of safety-management: it provides a structured channel for frontline workers to report safety concerns, observations, and improvement ideas that feed into safety management's risk assessment and control processes. Law 8d: servant (safety-suggestion) → master (safety-management).
A safety-near-miss is a specific kind of safety-signal: it signals that the system is vulnerable by revealing a failure narrowly avoided. The near-miss serves as an indicator of trending risk.

A safety-audit-report is produced to serve safety-maintenance: its findings identify degradation, non-compliance, and failure patterns so maintenance teams can prioritize, schedule, and execute repairs. The report exists by design to further maintenance operations.

Feedforward serves safety-maintenance by providing predictive information that enables proactive maintenance: trend data, early warning indicators, and projected failure modes let maintenance act before degradation becomes a safety issue. By design, feedforward data feeds the maintenance decision loop.

Safety-inspection serves safety-maintenance: inspections are conducted specifically to identify what maintenance is needed, where degradation is occurring, and what components require attention. The inspection's designed purpose is to feed actionable maintenance intelligence.
A safety-interval is a specific kind of safety-signal: tracked time between events serves as an indicator of system health.

which-came-first: practice (repeated action sustained by repetition) predates safety-practice; safety-practice IS a specific kind of practice — a competent speaker would call a safety-practice 'a practice' — applied to the safety domain.

which-came-first: safety-practice (repeated action sustained for safety) is more general; safety-maintenance IS a specific kind of safety-practice — a systematic activity performed to maintain safety systems and equipment. A competent speaker would call maintenance 'a practice' when sustained for safety. Nearest kind: safety-practice.

safety-promotion IS a specific kind of safety-management — the subsystem focused on promoting, communicating, and encouraging safety culture within an organization. Safety-management is the broader discipline; promotion is one specific kind of it. Nearest kind verified.

safety-audit-report IS a specific kind of safety-report — the documented output of a safety audit. A competent speaker would call it 'a safety report'. Nearest kind verified: safety-report (more specific than bare 'report', more precise than 'audit' which is the process not the document).

safety-moment IS a specific kind of safety-practice — a brief safety-focused presentation or discussion conducted at meetings to advance safety outcomes. A competent speaker would call it 'a practice.' Nearest kind verified: safety-practice.

safety-training IS a specific kind of safety-practice — the systematic process of building knowledge, skills, and awareness in safety matters. A competent speaker would call training 'a practice.' Nearest kind: safety-practice (not safety-competence — competence is the outcome, training is the practice itself).

safety-inspection IS a specific kind of safety-practice. Inspections are systematic, repeatable activities performed to assess safety conditions — a subset of the broader class of safety-practices (actions sustained to advance safety outcomes).

safety-moment IS built to serve safety-promotion. A safety moment is a brief safety-focused presentation at meetings — its designed purpose is to promote safety awareness and culture among attendees. The servant (safety-moment) points to the master (safety-promotion): moments exist to further promotion's operation.

safety-training IS built to serve safety-promotion. Training builds knowledge and skills in safety matters — its sustained purpose is to promote safety competence and culture. The servant (training) exists for the sake of the master (promotion).

safety-reporting IS a specific kind of safety-practice. The systematic practice of documenting, communicating, and escalating safety issues is a repeatable action sustained for safety outcomes. A competent speaker would call it a safety practice. Nearest kind: safety-practice.

safety-audit IS a specific kind of safety-practice. An audit is a structured, repeatable methodical review — a practice, not merely a concept or tool. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. A competent speaker would call a safety audit a safety practice.

safety-review IS a specific kind of safety-practice. A review is a systematic evaluation performed as a structured activity — a practice. Direction: specific→general per Law 9. A competent speaker would call safety-review a safety practice.

A safety-barometer IS a specific kind of safety-indicator — a structured survey or metric system designed to measure and report on safety conditions, culture, or performance. Direction: specific→general.

A safety-barometer is built or maintained for the sake of safety-management — its designed purpose is to provide visibility into safety conditions, culture trends, and performance gaps so that management can make informed decisions. safety-strategy is built or maintained for the sake of safety-management — it provides the strategic direction and policy framework that safety-management executes. Law 8d: servant(strategy)→master(management). Purpose is by organizational design.

That belief only operates when people trust that colleagues and leaders will not exploit vulnerability. Without trust, the mechanism collapses: people may know the policy says 'no punishment,' but without trusting that it will be honored, the safety doesn't operate. This is constitutive removal, not mere sayability.

Safety routines (scheduled briefings, checks, drills) are maintained for the sake of building organizational resilience — they systematically preserve and improve the institution's capacity to absorb disruption, adapt, and recover.

Incident reporting systematically documents accidents, near-misses, and hazards to feed organizational learning — its designed purpose is to build the institution's capacity to absorb disruption and improve, serving organizational resilience.

Psychological safety is cultivated FOR THE SAKE OF organizational resilience. Open communication about failures enables organizations to absorb disruption. SERVES per Law 8d.

A sunburst chart is a specific kind of chart — a hierarchical visualization radiating outward from a center. A competent speaker calls it a type of chart. INSTANCE_OF per Law 9, nearest kind.

A stem-and-leaf plot is a specific kind of chart: it displays quantitative data using stems and leaves in a tabular-visual format that preserves raw values while showing distribution shape. A competent speaker would call it 'a chart' or 'a type of chart.' Per Law 9, specific→general instance.
contour plot IS a specific kind of chart — uses contour lines to represent 3D data on a 2D plane. A competent speaker would call a contour plot 'a chart'. Nearest kind: chart.

A solar chart is a specific kind of chart: a circular diagram mapping sun position. Solar charts are a subtype of circular data visualization charts.

An infographic IS a specific kind of visualization: it is a graphical representation of information designed to present complex data quickly and clearly. A competent speaker would call an infographic 'a visualization' — it maps to the nearest kind.

A cross-check IS a specific kind of verification — confirming accuracy by comparing against an independent source. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.

A scatter plot matrix IS a grid (matrix) of scatter plots — each cell is a scatter plot showing the relationship between two variables. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind (scatter plot). chart is already reached via the ladder scatter plot matrix→scatter plot→chart.

A scatter plot matrix is a grid of scatter plots displaying pairwise relationships between multiple variables. It is a specific kind of matrix used for multivariate data exploration, not a whole-part or dependency relation.

A data structure is a particular way of organizing data in a computer for efficient access and modification. It is a specific kind of representation — a structured encoding of information — not an abstraction (which is a property, not a kind per Law 9a).

A belief system is a specific kind of narrative — a structured, interconnected set of propositions that tells a coherent story about how the world works. database IS a specific kind of software: a computer program designed to store, retrieve, and manage data systematically. A competent speaker would call a database 'a kind of software application.' spreadsheet IS a specific kind of software: a computer program that organizes data in a grid of rows and columns for calculation, analysis, and visualization. A database IS a specific kind of data structure: an organized collection of data stored and retrieved electronically. Files against nearest kind 'data structure'. Direction: specific (database) → general (data structure). Tested: a database is a kind of data structure per Law 9.

A spreadsheet IS a specific kind of data structure: a grid-based arrangement of data in rows and columns for organization and computation. Files against nearest kind 'data structure'. Direction: specific (spreadsheet) → general (data structure). Tested: a spreadsheet is a kind of data structure per Law 9.

A data structure IS a specific kind of abstraction: a logical method for organizing and representing data in a computer system. Direction: specific (data structure) → general (abstraction). Nearest kind.

Cross-validation IS a specific kind of method: a statistical technique for evaluating model performance by partitioning data. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call cross-validation a method. The note pins the sense of 'method' as a systematic procedure, which matches the accepted definition.

Algorithmic accountability IS a specific kind of governance: a system of oversight ensuring automated decisions meet ethical and legal standards. A competent speaker would call algorithmic accountability a form of governance. Specific→general per Law 9.

A prompt template SERVES automated-decision-making: it is designed to structure and standardize the prompts that drive AI-mediated decisions. Per Law 8d, the prompt template is built to further the operation of automated-decision-making. Direction: servant (prompt template) → master (automated-decision-making).

Open-source IS a specific kind of software distribution model: software made available with source code accessible for viewing, modifying, and distributing. A competent speaker would call open-source software. Specific→general per Law 9.

A data pipeline IS a specific kind of workflow: a sequence of processing steps where each stage feeds the next. A competent speaker would call a data pipeline a type of workflow specialized for data transformation.

A parallel coordinates plot IS a specific kind of chart — a visual encoding of multivariate data. A competent speaker would call it 'a chart' that displays multiple quantitative variables as parallel axes connected by polylines.

A forest plot IS a specific kind of chart: a graph used to display results of multiple studies simultaneously, showing point estimates and confidence intervals. A competent speaker would call it 'a chart'.

A scatter plot matrix IS a specific kind of scatter plot: it displays multiple scatter plots in a matrix/grid format to show pairwise relationships between variables. Each cell is a scatter plot, making the whole a structured family of scatter plots.

A box plot IS a specific kind of plot: it displays the five-number summary (min, Q1, median, Q3, max) as a rectangular box with whiskers. A Q-Q plot IS a specific kind of chart: it plots quantiles of two distributions against each other for visual comparison. A competent speaker would call it 'a chart' or 'a plot' — both are correct, and chart is the broader established kind in the taxonomy.

A choropleth map is a specific kind of chart: it divides geographic regions into zones color-coded by statistical variables for visual comparison. A competent speaker would call it a type of chart or data visualization. Chart is the nearest general kind.

A choropleth map is a thematic map where geographic areas are shaded or patterned in proportion to a statistical variable. Per Law 9, it is a specific kind of map — a competent speaker would call it 'a map' (specifically a thematic or statistical map). Note: sense pinned to the cartographic sense of map (geographic representation), not the abstract diagrammatic sense.

A strip plot (also called a stripchart) is a simple data visualization that displays individual data points along a single axis, often with jitter to avoid overlap. A scatter plot matrix IS a grid (matrix) of scatter plots — each cell is a scatter plot showing the relationship between two variables. The whole is the matrix layout; each constituent part is a scatter plot.
An area chart is a specific kind of plot — it is a line plot where the area between the line and the axis is filled. A competent speaker would call it 'a plot'. Law 9: specific→general.

An embedding is a specific kind of representation — a numerical/vector encoding that captures semantic relationships between entities. A competent speaker would call an embedding 'a representation'. Law 9: specific→general.

A lead indicator IS a specific kind of metric — it is a forward-looking measure used to predict future outcomes rather than record past performance. A plot is a specific kind of chart — a graphical representation of data points. Competent speakers use 'plot' and 'chart' interchangeably for data visualizations (scatter plot = scatter chart). Chart is the broader category (epoch 0.31, plot epoch 0.88). Nearest kind: no tighter category between plot and chart exists.

A streamgraph is a specific kind of chart — a centered stacked area visualization with organic, flowing shape around a baseline. Competent speakers would call it 'a chart'. Chart is older/more-foundational (epoch 0.31, streamgraph epoch 0.31). Nearest kind: no tighter chart category exists.
A chart as a category contains the histogram as one of its recognized forms — a histogram is a specific way of rendering a chart for distribution data.

A chart category contains the radar chart — a graphical method for displaying multivariate data in the form of a two-dimensional chart with three or more quantitative variables represented on axes starting from the same point.

A pivot table is a specific kind of chart: it organizes and summarizes data in a tabular format with interactive grouping, aggregation, and sorting capabilities for data comparison. A competent speaker would call a pivot table a type of data chart.

A pivot table is a specific kind of data visualization: it presents aggregated, summarized data in a structured tabular layout where rows, columns, and values encode information through organization, grouping, and optional color-coding. A competent speaker would call a pivot table a form of data visualization because it makes patterns and relationships in data visible through its structured presentation.

A chain of thought is a specific kind of cognitive-strategy: a deliberate method of reasoning where a problem is broken into sequential intermediate steps, with each step's output feeding the next. It is a strategy because it can be consciously adopted, taught, and applied across domains to improve reasoning quality.

A just-culture is a specific kind of practice: an organizational safety practice that categorizes human errors by intent (human error, at-risk behavior, reckless behavior, and unconscionable action) to determine appropriate responses, encouraging reporting while maintaining accountability.

TESTED INSTANCE_OF: a bubble chart IS a specific kind of plot — it displays numeric data as circles on a 2D Cartesian coordinate system where position encodes two variables and bubble size encodes a third. Direction: specific plot type (bubble chart) → general kind (plot). Law 9: specific→general. This extends the scatter plot pattern with a size dimension.

histogram INSTANCE_OF plot: a histogram is a specific kind of plot — it maps one dimension (value bins) to another (frequency/count) as a visual encoding. Per Law 9: specific→general. A lollipop chart IS a specific kind of chart: it displays categorical data as lines ending in circles (replacing bar chart glyphs with dot markers). A competent speaker would call it a chart. It encodes values for comparison across categories.

A funnel chart IS a specific kind of chart: it visualizes stages of a process (e.g. sales pipeline) as stacked, decreasing-width shapes. A competent speaker would call it a chart. Nearest kind is 'chart'. Law 9.

A word cloud IS a specific kind of chart: it encodes word frequencies as visual size to reveal distribution patterns in text data. A competent speaker would call it a chart. Nearest kind is 'chart'. Law 9.

A frequency distribution organizes data to show how often values occur within a dataset. Remove statistics and frequency distributions lose their meaning and purpose.

Pseudocode is a human-readable notation for describing algorithmic logic in a structured format that resembles programming code but is not executable. It is a specific kind of notation — a system of symbolic conventions for representing computational ideas — designed for communication between humans rather than execution by machines.

Direction test: specific→general. A grouped bar chart IS a specific kind of chart — bars arranged in clusters for multi-category comparison. A competent speaker would call it a chart. Direction test: specific→general. A scatter plot matrix IS a specific kind of matrix — a grid/matrix layout where each cell contains a scatter plot. A competent speaker in the data viz domain would describe it as a matrix of plots. Files against nearest kind. Sense: structured layout arrangement.

Direction test: specific→general. A grouped bar chart IS a specific kind of bar chart — bars arranged in clusters to compare multiple categories side by side. A competent speaker would call a grouped bar chart 'a bar chart'. Nearest kind: bar chart (bar chart→chart already ACCEPTED, so chart is not the nearest kind).

A histogram IS a visual encoding of frequency data (binned counts); without the concept of frequency distribution, there is no histogram to visualize. This is constitutive: the histogram's entire mechanism is to render a frequency distribution graphically.

Direction test: specific→general. A frequency distribution IS a specific kind of data structure — it maps values to their counts/frequencies, organizing data for analysis. A frequency table is a recognized data structure in statistics and data science. Nearest kind: data structure.

A dot plot is a specific kind of statistical plot where data points are plotted as dots on a simple axis. Each dot represents an observation. The sense is visual data representation: a minimalist plot showing individual data values. A competent speaker would call a dot plot 'a plot'.

A sankey diagram IS a specific kind of flow diagram. It visualizes quantities as flows passing through nodes, with flow width proportional to quantity. A sunburst diagram is a specific kind of tree diagram — it displays hierarchical data as concentric rings where each ring represents a level in the hierarchy. Files against nearest kind, not chart.
A pivot table is a specific kind of data visualization — it summarizes and groups data in a tabular format that conveys quantitative patterns through structured layout.

A stem plot (stem-and-leaf plot) IS a specific kind of plot: it is a visual display technique for showing the distribution of numerical data, where each value is split into a stem (leading digit(s)) and a leaf (trailing digit), arranged in a ranked, plot-like display. The nearest kind is plot — it is a way of plotting data.

A confusion matrix IS a specific kind of matrix — a rectangular array of numerical values used in machine learning to compare predicted versus actual classifications. It is a tabular data structure organized as a matrix with rows and columns, fitting the general definition of a matrix as a structured grid of values.

An outlier IS a specific kind of anomaly: it is a data point that deviates significantly from other observations in a dataset. The specific (outlier: a statistical observation) → general (anomaly: anything deviating from standard/expected) direction.

A fire drill IS a specific kind of safety routine: a practiced exercise designed to prepare people for emergency response. A competent speaker would call a fire drill 'a safety routine'. The direction is correct (specific→general).

Direction test: contour plot IS a specific kind of plot — a graphical method for representing 3D data on a 2D plane using contour lines. A competent speaker would call it 'a plot'. Nearest kind is 'plot' (same ladder as stem plot).

A slope graph is a specific kind of chart — a competent speaker would call a slope graph 'a chart'. It visualizes changes between states using connecting lines. Law 9: specific→general, nearest kind is chart.

A rug plot is a specific kind of plot that displays individual data points as small marks along an axis. Law 9: specific→general. A slope graph IS a specific kind of plot: data points connected by lines to visualize change across states. Per Law 9 (specific→general) and Law 11e, nearest kind is 'plot'. A scatter plot IS a specific kind of plot: it displays quantitative data as a collection of points on Cartesian coordinates. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call a scatter plot 'a plot'. Plot is the nearest kind — the edge runs from specific to general.

A stem-and-leaf plot is a specific kind of plot: a method for displaying quantitative data where each data value is split into a stem (leading digit(s)) and a leaf (trailing digit), preserving actual data values while showing distribution shape. A competent speaker would call it a plot.
Gradient descent is a specific kind of optimization algorithm, and more broadly a specific kind of algorithm. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call gradient descent 'an algorithm'.

A beeswarm plot is a specific kind of chart used in data visualization. Law 9: specific→general. The filer pins the sense of 'chart' as a visual representation of data — beeswarm plot is indeed a specific type.

A coxcomb chart (Flandrin chart) is a specific kind of pie chart where the segment radii vary proportionally to the data values. Remove statistics and stem-and-leaf plot ceases to operate: the plot's entire mechanism — sorting data into stems and leaves, interpreting frequency distributions, extracting summary statistics — depends on statistical concepts to function. A spider chart (spider diagram, web chart) IS a specific kind of radar chart. A lollipop chart IS a specific kind of bar chart. Random forest needs machine learning to operate: it is an ensemble learning algorithm whose entire purpose and operation — bagging, averaging predictions from multiple decision trees, reducing variance — are defined within the machine learning paradigm. Probability theory existed first and fed into PDP. PDP computes conditional expectations E[f(X)|X_j=x] which are probabilistic constructs rooted in probability theory. Which came first? Probability theory — PDP is a 2000s ML visualization built on these foundations.

Probability theory existed first and fed into conditional probability — Bayes built on the existing framework of probability to formalize inference under partial information.
DERIVED_FROM direction tested: precision (19th century) predates F1 score (1971). F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall — derived from precision.

Remove mathematics — the formal language of symbols, proofs, and structures — and information theory has no formalism. Entropy formulas, coding theorems, and information measures all require mathematical structure to operate.

A tombstone is a specific kind of memorial — a stone marker placed at a grave to remember the deceased. A competent speaker would call a tombstone 'a type of memorial.' Tested: INSTANCE_OF (specific→general, Law 9).

Law 9 INSTANCE_OF: a soundtrack is a specific kind of music composed or selected for media (film, video game, theater). It is music with a specific purpose — to accompany and enhance a narrative or visual experience. A competent speaker would call a soundtrack 'a kind of music.' Direction: specific (soundtrack) → general (music).

playing-cards are designed and maintained for the sake of games. Law 8d SERVES: the servant (playing-card) points at the master (game). Cards exist as game components by design, not because games need cards to operate.

Zeigarnik-effect is a specific kind of cognitive-bias: the systematic tendency to remember uncompleted tasks better than completed ones. Law 9 INSTANCE_OF — a competent speaker familiar with psychology would classify the Zeigarnik effect as a type of cognitive bias affecting memory recall.

Intermittent reinforcement is a specific kind of reinforcement where rewards are delivered unpredictably (partial/intermittent vs continuous). Law 9 INSTANCE_OF: a competent speaker would call intermittent reinforcement 'a type of reinforcement' — specifically, one delivered on an unpredictable schedule rather than every time.

reframing is a technique designed and maintained for the sake of cognitive-behavioral-therapy. Law 8d: the servant (reframing) points at the master (CBT). Reframing is a core CBT intervention, not an incidental use.

The Zeigarnik effect IS a memory phenomenon — better retention of incomplete tasks. Remove memory and the phenomenon literally stops operating; it is not merely unsayable but inoperable. The removal test passes: no memory → no retention pattern → no Zeigarnik effect.

The Zeigarnik effect is the phenomenon where incomplete tasks capture and maintain attention. The removal test: remove attention and the effect has nothing to operate on — the effect IS attention held by incompleteness. Present-tense dependency (Law 8).

The Zeigarnik effect is the phenomenon where incomplete tasks persist in recall better than completed ones. Remove memory and the effect ceases to operate entirely — the phenomenon IS the memory system's differential treatment of incomplete versus complete intentions. This is a real operational dependency: the effect cannot function without memory as its substrate, just as class imbalance DEPENDS_ON machine learning (the technique operates on data within that domain).

The anchoring heuristic (using a starting value and insufficiently adjusting) is the mental mechanism; the anchoring effect (judgments biased toward anchors) is the observed phenomenon. Which existed first? The heuristic as a cognitive process predates the effect as a documented finding — the effect was discovered as the consequence of the heuristic operating. This is a historical-causal relationship, not a present-tense dependency.

Memory as a concept existed first (ancient philosophical tradition, 0.52) and fed into the Zeigarnik effect (20th-century named psychological phenomenon, 0.55). Which-came-first test passes per edge-test. DERIVED_FROM is historical, not operational.

The zeigarnik effect (incomplete tasks persisting in recall better than completed ones) is a specific kind of cognitive bias. A competent speaker would call it a cognitive bias — it is a systematic pattern of deviation from rational judgment in how memory operates.

The anchoring heuristic operates by holding an anchor value in memory and adjusting from it. Remove memory — the anchor cannot be retained, adjustment cannot occur, and the heuristic ceases to function. This is a genuine operating dependency (Law 8), not meta-level (Law 2b): memory is a necessary operational component of the heuristic, not just a condition for naming it.

Emotional regulation is a specific kind of cognitive strategy: a deliberate mental approach to managing and processing emotional information. A competent speaker would call emotional regulation 'a cognitive strategy' — it is the cognitive-side method of emotional self-management.

The Zeigarnik effect describes how incomplete tasks persist in active recall. Remove working memory — the incomplete task cannot be actively maintained, and the effect ceases to operate. This passes the present-tense removal test of Law 8: the effect literally requires working memory to function, not merely to be said.

Self-talk is the internal use of language — talking to oneself using words. Remove language and self-talk literally ceases to operate; it is not merely unsayable, the practice itself becomes impossible. This is a constitutive, object-level dependency.

Surprise is the psychological response when an outcome deviates from a prediction. Remove prediction and surprise ceases to operate — there is no deviation from expectation to register. This is object-level: surprise's mechanism involves comparing outcomes to expectations, not merely needing the word 'surprise' to be said.

A queue is a specific kind of data structure where elements are ordered and accessed in FIFO (first-in, first-out) order. A competent speaker would call a queue 'a data structure.' This is a direct INSTANCE_OF relation against the nearest kind.

A commission (the fee/percentage paid for a transaction) is designed to further trade operations — its purpose is to compensate intermediaries who facilitate commerce. For whose sake? The commission points at trade as master. Law 8d: this is teleological (designed purpose), not a DEPENDS_ON (remove trade and commissions still exist as contracts).

A commission is a specific kind of incentive — a financial mechanism that rewards intermediaries for facilitating transactions. A competent speaker in the right context would call a commission an incentive. Sense: commission as a motivator/financial incentive structure, not just a fee. INSTANCE_OF: specific kind of financial incentive.

A credit hour is defined as a time-based unit of academic study (typically ~1 hour of class per week). Remove the concept of time and credit hours lose their defining parameter — they cannot operate as time measurements without time as a reference. This is constitutive at the object level, not meta-level: credit hours are specifically temporal units, not just anything that happens to need time.

A commission is built and maintained for the sake of commerce — its designed purpose is to facilitate commercial transactions by compensating intermediaries. Servant (commission) points at master (commerce). Law 8d.

Emotional regulation is a specific kind of self-regulation: it is the deliberate management and modification of emotional responses. A competent speaker would call emotional regulation 'a form of self-regulation.' Law 9 — the specific points at the general. Self-regulation is the broader category; emotional regulation is the emotion-specific variant.
A fluency-heuristic is a specific kind of heuristic — a mental shortcut where processing ease guides judgment. A competent speaker would call it 'a heuristic.' Specific→general, nearest kind.

A jailbreak requires software to operate: it is a software modification that circumvents platform restrictions. Remove software and the jailbreak literally cannot exist or function (Law 8 removal test).

Social proof is a specific kind of heuristic: a mental shortcut where, in uncertain situations, people use others' observed behavior as guidance for their own actions. A competent speaker would call social proof 'a heuristic' — specifically, a social heuristic that substitutes peer behavior for independent analysis. This is the same sense as fluency-heuristic and availability-heuristic, both already INSTANCE_OF heuristic in the graph.

A self-fulfilling prophecy requires belief in the prediction to trigger the behavior that makes it true. Remove belief and the self-fulfilling mechanism stops operating — the prediction may be stated but it no longer fulfills itself. The removal test passes.

A workshop is a gathering designed for active learning and creation. Its purpose is to further education — remove education as the aim and the gathering reverts to a mere meeting or lecture. The for-whose-sake test points workshop→education (Law 8d).

A funeral rite is a ceremony designed to help people process loss. Its purpose is to serve grief — remove grief as the target and the rite loses its function entirely. The rite exists for the sake of addressing grief (Law 8d).

A curtain call is a specific kind of ritual: a prescribed ceremonial behavior that marks the end of a performance and acknowledges the audience. A competent speaker would call a curtain call a ritual. The sense pinned is the ceremonial/ritual sense, not incidental — the curtain call follows a fixed pattern of recognition between performer and audience.

A curtain call is maintained for the sake of performance. Its designed purpose is to complete the performance experience: to acknowledge the audience, signal the end, and create the shared moment of gratitude between performer and spectator. Remove the performance — the curtain call loses its reason for existing. The servant (curtain call) points at the master (performance).

A jig is built and maintained for the sake of manufacturing. Its designed purpose is to guide or hold a workpiece in manufacturing processes, ensuring precision and repeatability. Remove manufacturing — the jig has no purpose without it. The servant (jig) points at the master (manufacturing).

A loom is a specific kind of instrument: a mechanical device used for weaving threads into fabric or other materials. A competent speaker would describe a loom as 'an instrument of weaving.' Files against the nearest accepted kind — instrument is the immediate category (loom is a specific type of instrument, not merely using one).
The Zeigarnik effect is a specific cognitive bias: the tendency to recall uncompleted tasks better than completed ones. It is a kind of memory-related cognitive bias. Files against nearest kind.
A jailbreak is created and maintained for the sake of autonomy — to gain unrestricted control over a device. Its designed purpose is to further the user's autonomy. Fits Law 8d.
A manifesto is created and maintained for the sake of persuasion — to declare principles and persuade others to adopt a viewpoint. Its designed purpose is to further persuasion. Fits Law 8d.

A certificate is created and maintained for the sake of verification. Its designed purpose is to attest to the truth, quality, or completion of something. Remove verification and a certificate loses its entire function — it exists to serve verification.

A credit hour is designed and maintained for the sake of education. Its purpose is to standardize and quantify student learning time within educational institutions. Remove education and the credit hour has no function — it exists to serve educational accounting.

A schema depends on taxonomy: a schema is a structured framework that organizes information, and it requires taxonomic classification (categorization into hierarchical kinds) to function. Remove taxonomy — structured categorization — and a schema loses its organizing principle. Present-tense removal test passes.
A certificate is a specific kind of credential — it attests to identity, qualification, or status. A competent speaker would call a certificate a credential. Files against nearest kind: credential.

Functional fixedness requires learning to operate: the bias arises from learned associations about typical object uses. Remove learning and there are no learned norms about how objects are used, so the fixation mechanism has nothing to latch onto. This passes the removal test — X as a concept needs Y (meta-level) only if the dependency is constitutive at the object level. Here the bias is literally about over-reliance on learned use-conventions, making learning constitutive to its operation.

A loom is built and maintained for the sake of producing woven fabric and garments. Per Law 8d: the servant (loom) points at the master (garment production). The designed purpose of a loom is to further garment/textile production.

A clock is built and maintained for the purpose of measuring and displaying time. Per Law 8d: the servant (clock) points at the master (time). The designed function of a clock is to serve time-keeping operations — without a clock, the measurement of time becomes imprecise and non-standardized.

A calendar is built and maintained for the purpose of organizing and tracking time over extended periods. Per Law 8d: the servant (calendar) points at the master (time). Its designed purpose is to serve temporal organization — seasonal cycles, dates, scheduling.

Antonymy is a specific kind of semantic relation — the relation between words with opposite meanings. Law 9: the specific (antonymy) points at the general (semantic-relation). A competent speaker would call antonymy 'a semantic relation'.

Synonymy is a specific kind of semantic relation — the relation between words with similar meanings. Law 9: the specific (synonym) points at the general (semantic-relation). A competent speaker would call synonym 'a semantic relation'.

An appliance is a specific kind of instrument — a device or tool designed for a particular practical purpose, typically mechanical or electrical. Law 9: the specific (appliance) points at the general (instrument). A competent speaker would call an appliance 'an instrument' in the broad sense (artifact extending human capacity, Law 11c).

The Dunning-Kruger effect is a specific kind of cognitive bias in which people with low ability at a task overestimate their ability. Law 9: a competent speaker would call the Dunning-Kruger effect 'a cognitive bias'.

Analogy is a specific kind of comparison — it draws structural parallels between two different domains to explain or reason about one in terms of the other. Law 9: a competent speaker would call an analogy 'a comparison'.
A sunset clause is a specific kind of provision — one that includes an automatic expiration trigger. Law 9: a competent speaker would call a sunset clause a provision.

Per Law 8: the Dunning-Kruger phenomenon operates through self-assessment mechanisms. Remove self-assessment — the ability to evaluate one's own competence — and the Dunning-Kruger effect cannot operate: there is no self-assessment to misfire. This is object-level, not meta-level: the effect is specifically about self-assessment errors, not about language or cognition in general.

Per Law 8d: a lattice is built or maintained for the sake of architecture — its designed purpose is to further architectural operation through decorative screening, light modulation, or structural articulation. Servant (lattice) points at master (architecture).

Per Law 9: the Dunning-Kruger effect is a specific kind of cognitive distortion — systematic misjudgment of one's own ability. A competent speaker would classify it as 'a cognitive distortion.' Direction: specific→general.

Per Law 9: functional fixedness is a specific kind of cognitive distortion — the inability to see novel uses for familiar objects because of entrenched mental categories. A competent speaker would call it 'a cognitive distortion.'

A waiver is a specific kind of legal document: a written instrument by which a party relinquishes a known claim or right. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call a waiver 'a legal document.' Direction: specific→general.

Overconfidence-bias is a specific kind of cognitive bias: systematic overestimation of one's abilities, knowledge, or prospects. A competent speaker would call it 'a cognitive bias.' Which-came-first test shows overconfidence-bias (epoch 0.01) predates cognitive-bias (epoch 0.69), consistent with INSTANCE_OF direction.

A homophone is a specific kind of homonym: a word that sounds the same as another word but differs in meaning. Homophones share phonetic identity while homonyms is the broader set of words sharing sound (and possibly spelling). Direction specific→general per Law 9.

Deductive reasoning needs logic to operate now: it is the application of logical principles to derive conclusions from premises. Remove logic and deductive reasoning cannot function — it has no working mechanism without logical rules. Object-level dependency, not meta-level.

Formwork is a specific kind of template: a mold into which concrete is poured to shape a structure. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call formwork 'a template.' Direction: specific→general, correct.

Homophones are a linguistic phenomenon: words that sound the same but mean different things. The phenomenon requires language to exist — words, phonetic systems, and semantic distinction are all products of language. Remove language and homophones have no substrate on which to operate.

Overconfidence-bias operates through the mechanism of distorted self-evaluation. The bias consists in systematically overestimating one's own abilities or knowledge — this requires self-assessment as the mechanism being distorted. Remove self-assessment and the bias has no operation: there is no evaluating self to be overconfident about.

A waiver is a formal renunciation of a right or claim within a legal/institutional framework. Remove law as a concept and the waiver mechanism stops operating — there is no 'right' to waive, no legal authority to renounce it before, and no institutional recognition of the renunciation. The removal test (Law 8) passes: without law, waiver ceases to function.

A dialect is a specific variety of language — a particular form used by a community. A competent speaker would call it 'a language' (e.g. 'a dialect of English'). Files against the nearest kind per Law 9.

A cognitive affordance is a specific kind of design pattern: a reusable solution to the problem of supporting cognition. A competent speaker would say 'a cognitive affordance is a design pattern' — specifically, a pattern whose purpose is to make a cognitive operation easier. Files against the nearest kind (design-pattern, per Law 11e).

Test: symbol first, then barcode. A barcode is a specific kind of symbol — a machine-readable visual marking designed to encode data. A competent speaker would say 'a barcode is a visual symbol' — specifically one designed for automated reading. Files against nearest kind per Law 9.

A sandbox is a specific kind of tool — an artifact or environment designed for safe experimentation and learning without risk. Per Law 11c, tool carries its broad sense of any artifact that extends a human capacity. Files against the nearest kind per Law 9.

A riddle is designed for the sake of provoking curiosity — its purpose is to engage the mind through puzzle. Per Law 8d, the servant (riddle) points at the master (curiosity). A competent speaker would say 'riddles serve curiosity.'

Remove measurement — does operational-definition stop operating? Yes. An operational definition defines how to measure a concept; without the measurement function, it has no purpose. The removal test passes.
A glyph is designed and maintained for the sake of communication — its purpose is to convey meaning through visual symbols. Per Law 8d, servant (glyph) points at master (communication). By design.

A cognitive affordance IS the perception of what actions an object affords — it is not a property of the object alone but a cognitive relationship. Remove perception entirely and cognitive affordances cease to operate. The removal test passes: this is a constitutive dependency, not a meta-level association (Law 2b).

Calculation needs number to operate now: arithmetic, counting, and computation all run on numerical values. Remove number as a concept and calculation stops — no numbers, no calculation. This is not a historical claim (DERIVED_FROM) but a present-tense operational need.

Calculation as a formal, systematic practice needs algorithms to operate now: algorithms are the structured procedures that make calculation reproducible and generalizable. Remove algorithms (systematic step-by-step procedures for computation) and calculation as a practiced discipline loses its method — only ad hoc counting remains. This is not a meta-level claim: calculation's operating procedure is the algorithm.
Calculation is a specific kind of problem-solving: applying systematic methods to resolve quantitative questions. A competent speaker calls calculation 'a form of problem-solving.'

Cognitive affordance serves learning: the perception of action possibilities directly supports skill acquisition and adaptive behavior. Its designed purpose is to guide learners toward effective interaction with their environment.

A data matrix code is a specific kind of barcode: both are machine-readable optical labels that encode data in visual patterns. A competent speaker would call a data matrix code 'a type of barcode.' Per Law 9, specific→general. The direction is correct and the sense is clear: we're talking about the class of 2D/barcode symbologies.

Information-foraging theory models how agents gather information to reduce uncertainty and make decisions. Its designed purpose is to serve decision-making by guiding search strategies toward information-rich patches. Per Law 8d: for whose sake does information-foraging operate? For decision-making.

Cognitive affordance is a specific kind of property — specifically, an environmental property that specifies action possibilities for a cognizing agent. Per Law 9, the filer pins the sense: environmental affordance-as-property. Not a cognitive bias (that was my previous error), but a property that cognition accesses.

Decision fatigue operates through depletion of executive resources — remove executive-function and the mechanism of decision fatigue ceases to operate. Law 8 removal test: without executive resources, there is no resource depletion.

Cognitive-affordance is a specific kind of affordance — it is an affordance as experienced, interpreted, and acted upon by a cognitive agent. Law 9: a competent speaker would call a cognitive affordance 'an affordance.' Nearest kind: affordance.

Precision measures reproducibility while accuracy measures correctness. Remove accuracy and the concept of precision loses its grounding — precision is precision relative to a correct standard. The removal test: without accuracy, precision as a measured quality stops operating.

Vernacular DEPENDS_ON language by Law 8's removal test: vernacular refers to everyday, non-specialized language use. Remove language as a concept and vernacular — defined as the ordinary speech of a community — loses all meaning. Vernacular operates only within the framework language provides.

Computation is a specific kind of calculation — the process of transforming information through a defined sequence of operations. Calculation is the broader concept of computing quantities; computation extends this to information processing and symbolic manipulation. A competent speaker would call computation 'a type of calculation' in the broad sense. Tested nearest kind: no intermediate rung between calculation and computation exists.
Computation SERVES calculation — computation is the specific process of transforming information through defined operations, and its designed purpose is to further the broader concept of calculation.

Removal test: remove algorithms (defined procedures for transforming information) and computation as a concept stops operating — computation is the execution of algorithms. This is constitutive, not incidental: computation exists as a concept only through the notion of defined operations/algorithms.

Resolution is a formal decision or determination — a specific kind of decision reached through deliberation. A competent speaker would call a resolution 'a decision.' The sense is formal/political: a resolution is a decision adopted by a body or assembly.

Calculation is a specific kind of computation — specifically, the arithmetic or numerical kind. A competent speaker calls calculation 'a computation.' The sense is operational: computation as the broad capacity, calculation as its numeric instantiation.

Remove ground-truth (the true/correct reference standard) and accuracy as a concept stops operating: accuracy IS closeness to the true, so without a ground-truth there is no accuracy to speak of. Passes the removal test of Law 8.
