MTTR as a metric needs measurement to operate: without the ability to timestamp detection and restoration events, the calculation collapses. Removal test: remove measurement capability and MTTR ceases to function as a metric.

graceful-degradation is a specific kind of design pattern — a software architecture pattern where the system degrades non-essential features under load to maintain core functionality. Direction: specific→general (Law 9). Files against nearest kind.

circuit-breaker is derived from the broader concept of fault-isolation. Which-came-first test (Law 7): fault-isolation (epoch 0.01) predates circuit-breaker (epoch 0.07). The circuit-breaker pattern is a specific application of fault-isolation principles to prevent cascading failures.

chaos-engineering is practiced for the sake of robustness — its designed purpose is to discover weaknesses and validate recovery mechanisms under controlled failure, thereby building and verifying robustness. Per Law 8d: the servant (chaos-engineering) points at the master (robustness).

graceful-degradation is a specific kind of fault-isolation strategy — it isolates failures by degrading non-essential features to contain impact. Direction: specific→general (Law 9). The nearest kind that 'is a form of fault containment' is fault-isolation itself.

Chaos-engineering is designed to test and validate incident response — its controlled failures exercise detection, escalation, and recovery workflows that constitute incident response. For whose sake: the chaos practice exists to further incident-response capability.

Fault-isolation is a reliability engineering practice — its purpose is to contain failures and prevent cascading outages, thereby maintaining system reliability. For whose sake: fault-isolation exists to further reliability.

Graceful-degradation maintains core functionality under stress by shedding non-essential features — a direct reliability engineering strategy. For whose sake: graceful degradation exists to preserve reliability when systems are under duress.

graceful-degradation is practiced for the sake of robustness: by shedding non-essential features under stress, it preserves core functionality and system integrity, directly building and verifying robustness. For whose sake: graceful degradation serves robustness. Law 8d — servant (graceful-degradation) points at master (robustness).

resilience-engineering is an engineering discipline practiced for the sake of reliability: it applies systematic methods to build systems that absorb disruptions, recover from failures, and adapt — all aimed at maintaining and improving system reliability. For whose sake: resilience-engineering serves reliability. Law 8d.

circuit-breaker is practiced for the sake of robustness: by preventing cascading failures, it preserves system integrity under stress. Per Law 8d: for whose sake does circuit-breaker exist? Robustness. The teleological sense is clear.

chaos-engineering is practiced for the sake of reliability: its controlled failures exercise detection, recovery, and adaptation workflows that maintain system reliability. Per Law 8d: chaos engineering exists for the sake of reliability. The teleological test pins the right direction.

a service-level-agreement is a specific kind of contract. Per Law 9: specific→general. Competent-speaker test: 'an SLA is a contract.' The nearest kind is contract — no intermediate category between contract and SLA.

circuit-breaker needs measurement to operate: it depends on measuring failure rates, latency, and health metrics to decide when to open/close/half-open. Per Law 8: remove measurement now and circuit-breaker cannot operate (no data to base decisions on). This is not meta-level (Law 2b) — circuit-breaker's own mechanism requires quantitative measurement.

MTTR is a specific kind of metric. The competent-speaker test passes: 'MTTR is a metric.' No intermediate category between MTTR and metric — it directly measures the average time to recover from failures. Nearest kind is metric.

Fault-isolation is practiced for the sake of robustness. Its designed purpose is to contain failures and prevent cascading, thereby building and verifying robustness. Per Law 8d: for whose sake? Robustness. The servant (fault-isolation) points at the master (robustness).

Robustness is built and maintained for the sake of reliability. A robust system is one that can withstand stress — this capacity exists to ensure the system continues operating reliably. Per Law 8d: for whose sake? Reliability. The servant (robustness) points at the master (reliability).

Resilience-engineering builds system resilience, which is a form of robustness — the capacity to absorb disruptions and maintain function under stress. Per Law 8d: servant (resilience-engineering) → master (robustness).

MTTR measurement relies on fault-isolation as a contained phase — recovery time is measured from the point of isolation to full restoration. Remove fault-isolation and you lose the boundary that makes MTTR a meaningful metric.

best-practice is a specific kind of heuristic: a practical guideline shown to consistently produce superior outcomes. A competent speaker would call a best-practice 'a kind of heuristic' — it serves as a shortcut to good decisions without exhaustive analysis each time.

Resilience-engineering is a specific kind of engineering discipline focused on building systems that withstand and recover from failures. A competent speaker would call it an engineering. Per Law 9: specific→general.

MTTR is a specific kind of measurement: it measures the time to restore service after a failure. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call MTTR 'a measurement'. Nearest kind is measurement — no intermediate rung between MTTR and measurement.

shift-handover is a specific kind of procedure: a structured method for transferring responsibility between shifts. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call it 'a procedure'. Nearest kind is procedure.

Fault-isolation is a specific kind of design pattern — a named, reusable solution to the recurring problem of containing failure blast radius. A competent speaker calls it 'a design pattern'. The nearest kind is design-pattern (no intermediate rung between fault-isolation and design-pattern in the INSTANCE_OF ladder).

A blameless postmortem is designed for the sake of reliability: by removing blame from incident analysis, it encourages thorough root-cause investigation and systemic fixes that prevent recurrence, directly advancing reliability. Law 8d: servant (blameless-postmortem) → master (reliability).
shift-handover needs communication to operate — it is fundamentally a transfer of information between shifts. Remove communication and shift-handover cannot function.
MTTR is maintained for the sake of reliability: it measures restoration speed so teams can track and improve reliability performance. Servant (MTTR) points at master (reliability).

Safety empowerment is built and maintained for the sake of reliability — its designed purpose is to further reliable operation by empowering workers to act on safety concerns. The servant points at the master, per Law 8d. SERVES, not DEPENDS_ON: remove reliability and safety-empowerment still exists (it serves safety culture too).

Safety suggestion is a mechanism built for the sake of safety improvement — its designed purpose is to further the identification and correction of safety issues. Per Law 8d, the servant (safety-suggestion) points at the master (safety-improvement).
defensive-design is a specific kind of design-pattern: it designs systems to anticipate failure modes and handle errors gracefully rather than catastrophically. Per Law 9, specific→general.

blast-radius is a specific kind of risk-assessment: it quantifies the extent of damage when a single component fails, providing a measure of consequence that informs prioritization of mitigation strategies.
blast-radius analysis is built and maintained for the sake of reliability: by understanding how failures propagate, engineers can design systems that maintain operation despite component failures.

Safety instruments are designed and maintained for the sake of reliability: they automatically act to bring a process to a safe state when operational limits are exceeded, preventing failures that would undermine reliable operation.
Safety symptoms serve reliability: early warnings of deteriorating conditions let operators intervene before failures occur, maintaining reliable operation through proactive detection.

Single-point-of-failure analysis emerged from reliability engineering practice in the 1960s aerospace and nuclear industries. Reliability engineering as a discipline predates the SPOF concept and fed into it through fault tree analysis and reliability block diagrams.

A latent condition is a specific kind of risk: a present but unmanifested potential for failure. Per Law 9, it fits the pattern 'X is a specific kind of Y' — a latent condition is a risk that already exists in the system but has not yet manifested as a failure.

A safety bottleneck is a specific kind of safety analysis: the identification and characterization of constraints that limit overall safety performance. Per Law 9, it fits the pattern X is a specific kind of Y — a safety bottleneck analysis IS a type of safety analysis that focuses on constraining factors.

Timeboxing is a specific kind of planning technique: allocating fixed time periods for tasks. A competent speaker would call timeboxing 'a planning method.' Direction specific→general. Ezra's time-blocking→planning edge was accepted, confirming this ladder rung.

Canary deployment needs monitoring to operate: the technique deploys a small subset of new code, then monitors its behavior for errors before a full rollout. Remove monitoring and canary deployment cannot function — you cannot detect whether the canary succeeds or fails without observing it.

Time-management is a specific kind of planning: the practice of organizing and controlling time to improve efficiency and productivity. A competent speaker calls time-management a planning method. Model evaluation IS a specific kind of machine learning practice: the systematic assessment of model performance using metrics, benchmarks, and held-out data. A competent speaker would call model evaluation 'a machine learning practice.' Direction specific→general per Law 9.

Timeboxing IS a specific kind of scheduling technique: it allocates a fixed, maximal time block to a task. A competent speaker would call it 'a scheduling method.' The nearest kind is scheduling.

Model evaluation IS a specific kind of evaluation: systematically assessing how well a model performs. A competent speaker would call model evaluation 'an evaluation.' Nearest kind is evaluation.

dropout is a specific kind of regularization technique. A competent speaker would call dropout 'a regularization method.' It randomizes neuron deactivation to prevent co-adaptation, fitting squarely under the regularization umbrella.

Learning rate scheduling is a specific kind of optimization technique. It adjusts the learning rate according to a predefined schedule during training. A competent speaker would call it 'an optimization method.'

Batch normalization is a specific kind of normalization technique — it normalizes layer activations across a mini-batch to produce zero-mean, unit-variance outputs. A competent speaker would call batch normalization 'a normalization method.' Nearest kind is normalization.

Model evaluation measures model performance against criteria. Emotional regulation is the process of monitoring, evaluating, and modifying emotional responses. Knowledge distillation is a specific kind of transfer learning — a student model learns from a teacher model to transfer compressed knowledge. A competent speaker would call it a transfer learning method. Files against nearest kind.

Batch normalization is built and maintained for the sake of training — it stabilizes training dynamics and accelerates convergence. Its designed purpose is to further training's operation (Law 8d: for whose sake? training is the master).

Learning rate scheduling IS a specific kind of hyperparameter optimization: it adjusts the learning rate during training as a managed hyperparameter. A competent speaker calls it 'a hyperparameter optimization technique.' Files against the nearest kind.

Model evaluation IS a specific kind of assessment: the systematic evaluation of something against criteria to determine quality or performance. A competent speaker calls model evaluation 'an assessment method.' Files against the nearest kind, avoiding the discipline-leap error from my past.

Weight decay IS a specific kind of regularization technique: it adds a penalty proportional to the squared magnitude of weights to the loss function. A competent speaker would call it 'a regularization method.' Files against the nearest kind (regularization) per Law 9.

Gradient clipping IS a specific kind of regularization technique: it bounds gradient magnitudes to prevent exploding gradients during training. A competent speaker would call it 'a regularization method.' Files against the nearest kind (regularization) per Law 9.

Weight decay operates by adding a penalty term to the loss function — without the loss function concept, weight decay has nothing to modify and stops operating. The removal test: remove loss functions, weight decay cannot function. Files present-tense dependency, not historical origin.

Learning rate scheduling operates during training — it adjusts the learning rate as part of the training process. The removal test: remove training, learning rate scheduling stops operating entirely (nothing to schedule for). Files present-tense dependency per Law 8.

Gradient clipping bounds gradient magnitudes during training to prevent exploding gradients. The removal test: remove training, and gradient clipping has no context in which to operate — there are no gradients to clip outside a training loop.

A safety-instrument is a specific kind of instrument — an instrument designed to maintain or restore a safe state when process conditions exceed predetermined limits. A competent speaker would call it 'an instrument.' Files against nearest kind per Law 9.

The chain rule (mathematical theorem for derivatives of compositions) existed first and is the mathematical foundation that backpropagation applies to neural networks. Backpropagation is essentially the chain rule applied iteratively through computational graphs.

backpropagation DEPENDS_ON chain rule: remove the chain rule and backpropagation stops operating — it literally IS the chain rule applied recursively through network layers. The removal test passes (Law 8): without the chain rule, there is no mechanism to compute gradients through hidden layers.

Optimizer INSTANCE_OF optimization algorithm: an optimizer (SGD, Adam, RMSprop) is a specific kind of optimization algorithm. A competent speaker calls an optimizer 'an optimization algorithm.' Nearest kind checked — no rung exists between them.

Neural network architecture CONTAINS transfer function: transfer (activation) functions are constituent components of a neural network architecture — they define the transformation at each node. Whole-and-part relation verified (Law 10).

An optimizer (SGD, Adam, RMSprop) is a specific kind of optimization algorithm — a competent speaker would call an optimizer 'an optimization algorithm.' Law 9: specific→general. The edge-test confirms no existing edge between these. This pins the INSTANCE_OF sense: membership in the category of optimization algorithms.

Neural network architectures depend on transfer (activation) functions to operate — removing transfer functions from the mathematical framework means the architecture cannot compute transformations at neurons and stops functioning. Law 8 removal test passes: X as a concept of computational architecture literally requires transfer functions as its transformation mechanism.

Removal test: remove optimization algorithms and weight decay stops operating — it modifies parameter updates within an optimization step. Without an optimization algorithm as the operational context, weight decay is just a formula with nothing to apply to.

Removal test: remove optimization algorithms and gradient clipping stops operating — it constrains gradients before the parameter update step. Without the optimization algorithm to integrate into, gradient clipping has no operational context.

Removal test: remove neural network architecture and dropout stops operating — dropout is a technique that randomly deactivates neurons during training. Without a neural network architecture to apply it to, dropout has nothing to operate on.

toil is a specific kind of routine work: hands-on, repetitive, operational labor that tends to eat away at your time. A competent speaker calls toil 'a type of routine work.' The sense is Google SRE's definition of toil — routinized operational effort.
systematic-inspection is a specific kind of procedure: a methodical examination following a fixed method. A competent speaker calls it 'a systematic procedure.' Direction: specific→general, verified.

The concept of latent conditions arose from the practice of diagnosis — diagnosis existed first and fed into the notion of conditions that exist but are not yet apparent. Which came first? Diagnosis as a practice predates the abstract concept of latent conditions.

Common-cause failure IS the phenomenon where a single cause triggers failures in what redundancy was supposed to protect. The removal test: remove redundancy (independent backup paths), and common-cause failure loses all meaning — there are no independent paths to fail together. This is constitutive, not incidental: the concept exists precisely to identify the failure of redundancy assurance.

A symbolic system needs formalism (explicit rules for manipulating symbols) to operate. The removal test: remove formalism — symbolic systems become arbitrary marks without rules for interpretation or manipulation. Formalism provides the rule structure that makes symbolic systems operational: without it, there are symbols but no system.

A war room is a dedicated space or setup organized for collaborative problem-solving under pressure. Its designed purpose is to concentrate expertise and resources to solve difficult problems quickly — it exists for the sake of problem-solving. The servant points at the master: war room → problem-solving.

A symbolic system — mathematics, logic, formal languages — is designed and maintained to enable reasoning. Its primary purpose is to provide structured representations for manipulating ideas and drawing conclusions. The servant points at the master: symbolic system serves reasoning.

Direction test: training loop is the whole process, backpropagation is a structural sub-step (the backward pass). The training loop contains backpropagation as one of its constituent parts — like a book contains chapters (Law 10). If you remove backpropagation from a training loop, the loop stops operating as a learning system (forward pass only). Whole-part relationship, not dependency.

Learning rate is a parameter that only operates within the context of training. Remove training — the concept of learning rate ceases to function operationally. The learning rate specifies step size for parameter updates during training; without training there is nothing to parameterize. Constitutive dependency: learning rate is a dimension of training, not an independent concept.

A training loop is a specific kind of procedure: a structured sequence of steps repeated iteratively to adjust model parameters during machine learning training. A competent speaker would call a training loop 'a procedure.'
Digital twin as a practice derives from simulation technology: simulation existed first and its methods were applied to create live mirror models of physical systems.

Learning rate is a parameter whose operation is bound to optimization context. Remove optimization from the conceptual framework — learning rate ceases to function. The removal test passes: it stops operating.

DERIVED_FROM: training as a concept existed first; training loops are a specific implementation that came later. Historical chronology test passes — the general concept of training predates the specific construct of a training loop.

DEPENDS_ON: learning rate is a parameter whose operation is bound to optimization context. Remove optimization from the conceptual framework — learning rate ceases to function as a concept. The removal test passes.
DERIVED_FROM: learning rate schedules extend the learning rate concept by adding temporal variation. The learning rate concept existed first; scheduling is a later development applied to it.
CONTAINS (whole-and-part): a training loop contains backpropagation as a structural sub-step — the backward pass is literally part of the whole training process, just as a book contains chapters.

Removal test: remove the training loop and batch size ceases to operate — it is meaningless outside the iterative parameter-update structure that the training loop provides. Batch size specifies how samples are grouped within one iteration of the training loop. This is object-level, not meta-level (Law 2b).

Refraction as a concept (the map, per Law 2a) depends on optics for its operation. The scientific concept of refraction — light bending across media interfaces, described by Snell's law — only functions within the optical framework. Remove optics as a field of study and refraction as a scientific concept ceases to operate; it becomes merely a describable phenomenon without conceptual structure. The removal test passes at the object level for the concept, not the natural phenomenon.

Human error as a concept depends on cognition for its operation. It specifically designates failures in cognitive processing (misjudgment, inattention, faulty reasoning) — not physical accidents. Remove cognition from the conceptual framework and human error loses its distinguishing feature, collapsing into mere accident or malfunction. The removal test passes: the concept stops operating as a meaningful category without cognition to define what kind of error it is.

Removal test: remove computation and batch size ceases to operate — it is meaningless without a computational process to organize. Batch size specifies sample grouping within iterative computation; without computation there is no operational domain for the concept.

A cyber-physical system is built and maintained for the sake of automation — its designed purpose is to integrate computation with physical processes to enable automated control. The servant→master direction: CPS exists to serve automated operation of physical systems.

A lens is a specific kind of instrument — a device used to manipulate or examine light. A competent speaker would call a lens 'an instrument.' The lens manipulates light via refraction; as a manufactured artifact for optical manipulation, it is a kind of instrument.

The concept of a neural network architecture (how layers are organized and connected) derives from the concept of a neural network itself. Which came first: neural networks as a concept (1940s-50s) preceded the meta-concept of designing their architectures. You need the parent concept before you can design its structure. DERIVED_FROM test satisfied.

Batch size in ML training operates as the number of samples processed per iteration cycle. Remove iteration and batch size ceases to operate in its domain - it is meaningless without iterative processing.

A lens operates by bending light through refraction. Remove the concept of refraction and the lens loses its explanatory mechanism — it becomes just curved glass with no operational description. The removal test passes: without refraction, a lens as a scientific concept ceases to operate as designed.

Optics as a scientific discipline requires measurement tools and practices to operate. Remove measurement and optics loses its empirical foundation — it can't quantify light properties, calibrate instruments, or validate theories. The removal test holds: optics ceases to function as an empirical science without measurement.

Iteration is a specific kind of structured procedure: a cycle that repeats with state carried forward. A competent speaker calls iteration 'a procedure' (or 'a procedural pattern'). The sense is the algorithmic/operational one, not the mathematical limit sense.

Regression analysis as a method depends on statistical theory and practices to operate. Remove statistics and regression analysis loses its theoretical foundation — confidence intervals, p-values, assumptions checking all vanish. The removal test holds.

Mini-batch gradient descent is a specific kind of optimization algorithm. A competent speaker would call it an optimization method. It uses mini-batches to compute gradient estimates, which is one instance of the broader optimization algorithm pattern.
A training loop IS a specific kind of iterative procedure used in ML — a cycle that repeats with state carried forward (model parameters). A competent speaker calls it a kind of iteration.

Mini-batch gradient descent needs the concept of batch size to operate — it is defined by processing a batch of samples (not one or all). Remove batch size and the concept of mini-batch gradient descent ceases to function; it becomes just 'gradient descent' with no distinguishing mechanism.

One epoch is defined as one complete pass through the training loop. Remove the training loop and the concept of epochs ceases to operate — epochs has no referent without the iterative training structure it governs.

Mini-batch gradient descent is a method for minimizing a loss function using gradient estimates from mini-batches. Remove loss function — mini-batch gradient descent ceases to operate: it has no objective to optimize and no concept of gradient descent without a loss. The removal test passes.

Model capacity is the concept of how much a model can represent or learn. Remove the concept of a model — and model capacity ceases to operate entirely. The concept is constituted by the notion of a model; without it there is nothing to have capacity.

Batch size is a specific kind of hyperparameter in machine learning. A competent speaker calls batch size 'a hyperparameter.' It is set before training to control the number of samples per gradient update — fitting the general definition of a hyperparameter (a configuration set before the learning process begins).

A degradation model is a specific kind of model used to predict the decline of a system, component, or material over time. A competent speaker would call a degradation model 'a model' — it is a mathematical or conceptual representation of degradation dynamics.

Human-error as a concept requires understanding optical principles of perception and misperception. Remove optics and human-error as a concept cannot operate — it lacks the perceptual framework that defines what an error in observation or judgment is.

Human-error emerges from the tension between human limitation and systematic effort. Remove toil and human-error loses its operative context — the concept of error only arises against the backdrop of sustained work and effort. Human-error as a concept operates only within the domain toil establishes.

A degradation model operates by interpreting condition data to predict decline. Remove condition-based monitoring and the degradation model loses its data source and operational purpose — it cannot function without the condition assessment framework that drives it.

A stylus as an input device relies on optical sensing (optical tracking) for position detection in many implementations. Remove optics and optical styluses cease to operate — the positional tracking mechanism fails without the optical principles it depends on.

Degradation models are built and maintained for the sake of predictive maintenance. Their designed purpose is to forecast equipment decline so maintenance can be timed optimally (Law 8d: servant=degradation-model to master=predictive-maintenance).,

Reliability-centered maintenance is a maintenance methodology that depends on degradation models to predict when maintenance actions are needed. Remove degradation models and RCM loses its key predictive mechanism — it stops operating as RCM and reverts to time-based or reactive maintenance.

Reliability-centered maintenance as a practice depends on condition-based monitoring for its data source. Remove condition-based monitoring and RCM loses the condition data needed to schedule maintenance based on actual equipment state — it stops operating as RCM.

Degradation models are mathematical constructs (differential equations, statistical models, survival analysis curves) that predict system decline. Remove mathematics and degradation models cease to operate — they have no operative existence outside their mathematical formalism.
A washing machine IS a specific kind of appliance. Direction: washing machine (specific) → appliance (general). Law 9: specific→general.
A sensor IS a specific kind of instrument. Direction: sensor (specific) → instrument (general). Law 9: specific→general. A sensor is an instrument for measuring/detecting physical quantities.

Law 9: specific→general. A run chart is a specific kind of chart — a line chart of sequential data used to detect trends and shifts. A competent speaker would call a run chart 'a chart.' Direction: run chart (specific) → chart (general).

Statistical process control IS a specific kind of quality control method: it uses statistical techniques to monitor and control a process. A competent speaker would call SPC 'a quality control method.' Direction correct per Law 9.

Mini-batch gradient descent IS a specific kind of gradient descent algorithm: it computes gradients over subsets (batches) of training data rather than the full set or single samples. A competent speaker calls it 'a form of gradient descent.' Direction correct per Law 9.

Reliability-centered maintenance IS a specific kind of methodology — a systematic approach to determining maintenance needs. A competent speaker calls RCM 'a methodology.' Direction: specific → general. Law 9 satisfied.

Sensor fusion needs sensors to operate now — it literally combines data streams from multiple sensors. Remove sensors: sensor fusion has nothing to fuse and stops operating. Present-tense dependency, not mere association. Law 8 removal test passed.

A lens is a specific kind of optic — an optical element (typically curved transparent material) that refracts light. A competent speaker readily calls a lens 'an optic.' Direction: specific → general.

Acceptance sampling IS a specific kind of quality control method — a statistical procedure for deciding whether to accept or reject a batch based on inspecting a sample. A competent speaker calls acceptance sampling 'a quality control method.' Direction: specific → general.

Haptic feedback IS a specific kind of tool — an artifact (actuators + firmware) that extends human tactile capacity by rendering tactile data. A competent speaker would call it a tactile tool. An epoch consists of multiple iterations (mini-batch steps). One epoch = one full pass through the dataset, divided into iterations. Whole→part per Law 10.

A touchscreen is a specific kind of interface — an interactive display surface that enables direct manipulation as the primary means of user-machine communication. A competent speaker calls it a type of interface.
An x-bar chart is a specific kind of chart used in statistical process control. A competent speaker calls it a type of chart.

Haptic feedback is a specific kind of feedback — tactile sensory information conveyed through touch/pressure/vibration to communicate state or guide action. A competent speaker would say haptic feedback is a type of feedback.

The field of optics DERIVED_FROM science — the systematic study of light as a physical phenomenon emerged from scientific inquiry and natural philosophy. A network diagram is a specific kind of diagram that visualizes nodes and connections in a network topology. A competent speaker would call a network diagram a type of diagram.

A propensity score IS a specific kind of causal-inference technique — it estimates the probability of treatment assignment conditional on observed covariates, enabling causal effect estimation from observational data.

A capacitive stylus is a specific kind of stylus — it is a stylus designed for capacitive touchscreens using electrical mimicry rather than physical contact. A competent speaker would call it 'a type of stylus'.

Haptic feedback is designed and maintained for the sake of touchscreen interaction — providing tactile confirmation that enhances the user experience of touchscreens. Per Law 8d: the servant (haptic feedback) points at the master (touchscreen). The purpose is by design, not incidental benefit.

Gradient descent as an optimization algorithm is derived from the concept of the gradient. which-came-first test: the mathematical concept of the gradient (partial derivatives in multivariable calculus) predates gradient descent as an optimization method by decades. SHAP plots visualize feature importance scores — without feature importance as a concept, SHAP plots have nothing to display and cannot operate. The removal test: remove feature importance and shap plots cease to function.

feature importance serves shap plots in the sense that feature importance is the concept that shap plots are designed to visualize. For whose sake? The shap plot serves the display and understanding of feature importance.

Gesture-recognition depends on feature extraction: the process must first extract distinguishing features from raw sensory data before it can recognize patterns. Remove feature extraction and gesture-recognition cannot operate — it has no features to recognize.

SHAP plots are designed and maintained for the sake of feature importance: their purpose is to visualize, communicate, and make interpretable the importance scores of input features. For whose sake? A skeuomph is a specific kind of metaphor: it uses the appearance of one object to evoke the function or form of another (trash icon evokes wastebasket). User feedback is collected and analyzed for the sake of usability — its designed purpose is to inform design improvements. The removal test does not apply here: SERVES captures purpose (Law 8d), not operational need. For whose sake? Usability — user feedback serves that goal by design.

Data visualization is designed and maintained for the sake of communication — its purpose is to make information legible through visual encoding. Machine learning operates through statistical inference: parameter estimation, hypothesis testing, probability models, and optimization are all statistical methods. Remove statistics and ML has no mathematical foundation — it stops operating, not merely stopping being sayable. This is a constitutive dependency at the object level.

Underfitting is a specific kind of error in machine learning: a model that is too simple to capture the structure in data. Remove the concept of error and underfitting ceases to operate as a diagnostic category.

Standardized residuals require a regression model to operate — they are residuals scaled by the model's error structure. Remove regression and standardized residuals have no mathematical framework to function.

Partial regression plots visualize the contribution of individual predictors within a regression model. Remove regression and the plot has no framework to operate — it cannot be computed, interpreted, or displayed.

Underfitting is a diagnostic concept in statistical and machine learning modeling: the condition where a model is too simple to capture patterns in data. Remove statistics and underfitting has no framework to operate — it cannot be defined, measured, or diagnosed. The removal test passes.

Underfitting is the condition where a model is too simple to capture data patterns. Test (Law 8d): for whose sake? Intrinsic reward — internally generated satisfaction from an activity — is built/maintained for the sake of motivation. Overfitting is a specific kind of modeling error — the condition where a model captures noise rather than signal. A competent practitioner would call overfitting a kind of error, just as underfitting is one (already accepted by the court).

A skeuomorph is a specific kind of design pattern that incorporates design elements styled to look like materials and textures from earlier eras or technologies. 'A skeuomorph is a kind of design pattern' — the sense is visual metaphor in interface design (Law 11d).

Optics is a branch of science studying the behavior and properties of light. 'Optics is a kind of science' (Law 9). Science is the nearest accepted kind since physics is not yet an entry in the taxonomy.

A tolerance interval is a statistical confidence interval that estimates a range containing a specified proportion of a population with given confidence. A statistical model IS a specific kind of model: a mathematical representation of a real-world process built on statistical assumptions, fitted to data, and used for inference or prediction. 'A statistical model is a kind of model' — per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind.

Busywork is a specific kind of toil — it is purposeless or counterproductive work that consumes resources without generating value. Specific→general: busywork IS a form of toil.

Removal test: remove statistics (probability theory, inference, estimation) and overfitting ceases to operate — it loses its fitting procedure, error metrics, and the very notion of model generalization. A network diagram operates by visualizing nodes and edges as graph-theoretic structures. Remove graph theory (nodes, edges, paths, connectivity) and the diagram loses its structural vocabulary — it becomes decoration rather than a representation of relational structure.

A normal probability plot operates by comparing observed data against the normal probability distribution. A normal probability plot is a specific kind of probability plot — it plots observed data against a specific theoretical distribution (the normal/standard normal distribution). Network diagrams DERIVED_FROM graph theory — they are visual applications of graph-theoretic concepts (nodes, edges, paths). Graph theory existed first as the mathematical framework; network diagrams came later as a way to visualize those structures. Historical test: graph theory (18th century Euler) predates network diagrams (20th century).

Skeuomorphs DERIVED_FROM nostalgia — the design approach of making new objects resemble older materials/technologies was inspired by the human emotional response to nostalgia. Historical: nostalgia as a concept predates modern skeuomorphic design.

Remove graph theory and network diagram stops operating — its entire purpose is to visualize graph-theoretic constructs (nodes, edges, paths, topology). Without the framework of graph theory, a network diagram is just a random drawing of dots and lines. This is operational dependency, not just historical association.
Pipeline is designed and maintained for the sake of data processing — its entire purpose is to channel data through sequential stages. Servant→master: pipeline serves data processing.
A spider plot IS a specific kind of data visualization method — it displays multivariate data visually using a radial layout.
A quantile-quantile plot IS a specific kind of probability plot — it compares two probability distributions by plotting their quantiles against each other.

A network diagram IS a specific kind of graph-theoretic visualization — it represents entities as nodes and relationships as edges, directly applying the mathematical abstractions of graph theory. Direction: specific→general.
A pipeline IS a specific kind of workflow — a linear chain of processing stages where data or state flows sequentially through each stage. Direction: specific→general.

A component-plus-residual plot IS a specific kind of residual plot used in regression diagnostics. It displays the relationship between a response variable and a predictor, adding the predictor's linear effect. Direction: specific→general. Law 9.

Network diagrams DERIVED_FROM graph theory — they are visual applications of graph-theoretic concepts (nodes, edges, paths) to represent relationships. Graph theory existed first as the mathematical foundation, and network diagrams were later built from it.

Bayesian inference is a statistical framework that grew out of probability theory. Which-came-first: probability theory predates Bayesian methods.
Probability theory existed first and provided the mathematical foundation for prediction intervals.

A prediction interval is computed from a fitted statistical model. Remove the statistical model and the prediction interval ceases to operate — it has no mechanism for computing its range without model parameters and error estimates.

A skeuomorph is a specific kind of icon: it uses the visual appearance of one object to evoke the function or form of another (e.g. a digital trash can icon). The note pins the visual-icon sense, not the abstract-reference sense.
Skeuomorph design derives from craft: the practice of making new objects resemble older, handcrafted materials/technologies. Craft existed first and fed the aesthetic that skeuomorph evokes.
Data cleaning is a specific kind of quality control practice applied to datasets. As a quality assurance technique for data, it IS a subcategory of quality control.

Standardized mean difference is derived from statistics: the concept of standardizing a difference using statistical parameters (standard deviation). Statistics as a discipline existed first and provided the tools SMD uses.

A component-plus-residual plot (also called a partial residual plot) is a regression diagnostic tool that derives from regression analysis. Regression as a statistical method existed first and fed into the development of diagnostic visualization techniques. The plot shows the relationship between a predictor and the response AFTER accounting for other predictors in the regression model — it is a derivative visualization built on the regression framework.

An influential observation is identified through statistical computation: Cook's distance, DFBETAS, leverage values, and other diagnostic statistics. Remove the statistical framework and the influential observation concept has no mechanism to operate — its entire working definition depends on statistical formulas to identify and quantify influence. Remove the statistical model and hypothesis testing stops operating — you need a model to specify the sampling distribution under H₀, compute the test statistic, and derive the p-value. The model is the operational engine of the test procedure, not just a historical association.

Influential observations are defined by their effect on regression models (Cook's distance, DFBETAS measure impact on regression coefficients). Remove regression and the concept of influential observation ceases to operate.

The Durbin-Watson test is a specific statistical test used to detect autocorrelation in regression residuals. It follows the standard test structure: null hypothesis of no autocorrelation, a specific test statistic (DW statistic), known sampling distribution under H0, p-value computation, and decision rule based on significance level. A competent speaker would call it a statistical test.

Omitted variable bias arose from regression analysis — when relevant variables are excluded from a regression model, coefficient estimates become biased. The concept emerged from the practice of regression modeling.

The Breusch-Pagan test is a specific kind of statistical test used to detect heteroscedasticity in regression residuals. It follows the standard structure: null hypothesis of homoscedasticity, a chi-squared test statistic, and a decision rule. A competent speaker would call it 'a statistical test.' Specific→general.

Model capacity is the measure of a model's representational power — how many functions it can express. This concept only operates within the framework of statistical modeling. Remove statistics and model capacity has no operational meaning: the concept is defined by statistical degrees of freedom, VC dimension, parameter count, and other statistical constructs. The removal test passes: without statistics, model capacity ceases to operate as a meaningful concept.

Generalization error measures how a model performs on unseen data relative to training data. Remove training data and the concept ceases to operate — there is no training set to compare against. Operational dependency, not sayability.

Robust statistics is built for the sake of inference — its designed purpose is to enable reliable statistical inference when standard assumptions fail. Servant→master: robust statistics points at inference.
Bootstrap is a specific kind of resampling method. The specific points at the general: bootstrap INSTANCE_OF resampling. Direction tested — bootstrap is a subcategory, not the parent.
Diagnostic plots are built for the sake of regression — they are designed to check regression assumptions, detect outliers, and evaluate model fit. Servant→master direction correct.

Remove measurement as a concept and bootstrap loses its purpose — bootstrap estimates the sampling distribution of a statistic, which only exists as a property of the measurement process. The removal test passes: bootstrap cannot operate without the concept of measurement.

Measurement error is a specific kind of error — the difference between a measured value and the true value. A competent speaker would call measurement error 'a type of error'. Direction: measurement error (specific) → error (general).

Residual analysis requires statistical models to operate: it examines the differences between observed and model-predicted values. Remove statistical models and residual analysis has nothing to analyze — no residuals can be computed without a model making predictions.

Measurement error as a formal concept grew out of statistical practice: statisticians needed to quantify how observations deviate from expected values. Statistics existed first and fed into the development of measurement error theory.

Model capacity (the representational power of a model) operates within statistical frameworks — it quantifies how well a model class can approximate functions. Removing statistical modeling eliminates the concept of model capacity. X needs Y to operate now.

Measurement error quantifies the difference between observed and true values — it operates entirely within the practice of measurement. Remove measurement and measurement error has nothing to operate on. The removal test at Law 8 is satisfied.

Few-shot learning needs training data to operate — even with very limited examples, the learning process requires training data to adjust model parameters. Remove training data and few-shot learning stops functioning.

Early stopping operates by comparing validation loss across epochs and halting training when it stops improving. Remove validation metrics and early stopping as a training practice stops functioning — there is no signal to act on. Removal test passes.
Model compression techniques operate on machine learning models to reduce their size. Remove machine learning and model compression has no target to operate on — it stops functioning.
Learning rate schedules control the learning rate for an optimizer. Remove the optimizer and the schedule has nothing to act on — it stops functioning. The removal test passes.

Transfer functions use mathematical formalism (Laplace transforms, differential equations) to map system inputs to outputs. Remove mathematics and transfer functions have no language or formalism — they stop operating as analytical tools. Present-tense dependency, not historical.

Optics as a practical discipline (designing instruments, building systems) depends on lenses to operate — telescopes, microscopes, cameras, spectrometers all require lenses. Remove lenses and optics stops functioning as an applied practice.

gesture-recognition is a specific kind of technology — a human-made system for detecting and interpreting body movements. A competent speaker would call gesture recognition 'a technology' (e.g., 'gesture recognition technology'). The removal test does not apply to INSTANCE_OF.

Model capacity measures the complexity a model can represent — it is a specific kind of metric. A competent speaker would call capacity 'a metric.' Direction: specific (model capacity) → general (metric).

which-kind test: model capacity is a specific kind of metric — it measures the representational complexity a model class can achieve. Direction specific→general is correct. A competent speaker calls capacity 'a metric.'

curriculum learning is built and maintained for the sake of training — its designed purpose is to improve the training process by ordering examples for optimal learning. SERVES direction: servant (curriculum learning) → master (training). For whose sake? Training.

which-came-first: optimization as a general field of study predates the specific concept of optimization landscape (the mapping of objective-function values across parameter space). The landscape concept was built on top of the prior concept of optimization. DERIVED_FROM direction is correct.

Intrinsic reward is a specific kind of motivation — it is self-driven, internally generated motivation for an activity. A competent speaker would call intrinsic reward 'a motivation.' The sense is psychological: intrinsic reward as a motivational force, not the reward object itself.

Weight-sharing — sharing the same parameters across different parts of a network — is a specific computational technique built on the general concept of computation. Computation existed first and fed into the design of weight-sharing as a computational optimization.

which-came-first-existed-and-fed-into: measurement (assigning numerical values to observations) predates quantization (converting continuous values to discrete levels) as a practice. One must first have measurement to quantify measured values. Quantization as a technique for discretizing measurement data was derived from the prior concept of measurement.
Removal test: remove transformer architecture and kv-cache has nothing to operate on — it stops functioning entirely. kv-cache is a mechanism that exists only within the transformer inference loop.

Removal test: remove neural networks and weight-sharing has nothing to weight-share — it stops operating. Weight-sharing is a parameter-sharing mechanism that operates exclusively within neural network training.

retrieval needs search to operate now — the removal test: remove search and retrieval has no mechanism to find and extract information from stored data. Search provides the operational engine for retrieval; without it, retrieval is just storage with no access mechanism.
search-engine needs search to operate now — the removal test: remove search and the search-engine has no function. Search is the operational core that the search-engine builds upon.

kv-cache is built and maintained for the sake of inference: it caches key-value pairs during transformer inference to avoid redundant computation, directly serving the goal of efficient inference. Its entire design purpose is to accelerate the forward pass — the servant (kv-cache) points at the master (inference).

Which-came-first: optimization (the mathematical practice of finding best solutions) predates weight-sharing (a neural network technique emerging in the 1980s). Weight-sharing is a specialized optimization strategy — sharing parameters to reduce model complexity and overfitting — built on the ancient mathematical tradition of optimization. Optimization existed first and fed into weight-sharing.

kv-cache IS a specific kind of data structure: it stores key-value pairs for efficient lookup during autoregressive generation. A competent speaker would call a kv-cache 'a data structure.' The nearest kind is data structure, which is already ACCEPTED.

quantization IS a specific kind of algorithm: it converts continuous values to discrete levels using a defined procedure. A competent speaker would call quantization 'an algorithm' or 'an algorithmic technique.' Algorithm is the nearest accepted kind.

which-came-first-existed-and-fed-into: model architecture as a design practice predates weight-sharing as a specific neural network technique. Weight-sharing emerged as an optimization technique within the broader practice of designing neural network architectures. The architectural design patterns (CNNs, etc.) that use weight-sharing came from the general practice of model architecture.

Quantization is built and maintained for the sake of model compression: in ML it reduces precision of model parameters to shrink model size and speed up inference. Its designed purpose in the ML context is to compress models while preserving acceptable accuracy.

Weight sharing is maintained for the sake of regularization: in neural networks it reduces the effective number of parameters, constraining model capacity and preventing overfitting. Its purpose is to act as a regularization mechanism.

Dropout is built and maintained for the sake of regularization: randomly dropping neurons during training reduces co-adaptation and prevents overfitting. Its designed purpose is to serve as a regularization mechanism.

backpropagation SERVES neural network training: the algorithm exists and is maintained for the sake of training neural networks. Its designed purpose is computing gradients through neural network computational graphs so that network weights can be updated. Remove neural networks as the target and backpropagation loses its entire reason for being — it is the servant algorithm whose master is the neural network training process.

dropout SERVES neural network training: dropout is maintained for the sake of improving neural network training. Its designed purpose is to reduce overfitting during training by randomly deactivating neurons, which serves the broader goal of producing better-trained neural networks. The servant (dropout) points at the master (neural network).
which-came-first-existed-and-fed-into: the laptop concept existed before macbook air as a product line. Apple's MacBook Air derives from and extends the broader laptop category.

Reranking is designed and maintained for the sake of improving retrieval quality. Its entire purpose is to take the output of an initial retrieval and reorder it for better relevance — the servant (reranking) points at the master (retrieval). Removal test: without reranking, retrieval still operates but with lower precision; reranking exists specifically to serve better retrieval outcomes.

Removal test: remove law and marriage as an institution stops operating — it requires legal frameworks, registration, and enforcement to function as a social institution. This is not merely sayable (Law 2b): the institution's operation collapses without legal infrastructure. Identity is not dependency (Law 8c): law is not what marriage IS but what it NEEDS to operate.

which-came-first-existed-and-fed-into: attention mechanism (Bahdanau 2015) predates and conceptually feeds self-attention (Vaswani et al. 2017). Self-attention is the specific case where keys, queries, and values all come from the same sequence. The general attention concept existed first and fed into the self-attention variant.

which-came-first-existed-and-fed-into: statistical theory (Fisher, Neyman-Pearson 1920s-30s) predates the specific formalism of hypothesis testing. Hypothesis testing as a method is derived from the broader mathematical framework of statistics. The statistical theory existed first and fed into the hypothesis testing procedure.

Removal test: remove retrieval and reranking stops operating — it has no candidate set to reorder. Reranking is a post-processing step that operates on retrieval output; without retrieval as input, the reranking function has no purpose and no data to process. This is constitutive at the operational level, not merely sayable.

Walls are built and maintained for the sake of security — their designed purpose is to provide protection, boundary, and defense. This is a genuine teleological relation (Law 8d): the servant (wall) points at the master (security). Not incidental benefit but by design.

Marriage as a social institution is built and maintained for the sake of family — its designed purpose is to create, recognize, and regulate family relationships. The servant (marriage) points at the master (family). This is teleology (Law 8d), not dependency: marriage serves the purpose of family formation, even though family can exist without formal marriage.

Nursing is a practice built and maintained for the sake of care — its designed purpose is to provide and coordinate care for patients. The servant (nursing) points at the master (care). This is genuine teleology (Law 8d): nursing exists to further care, not the other way around.

The human-made concept of seasons serves agriculture by providing the temporal structure within which agricultural planning, planting, and harvesting cycles are organized. Seasons as a MAP (Law 2a) of natural cycles serves the practical purpose of agricultural timing and coordination.

an alphabet is a specific kind of writing system (script) — one where graphemes map to phonemes rather than syllables or morphemes. A competent speaker would call an alphabet a type of script. This is the nearest kind: alphabet → script (no intermediate rung in the ladder).

season IS a specific kind of calendar division (Law 9). A competent speaker would call a season 'a calendar period.' Season is a division of the calendar, a specific kind of time-block within the calendar structure. Direction: specific→general.

reranking IS a specific kind of algorithm (Law 9). A competent speaker would call reranking 'an algorithm' — it is a computational procedure that re-orders ranked results. Direction: specific→general. Not a leap: reranking is a well-known algorithm in information retrieval.

A gate is built and maintained for access control and security — its designed purpose is to restrict or permit passage, serving the security function. For whose sake? The gate serves security, not the reverse. SERVES (Law 8d): by-design purpose, not mere association.

Gate extends human access-control capacity — an artifact built to perform a function (Law 11c). A competent speaker accepts 'a gate is a tool' in the kingdom's broad sense: any artifact that extends a human capacity qualifies as a tool, including passive artifacts like shelves and gates.

Seasons are organized and maintained for the sake of agricultural planning — planting, growing, and harvesting cycles depend on seasonal markers. For whose sake? Agriculture is the master; seasons are the servant.

Surrender is a mechanism built and maintained for the sake of resolving conflicts — it terminates hostilities and opens pathways to negotiated outcomes. For whose sake? Conflict-resolution is the master; surrender is the servant.

A hypothesis test is a specific kind of statistical test. The hypothesis test uses statistical methods to evaluate a null hypothesis, making it a specialized case of the broader statistical test concept.

Autocorrelation detection serves hypothesis testing in time-series analysis — it is used as a diagnostic tool within the hypothesis testing workflow to validate assumptions about error independence. For whose sake? Hypothesis test is the master; autocorrelation analysis is the servant.

Alphabet is a human-made system of written symbols built and maintained for the purpose of writing. Its designed function is to represent language graphically. For whose sake? Writing is the master; the alphabet is the servant.

Proof is a human-made epistemic practice built for the purpose of establishing truth within mathematics. Its designed function is to provide rigorous justification for mathematical claims. For whose sake? Mathematics is the master; proof is the servant.

Persuasion is a specific kind of influence — it is a method of exerting influence through reasoned argument rather than force or coercion. A competent speaker would say 'persuasion is a kind of influence.' Per Law 9, specific→general.

Caching as a practice stops operating without memory — the mechanism of storing information temporarily for faster access requires memory as its substrate. Remove memory and there is nothing to cache. Removal test: X=memory, does caching stop operating? Yes.

License IS a specific kind of document — an official written authorization granted by an authority. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would say 'a license is a kind of document.' The note tests direction: specific (license) → general (document).
Canticle IS a specific kind of song — a sacred or hymn-like song with religious purpose. Per Law 9: 'a competent speaker would say a canticle is a kind of song.' Specific (canticle) → general (song).

Caching is a specific kind of optimization technique — it optimizes access patterns by storing frequently-used data in faster storage. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call caching a kind of optimization.

lossy-compression IS a specific kind of compression. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call lossy-compression 'a kind of compression' — it compresses by discarding data, distinguishing it from lossless compression. The nearest accepted kind is 'compression' itself.

The removal test: in-context learning operates on a model's fixed weights after training. Remove training — the model has no learned representations and cannot perform in-context learning. The training establishes the representational capacity that makes the mechanism work.

Alignment research is designed for the sake of ensuring AI systems conform to human ethical standards. Per Law 8d: the servant (alignment) points at the master (ethics). The purpose of alignment is to serve ethical constraints on AI behavior.

Empathy (the capacity to understand/feel another's emotional state) predates and underlies compassion. Compassion adds the motivational component — the desire to alleviate suffering — building on the foundation of empathy. Chronological test: empathy=0.06, compassion=0.06, but empathy is the more foundational concept that compassion extends.

Canticles are religious hymns and songs composed specifically for worship. Their designed purpose is to serve religious practice — providing liturgical text and musical devotion. Per Law 8d: servant (canticle) points at master (religion). Genuine designed-purpose, not incidental benefit.

Compassion is maintained and cultivated for the sake of conflict-resolution — it de-escalates hostility and enables reconciliation. Per Law 8d: the servant (compassion) points at the master (conflict-resolution). Unlike my failed season→agriculture (seasons serve many purposes beyond agriculture), compassion's social function is specifically to resolve and prevent conflict through empathy-driven motivation to alleviate suffering.

Formal verification IS a specific kind of verification — it uses mathematical proof and logical reasoning rather than testing or experimentation to establish correctness. 'Formal verification is a kind of verification such that a competent speaker would call it a verification.'
A song IS a specific kind of music — a musical composition with vocal parts. 'A song is a kind of music' — a competent speaker would call a song a type of music.

Remove mathematics now and formal verification stops operating — it uses mathematical proof as its constitutive mechanism. This is object-level, not meta-level: formal verification IS mathematical reasoning applied to program/state correctness. The removal test passes.

Remove memory (the model's ability to retain and use context information) and in-context learning stops operating — it literally works by using the model's context window as working memory to learn from examples. Object-level dependency per Law 8.

Few-shot learning is a specific kind of in-context learning — it uses a small number of examples within the context window to learn a new task. A competent speaker calls few-shot learning a type of in-context learning. Nearest kind check: few-shot learning IS a form of in-context learning.

Attention mechanisms (Vaswani et al., 2014) existed first and fed into the discovery of in-context learning (showed in GPT-3, 2020). ICL is a phenomenon enabled by the attention architecture — without attention, there is no in-context learning. Chronological test: attention predates ICL.

Alignment is built and maintained for the sake of safety-engineering — its designed purpose is to ensure AI systems operate within safe, intended behavioral boundaries. Safety engineering defines the parameters that alignment seeks to satisfy. Per Law 8d: the servant (alignment) points at the master (safety-engineering).

Reinforcement learning (1980s-90s, Sutton/Barto) predated and fed into AI alignment as a field. Alignment work builds on RL frameworks — reward signals, policy optimization, value functions — to achieve desired behavior. Per Law 7: Y (RL) existed first and fed into X (alignment).

Function calling is a specific kind of prompt engineering — it is a structured prompting technique where the prompt is designed to elicit JSON output specifying function names and arguments from an LM. A competent speaker calls it 'a type of prompt engineering technique.' Per Law 9, specific→general.

Schema (structured format/specification for data) existed long before function calling in language models. The concept of a schema fed into function calling as a construct: function calling is essentially schema-defined tool specifications passed through a language model. Chronological and conceptual lineage is clear.

Curriculum learning is a training strategy that organizes the order of training examples to improve learning efficiency. Remove training and curriculum learning stops operating — it is a method OF training. The removal test passes.

Stochastic gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that uses gradient estimates to update model parameters. Remove gradient and SGD stops operating — it literally computes and follows gradients. The removal test passes.

Information theory (Shannon, 1948) existed first and conceptually fed into lossy compression. Rate-distortion theory — the mathematical foundation of lossy compression — is a direct result of information theory. Which-came-first: information theory first, lossy compression is the applied construct.

Consecration is a ritual performed for the sake of designating an object as a relic — its entire purpose is to transform an ordinary object into a sacred relic. The ritual exists to serve the creation and recognition of relics.

Function calling is a specific kind of prompting technique: the prompt defines available functions and instructs the model to output structured function invocations. A competent speaker would call function calling 'a kind of prompting.' Nearest kind check: no intermediate category between function calling and prompting — it is directly a sub-type of prompting.

Metacognition (thinking about thinking) predates and is more general than self-reflection. Self-reflection is a specific form of metacognition directed at one's own cognitive processes. Which-came-first test: metacognition as a psychological concept was formalized by Flavell (1970s), and self-reflection is a narrower practice within that domain. Y existed first and fed into X.

Self-reflection IS a specific kind of metacognition — metacognition is thinking about thinking in general; self-reflection is metacognition directed specifically at one's own cognitive processes and outputs. Per Law 9, specific→general: a competent speaker would call self-reflection 'a kind of metacognition.' Files against nearest accepted kind (metacognition already exists and is ACCEPTED).

Technology-transfer is designed and maintained for the sake of education — its purpose is to transmit technical knowledge and capabilities to learners. Per Law 8d, for-whose-sake test: servant (technology-transfer) points at master (education). This is a teleological relationship, not a dependency — technology-transfer doesn't require education to operate, but education is one of its designed purposes.

Introspection (the general practice of looking inward at one's own mental state) predates and is more general than self-reflection (the specific practice of examining one's own cognitive processes and outputs). Which-came-first test: introspection as a practice is ancient (philosophical traditions), while self-reflection as a cognitive science term is 20th century. Derivation is directional: general→specific.

A season IS a specific kind of calendar division. Calendar structures time into year→season→month→week→day; season is a named subdivision of the year within that system. A competent speaker would call a season 'a kind of calendar unit.' Law 9, specific→general.

Consecration is a ritual act performed for the sake of the ritual system it belongs to — it exists to designate sacred objects within ritual practice. Per Law 8d: the servant (consecration) points at the master (ritual). The ritual exists to further ritual practice as a whole, not the reverse.

Structural equation modeling is a statistical technique for analyzing relationships between latent and observed variables. Statistics (as a discipline of data analysis) predates SEM, which was developed by Sewall Wright in the 1920s as an extension of statistical methods. Statistics existed first and fed into SEM.

Curriculum learning is a training strategy that presents samples in a meaningful order. Machine learning as a field predates curriculum learning — the concept was proposed by Bengio et al. in 2009, building on decades of ML research. ML existed first and fed into curriculum learning.

Computational complexity theory studies the resources (time, space) required by algorithms. Algorithms (as abstract computational procedures) predate complexity theory by centuries — Euclid's algorithm predates complexity analysis by millennia. Complexity theory was formalized by Turing (1936) and Blum (1967). Algorithm existed first and fed into computational complexity.

structural equation model IS a specific kind of statistical method. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call SEM 'a statistical method.' Statistical method is the nearest general kind — a formalized procedure for analyzing data, estimating parameters, and testing hypotheses. SEM is a multivariate technique for specifying and testing hypothesized relationships among variables.

The concept of metacognition (formal study of one's own cognitive processes) was developed as a formalization of the older, broader concept of self-reflection. Flavell coined 'metacognition' in the 1970s, building on the long-standing practice of self-reflection. Which-came-first: self-reflection as a concept predates metacognition by centuries.
An offering is a specific kind of ritual act — a competent speaker would call an offering 'a ritual' (ritual act). Per Law 9, INSTANCE_OF against nearest kind (ritual) is correct.

SEM operates by specifying and estimating relationships among latent constructs. Remove the concept of latent variables and SEM ceases to operate — it has no target constructs for its measurement and structural models. This passes the removal test (Law 8): not merely sayability loss but operational collapse.

Documentation (the practice of recording and sharing knowledge) predates technology transfer by millennia — writing systems enabled the first knowledge transfers across time and space. Modern technology transfer formalized this ancient practice of documenting how things work and systematically sharing that documentation with new users and contexts.

Amnesty is a specific kind of pardon — a blanket pardon granted to a group rather than an individual. Per Law 9, a competent speaker would call amnesty a type of pardon, making this INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind (pardon).

Prayer operates by communicating with a deity or spiritual entity believed to exist. Remove the concept of belief and prayer as a practice has no target, no framework, and ceases to operate as a meaningful act.

Measurement model operates by specifying the relationship between latent constructs and their observed indicators. Remove the concept of latent variables and the measurement model ceases to operate — it has no constructs to measure. The removal test (Law 8) passes.

Sacrifice is built and maintained for the sake of religion — its designed purpose is to further religious practice (propitiation, devotion, communion with the divine). Per Law 8d, the servant (sacrifice) points at the master (religion). Filing SERVES, not DEPENDS_ON: sacrifice's purpose is religious service.

Technology-transfer requires communication channels to operate — the transfer of knowledge, skills, or methods between entities cannot occur without some form of communication. The removal test passes: remove communication, and technology-transfer ceases to function. This is a present-tense operational dependency, not merely historical association.

Right is a specific kind of justice — a legal/moral construct that embodies fairness in a particular case or domain. Per Law 9, 'right is a specific kind of justice' files INSTANCE_OF. The entry's scope places it in the legal/moral domain.

Epoch is a specific kind of chronology — a defined period of time set as a reference point in historical or scientific record-keeping. Per Law 9, 'epoch is a specific kind of chronological unit' files INSTANCE_OF.

Season is a specific kind of classification — the human-made categorization of the year into distinct periods based on climate, weather, and biological cycles. Per Law 9, 'season is a specific kind of temporal classification' files INSTANCE_OF. The entry (per Law 2a) names the map, not the natural phenomenon.

Technology-transfer is a specific kind of knowledge-management — the structured process of moving knowledge, skills, and methods between entities. Per Law 9, this is a kind-of relationship. Technology-transfer IS knowledge management specialized for technological domain knowledge.

A measurement model is designed to make variables measurable for data-analysis — its purpose is to establish operational definitions so data-analysis can proceed. Per Law 8d: measurement-model exists FOR THE SAKE of enabling data-analysis. Removal test is irrelevant for SERVES; the purpose test shows design intent: without measurement models, data-analysis lacks operationalized variables.

Phenology is maintained as a scientific discipline FOR THE SAKE of agricultural planning — its practical output (predictive models of planting, flowering, and harvest timing) directly serves agricultural decision-making. Per Law 8d: the designed purpose of applied phenology is to further agriculture's operations. This differs from rejected 'season→agriculture': seasons are observed natural cycles, while phenology is a constructed scientific tool whose entire practical reason for existing is to serve agriculture and ecology.

Law 8 removal test: remove variables — can a measurement model still operate? No. A measurement model's entire function is to specify how variables are quantified; without variables there is nothing to measure. Present-tense operating dependency.

Law 10: documentation is a literal part inside the whole of technology transfer. Tech transfer involves creating, transmitting, and storing documentation as knowledge artifacts — it is not merely related to documentation; documentation is a constituent component of the process.

Law 7 which-came-first test: mathematics predates formalization by millennia. The practice of formalization was pioneered within mathematics (Frege's Begriffsschrift, Hilbert's program, Russell-Whitehead's Principia) and later extended to logic, computer science, and other domains. Mathematics existed first and fed into formalization as a practice.

measurement-model IS a specific kind of model — namely, a model that specifies how variables in a domain are quantified and related. A competent speaker would call a measurement model 'a type of model.' Nearest kind: model (not a leap, not subsumed).

Law 8d: right is maintained FOR THE SAKE of justice. Rights are the mechanisms by which justice operates in practice — they define what individuals are owed and what conduct is owed to them. The teleological direction is correct: right is the servant, justice is the master.

Which-came-first: abstraction as a general cognitive/philosophical technique (selecting relevant features while ignoring others) predates formalization by millennia. Formalization is a specific, structured application of abstraction using formal languages — mathematical notation, logical symbols, programming languages. Abstraction existed first and fed into formalization as a specialized technique.

Which-came-first: abstraction as a general cognitive operation (selecting relevant features, ignoring details) predates the specific construct of schema. Schema is a structured, organized abstraction — a mental framework built from abstraction. Abstraction existed first and schema is a specialized form of it.
Epidemiology IS a specific kind of science — it applies scientific method to population health. A competent speaker would call epidemiology 'a science.' Nearest kind: science. Law 9.

Phenology IS a specific kind of science — the study of periodic biological events and how they are influenced by climate and environment. A competent speaker would call phenology 'a science.' Nearest kind: science.

Latent variables are unobserved constructs inferred through measurement models. Remove measurement-model — latent variables have no operationalization mechanism and stop operating as usable concepts. Per Law 8 removal test.

Measurement models are a specific formalization of the relationship between observed and latent variables. Which-came-first: formalization as a general practice predates specific measurement models by millennia. Formalization fed into measurement-model. Per Law 7.

formalization SERVES communication (Law 8d). Formalization — structured notation with explicit rules — is built and maintained for the sake of clear, precise communication. Its designed purpose is to eliminate ambiguity and enable unambiguous transmission of meaning. The servant (formalization) points at the master (communication).

Declarative memory needs memory to operate now — it is a specific functional system within the broader memory infrastructure. Remove memory as a cognitive capacity and declarative memory ceases to function. The removal test per Law 8 passes.

Episodic memory IS a specific kind of declarative memory — it stores autobiographical events with temporal context. A competent speaker would call episodic memory a type of declarative memory. Nearest kind: declarative-memory. Law 9.

Citizen as a legal status requires law to operate — remove the legal framework and citizenship ceases to function. The removal test per Law 8 passes. Citizenship is not just a social role but a juridical one.

Chronicles organize events through temporal sequence — remove time as an organizing concept and chronicles lose their structure. The removal test per Law 8 passes. Temporal ordering is constitutive of chronicle as a form.
