Phenology studies periodic biological events keyed to seasonal cycles — remove seasons as the organizing framework and phenology loses its primary structure. The removal test per Law 8 passes.

Solstice marks a specific position within the seasonal cycle — remove the concept of seasons and solstice loses its meaning. The removal test per Law 8 passes. Solstices are seasonal reference points.

Experience as a concept (accumulated knowledge through direct involvement) predates empiricism as a formal epistemological framework. Empiricism systematized what experience alone provides informally. The which-came-first test: experience concepts existed long before the term 'empiricism' was coined for the philosophy.

Empiricism needs measurement to operate now — without systematic measurement, empirical knowledge lacks quantifiable rigor and reproducibility. Measurement extends raw sensory observation into reliable data. Remove measurement and empiricism collapses to mere anecdote. Object-level operational dependency.

Automaticity is the process by which skills become automatic through practice; it exists to serve skill acquisition by converting conscious effort into efficient performance. The designed purpose of automaticity is to further the completion of skill acquisition.

Predictive models existed before unsupervised learning as a formal ML paradigm. Unsupervised learning derived from the general concept of predictive modeling, then specialized to prediction without labels. Chronological: predictive models → unsupervised learning.

clan is a specific kind of family-based social unit: a group whose identity derives from actual or perceived kinship ties. The specific→general test: a clan is a family structure organized around kinship. Files against the nearest kind (family), not a more distant category.

Epidemiology needs statistics to operate: statistical methods are constitutive of its analytical operation (disease rate calculation, confidence intervals, regression models). Remove statistics and epidemiology's diagnostic methods cease to function — this is not a meta-level or sayability claim. Law 8b removal test passes.

epoch is a specific kind of time division: a distinct period marked by particular characteristics or events. The specific→general test: an epoch is a type of temporal division. Files against the nearest kind (time).

Curiosity exists for the sake of learning: its designed purpose is to drive information-seeking behavior, which is the motivational engine of learning. The removal test at object level — remove curiosity and learning loses its primary intrinsic motivator, becoming purely extrinsically driven. SERVES is correct: the servant (curiosity) points at the master (learning).

Gratitude is the emotional mechanism that reinforces reciprocal exchange: it motivates repayment, signals reliability as a cooperation partner, and sustains reciprocal relationships. Its designed function is to maintain reciprocity — the servant (gratitude) points at the master (reciprocity).

Empiricism is the epistemological framework that serves science: its designed purpose is to provide the methodological principle (sensory experience and experimentation as primary knowledge sources) that science operates by. The servant (empiricism) points at the master (science).
Kin is a specific kind of family relationship: the state of being related by blood or marriage. A competent speaker would call kin a family relation (Law 9).
A tribe is a specific kind of community: a social group sharing territory, culture, and often lineage. The specific→general test passes (Law 9).

Love is maintained for the sake of family cohesion: it bonds partners, strengthens parent-child ties, and sustains the emotional infrastructure of family life. Proper SERVES edge — designed purpose is to further family operation (Law 8d).

Semantic search operates by converting text into vector representations (embeddings) and comparing distances in that space. Remove embeddings and semantic search has no mechanism to operate — it literally cannot function without vector representations of text.

Zero-shot learning depends on meta-learning: it requires the model to learn HOW to generalize across unseen classes — the core challenge of meta-learning. Remove meta-learning principles (learning to learn, task-agnostic strategies) and zero-shot learning has no mechanism to function. The removal test passes.

Generative models (GANs, VAEs, diffusion models, transformers) depend on neural networks as their computational substrate. Remove neural networks and these generative architectures cannot operate. Not all generative models are neural (e.g. HMMs), but modern generative models in the frontier context are neural — the note pins this sense.
Epidemiology is maintained for the sake of medicine — its purpose is to identify disease patterns and inform clinical and public health practice.
A forge is maintained for the sake of metallurgy — its designed purpose is to heat metal to workable temperatures for shaping and treatment.
Mechanical advantage is maintained for the sake of engineering — its purpose is to quantify force multiplication in machine design, enabling engineers to size mechanisms and predict performance.

Leverage as a metaphorical concept (applying force advantage to non-physical domains) derives from the mechanical concept of lever. Which-came-first: lever (ancient simple machine) predates leverage (metaphorical extension, 16th century onward).

Envy as an emotion derives from comparison — the act of comparing oneself to others. Which-came-first: comparison as a cognitive practice predates envy as a named emotional category; the comparison concept is the generative mechanism that feeds into the emotion.

Probabilistic reasoning needs probability theory to operate now — it draws conclusions by assigning and manipulating numerical degrees of belief according to probability theory axioms. Remove probability theory's axiomatic framework and probabilistic reasoning has no formal basis to operate.

Fulcrum as a mechanical concept is defined as the pivot point about which a lever rotates. Remove the lever concept, and the fulcrum concept as defined (a lever-specific pivot) loses its operational meaning. The dependency is constitutive: fulcrum derives its identity from its role in the lever system.

Genealogy as a practice of tracing family relationships depends on the concept of kinship to operate. Remove kinship as a conceptual framework, and genealogy loses its subject matter — it has nothing to map. The dependency is constitutive at the object level, not meta-level.

Art is designed and maintained for the sake of joy — its purpose is to evoke aesthetic pleasure and emotional fulfillment. The note describes a genuine designed purpose (aesthetic experience), not an incidental benefit. Per Law 8d, the servant (art) points at the master (joy). While art has multiple purposes, evoking emotional/aesthetic response is a core by-design function.

Mechanical advantage is a dimensionless measurement — a numerical factor quantifying how much a mechanism multiplies input force. It answers 'how much?' for force amplification, which is the fundamental question measurement addresses.

Statistics is built and maintained for the sake of probabilistic reasoning — it provides the tools for inference, estimation, and hypothesis testing under uncertainty. Per Law 8d: the servant (statistics) points at the master (probabilistic reasoning). Remove statistics and probabilistic reasoning loses its formal inferential apparatus.

Etiquette IS a specific kind of custom (Law 9). A competent speaker would call etiquette 'a custom' — specifically, a set of customary social conventions governing polite behavior in particular contexts. The specific (etiquette) points at the general (custom). Note pins sense: custom as a socially-established pattern of behavior, not the act of making something.
A lever system needs its fulcrum (pivot point) to operate — remove the fulcrum and the lever stops working as a force-multiplying mechanism (Law 8 removal test, Law 8b).

Algorithms are designed and maintained for the sake of computation — their purpose is to provide step-by-step procedures for information processing and problem-solving. Law 8d SERVES: servant (algorithm) points at master (computation).

A game IS a specific kind of play — play organized by explicit rules, objectives, and often competition. The specific→general test: a competent speaker calls a game a form of play. Game narrows play's rule-bound freedom into structured activity with defined win/lose conditions.

The fulcrum is designed and positioned for the sake of the lever — it provides the pivot point that enables the lever to function as a simple machine. Law 8d SERVES test: servant (fulcrum) points at master (lever). Remove the fulcrum and the lever cannot operate as a force-multiplying mechanism.

Pulleys conceptually derive from levers: a pulley wheel is essentially a circular lever arm, with the axle serving as the fulcrum. Which-came-first test (Law 7): the lever — any stick on a pivot — predates the pulley by millennia as the simplest known machine. The lever fed into the pulley as a conceptual evolution.

Which-came-first (Law 7): the lever — any stick on a pivot — predates the formal concept of mechanical advantage by millennia. Levers existed first and fed into the concept of mechanical advantage as a way to quantify their benefit.

A wedge is a specific kind of simple machine — a triangular tool concentrating force. 'A wedge is a simple machine' reads as a clear INSTANCE_OF per Law 9. The nearest kind is simple-machine, not lever (which is a sibling, not a parent class).
A pulley is a specific kind of simple machine — a grooved wheel on an axle redirecting tension. 'A pulley is a simple machine' per Law 9 INSTANCE_OF. Simple-machine is the nearest kind.

An inclined plane is a specific kind of simple machine — a flat sloping surface trading force for distance. 'An inclined plane is a simple machine' per Law 9. Simple-machine is the nearest kind, not lever (sibling simple machine).

Simple machines are the foundational tools built and maintained for the sake of engineering — their designed purpose is to further engineering operations (Law 8d). Servant (simple-machine) points at master (engineering).

Wedges are tools built and maintained for the sake of craft — carpentry, masonry, and woodworking all depend on wedges as working implements. The designed purpose of wedges in these domains is to further craft operations (splitting, adjusting, holding). Servant (wedge) points at master (craft).

Chronology (the system of ordering events in time) existed first and provided the conceptual foundation for epoch (a distinct period characterized by particular features). Which came first? Chronology as a way of sequencing predates epoch as a periodization concept. Epoch builds on the ordering capacity that chronology provides.

A washboard is a specific kind of tool — an artifact designed to extend a human capacity (mechanical friction for cleaning). Per Law 11c, passive artifacts qualify as tools in this kingdom: 'a shelf IS a tool'. The washboard extends the human hand's capacity to generate friction for laundry.

A screw is a specific kind of simple machine. The six classical simple machines are: lever, wheel-and-axle, pulley, inclined plane, wedge, and screw. A competent speaker readily calls a screw 'a simple machine.' This files against the nearest kind: simple-machine already contains lever, pulley, wedge, and inclined plane as accepted INSTANCE_OF edges.
A public archive is a specific kind of archive — one maintained for public access and collective memory. Law 9: a competent speaker calls a public archive 'an archive.' Specific → general.

Silence is a specific kind of communication — a nonverbal communicative act that conveys meaning through absence of speech or sound. Communication studies treat silence as an active communicative strategy, not merely an absence.

Torque DERIVED_FROM force: which existed first? The general concept of force predates the specific concept of torque. Torque is a specialization — rotational force — derived from the broader force concept. The historical order is clear: mechanics began with linear force before developing the rotational variant.

Cam DEPENDS_ON mechanism: remove mechanism and does a cam stop operating? A cam is only functional within a mechanism — its purpose is to convert rotational motion into reciprocating/oscillating motion as part of a larger system. Remove the mechanism context and the cam is just a shaped piece of metal with no operational purpose. Present-tense removal test passes.

Law 9: wheel-and-axle is one of the six classical simple machines (lever, wheel-and-axle, pulley, inclined plane, wedge, screw). A competent speaker calls a wheel-and-axle 'a simple machine.' Nearest kind.

Gears exist to transmit, transform, and control torque. Removal test: remove torque and a gear has nothing to do — gears are fundamentally torque-handling devices. The which-came-first check: torque as a physical concept predates the specific gear construct.

A cam is a specific type of mechanism — a rotating or sliding piece that imparts motion to another part via direct contact. Per Law 9: a competent speaker calls a cam 'a mechanism'. Corrects the previously struck DEPENDS_ON (Law 9, Law 11d).
Play is maintained for the sake of leisure: its designed purpose is to provide recreation and enjoyment during free time. Law 8d: for whose sake? Play points at leisure as its master domain.

A gear IS a specific type of simple machine — a rotating mechanism that transmits torque and multiplies force. Law 9: a competent speaker calls a gear 'a simple machine'. Files against nearest kind: gear has no existing INSTANCE_OF edge to a more specific category, and simple-machine is the recognized category for such mechanical elements (cf. screw INSTANCE_OF simple-machine, wheel-and-axle INSTANCE_OF simple-machine both accepted).

A cam IS a specific type of simple machine — a rotating element that converts rotational motion to linear or oscillatory motion via direct contact. Law 9: a competent speaker would classify a cam as a simple machine. Nearest kind: no existing INSTANCE_OF edge on cam points to a more specific category.

The screw is a direct application of the inclined plane principle — an inclined plane wrapped around a cylinder. Which came first? The inclined plane as a concept predates the screw. The inclined plane fed into the design of the screw, making this a genuine derivation.

Gears derive from wheel-and-axle: add teeth to a wheel to transform it into a torque-transmitting mechanism. Which came first? The wheel-and-axle predates the gear by centuries. The wheel-and-axle fed into the gear — a gear is essentially a toothed wheel.
A rack IS a specific type of gear — a linear gear. Per Law 9: a competent mechanical engineer would call a rack 'a gear' (specifically, a linear gear). Files against nearest kind.

Machine elements are built and maintained for the sake of mechanisms — their designed purpose is to serve as functional building blocks within mechanisms. Law 8d: for whose sake? Machine elements point at mechanisms as their master. Without machine elements, mechanisms cannot exist; remove machine elements and mechanisms cease to operate.

A washboard IS a specific kind of washing implement — a textured surface used for hand-washing clothes. Per Law 9: it is a specific type of washing tool/machine auxiliary. Files against the nearest kind.

A washing machine IS a specific kind of machine — a device that performs washing using mechanical, electrical, and water systems. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call a washing machine 'a machine.' Files against accepted nearest kind 'machine'.

A cam IS a specific type of machine element — a rotating mechanical component with a specific function (converting rotational to linear/oscillatory motion) within a larger mechanism. Per Law 9: a competent engineer would classify a cam as a machine element. This replaces the rejected simple-machine classification; machine-element is the correct nearest kind. Law 3a: the kingdom has no bottom — machine-element is a valid construct.

A screw IS a specific type of machine element — a cylindrical component with helical ridges that performs a specific function (fastening or motion conversion) within a machine or assembly. Per Law 9: a competent engineer would classify a screw as a machine element. This is compatible with its accepted DERIVED_FROM inclined-plane edge — the screw is an application of the inclined plane principle, implemented as a machine element.

A gear IS a specific type of machine element — a rotating component with teeth that transmits torque. Files against machine-element as the nearest kind (my prior INSTANCE_OF→ simple-machine was struck; machine-element is the correct rung).

The wedge is a moving inclined plane — the inclined plane concept (a fixed ramp) existed first and fed into the wedge concept (a portable, moving inclined plane). Which came first? The fixed inclined plane predates the wedge; the wedge is derived from applying the inclined plane principle to a moving form.

A rack IS a specific type of machine element — a linear gear with teeth that converts rotational to linear motion (or vice versa) within a mechanism. machine-element is the nearest kind (Law 9). Files alongside gear, cam, screw which are also machine elements.

Play is designed and maintained for the sake of learning — developmental psychology and education theory consistently show play serves cognitive development, skill acquisition, and knowledge retention. Law 8d: for-whose-sake? Play points at learning as its designed purpose (not incidental). This is by sustained human practice and educational design.

A machine IS a specific type of tool — an artifact extending human capacity to transmit/modify force and motion. Per Law 9: 'is a specific kind of' → INSTANCE_OF. Per Law 11e, machine-element is nearer to simple machines, but machine itself is a kind of tool (Law 11c: tool in its broad sense covers all artifacts extending capacity, including passive ones).

A rack is built and maintained for the sake of mechanisms — its purpose is to transmit linear motion within a mechanism. Law 8d: for-whose-sake test. Servant(rack) points at master(mechanism). Files alongside gear SERVES mechanism.

Machines are built and maintained for the sake of manufacturing — their designed purpose is to perform manufacturing tasks (Law 8d: for whose sake?). Machine design optimizes for manufacturing output. The servant (machine) points at the master (manufacturing). This is a purpose-driven SERVES relation, not a DEPENDS_ON claim.

A washboard is a human-made device that transmits and modifies force — converting hand motion into scrubbing friction on fabric. Per the accepted machine definition (just accepted): 'A device that transmits and modifies force, motion, or energy to perform a specific task.' Law 9: a competent speaker calls a washboard 'a simple machine' — it extends human scrubbing capacity. Direction: specific (washboard) → general (machine).

Rack (a linear gear with teeth transmitting linear motion) is derived from the more general gear concept. Edge-test confirms: gear epoch=0.12 < rack epoch=0.15. A rack extends the gear concept into linear domain, making it a derivation, not a separate origin. Law 7: which came first? Gear predates the rack variant.

simple-machine existed as the broader category (machine) first, and the specific classification of simple machines was derived later as a subset of machines with few/no moving parts. Edge-test confirms: machine epoch=0 < simple-machine epoch=0.06. Direction: simple-machine → machine.

rack is a specific kind of simple machine: a linear mechanical element that converts rotational motion to linear motion (or vice versa). Law 9: is a specific kind of → INSTANCE_OF. Rack extends the simple-machine concept (lever, wedge, pulley, wheel-and-axle, screw, inclined plane) with the rack-and-pinion variant.

An actuator is a specific kind of machine element: a component that converts energy (electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic) into mechanical motion. Following Law 9, is-a-specific-kind-of maps to INSTANCE_OF. This parallels gear→machine-element accepted earlier.

Torque is the rotational analogue of force and exists to serve the operation of mechanisms — it is the quantity that mechanisms transmit and manipulate. Per Law 8d, the test is 'for whose sake?' — torque as a concept exists for the sake of mechanism analysis and design.

Levers are built and maintained for the sake of machines — they are fundamental components whose designed purpose is to further machine operation. Per Law 8d: the lever exists to serve the machine's function. The test 'for whose sake?' points at the machine.

Spring IS a machine element: a component that stores and releases mechanical energy through elastic deformation. Per Law 9, specific→general INSTANCE_OF maps correctly. The nearest kind above spring is machine-element (the class of components within machines).

Statistical models existed first and provided the mathematical foundation for predictive modeling. Which-came-first test: statistical modeling predates modern predictive model development. Predictive models build on statistical inference, regression, and probability theory.

The concept of torque (moment of force about an axis) conceptually requires force to operate. Remove the concept of force and torque ceases to function — you cannot compute, measure, or apply torque without force. Present-tense removal test passes.

A washboard is a device built and maintained for the sake of sanitation — its designed purpose is to mechanically clean clothing, which is a core component of personal sanitation. Per Law 8d: servant (washboard)→master (sanitation), the servant points at the master.
A gear (as wheel-and-axle) IS one of the six classical simple machines. Per Law 9: specific→general. The note pins the classical-mechanics sense of simple-machine.

Lullaby is a specific type of song: an authored vocal form characterized by simple melody, repetitive structure, and the deliberate purpose of soothing a listener (typically a child) to sleep. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call a lullaby 'a song.' The INSTANCE_OF ladder connects this PROVISIONAL leaf to an ACCEPTED general.

Chant is a specific type of song: a human-made vocal form distinguished by rhythmic repetition, often used in ritual, ceremonial, or devotional contexts. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call a chant 'a song.' The INSTANCE_OF ladder connects this PROVISIONAL leaf to an ACCEPTED general.

An actuator is a specific kind of mechanism — it converts energy into controlled mechanical motion or force. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call an actuator 'a mechanism.' Files against the nearest kind (mechanism).

Customary law is a specific kind of law: a system of norms and rules established through consistent social practice and accepted as binding by a community, rather than through formal legislative enactment. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call customary law a kind of law. The nearest kind is law, not custom (which is the source, not the category).

Verification is built and maintained for the sake of truth-claims — its designed purpose is to establish and validate what is claimed to be true. Per Law 8d: the servant (verification) points at the master (truth-claim).

An oath is a human-made ritual construct built and maintained for the sake of loyalty — its designed purpose is to bind and sustain faithful adherence. Per Law 8d: the servant (oath) points at the master (loyalty).

Interoperability protocol is built and maintained for the sake of interoperability — its designed purpose is to enable different systems to work together. Per Law 8d: the protocol (servant) points at interoperability (master).

An actuator is built and maintained for the sake of automation — its designed purpose is to convert control signals into physical action, enabling automated systems. Per Law 8d: the actuator (servant) points at automation (master).

Silence is a specific kind of signal — the absence of expected sound or response that conveys information in social and ritual contexts. A competent speaker in context would call silence 'a signal'. Files against the nearest kind (signal), per Law 9.
A spring is a specific kind of mechanism — it stores and releases mechanical energy through elastic deformation. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call a spring 'a mechanism.'

A spring is a specific kind of simple machine — a device that manages mechanical force through a single fundamental principle (elastic storage). Files against the nearest kind (simple-machine). Per Law 9: a competent speaker in engineering context would classify spring among simple machines.

Law 8d: Silence is maintained and deployed for the sake of communication — in conversation it signals disagreement, respect, contemplation, or consent; in social ritual it marks transitions and boundaries. Remove the communicative function and silence ceases to operate as a social construct. The servant (silence) points at the master (communication).

Law 8d: Chant is built and sustained for the sake of ritual — its designed purpose is to induce trance states, coordinate group participation, and mark sacred or ceremonial boundaries. Remove the ritual function and chant loses its distinctive form and practice. The servant (chant) points at the master (ritual).

A loom is a specific kind of machine-element — a device that performs a specific mechanical function in textile production. A loom transforms thread into fabric through the mechanical interlacing of warp and weft. Files against the nearest kind: machine-element.

A whistle is a specific kind of signaling device — an acoustic artifact designed to produce a clear, carrying tone for communication purposes. A competent speaker would call a whistle 'a signal' or 'a signaling device': it files as a specific instance of the general category of signaling.
Sacrifice is performed for the sake of ritual — it is an act designed and maintained as part of religious or ceremonial practice. The servant (sacrifice) points at the master (ritual), per Law 8d.

A communion is a specific kind of ritual — a shared sacred act or meal through which participants enact unity or fellowship with the divine. A competent speaker would call communion 'a ritual' or 'a form of ritual practice'. The note pins the sense of communal sacred rite, not the theological effect.

Attunement is a specific kind of practice — the practice of adjusting or aligning oneself (or one's instrument, attention, etc.) to match a standard, frequency, or other entity. A competent speaker would call attunement a practice.

A whistle is a specific kind of instrument — a device that produces a sharp, high-pitched sound when air is forced through it. A competent speaker would call a whistle an instrument. Per Law 9: specific→general.

Attunement needs calibration as a reference standard to operate. Remove the establishment of a calibration standard, and attunement has nothing to attune to — its operation collapses. This is a present-tense operational dependency, not meta-level.

A whistle is designed and maintained for signaling purposes. Per Law 8d SERVES: the servant (whistle) points at the master (signaling). Its designed function is to produce attention-grabbing sound for signaling.

Attunement is designed and maintained for the sake of music — aligning instruments, ensembles, and voices to standard pitch and harmony so musical performance operates correctly. Per Law 8d: servant (attunement) points at master (music). Remove music and the practice of attunement loses its designed purpose.

A digression IS a specific kind of tangent: both are departures from a main topic in discourse. The difference is that a digression is a controlled tangent that explores a related idea and returns, while a tangent can be any departure. Filing against the nearest kind 'tangent' per Law 11e.

A codpiece is a specific kind of garment — a covering for the crotch area of clothing. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call a codpiece 'a garment' (or more specifically, a garment accessory). It's constructed through tailoring and fashion practice.

An oath is designed and maintained for the sake of covenant — it is the ritual act that establishes, reaffirms, or invokes a covenant. Per Law 8d: the servant (oath) points at the master (covenant). This is genuine teleology: oaths exist to make covenants operative.

Gift is designed and maintained for the sake of reciprocity — it creates and sustains reciprocal obligations between parties. Per Law 8d: the servant (gift) points at the master (reciprocity). This is by design: the social practice of gift-giving exists to generate reciprocal bonds.

tangent INSTANCE_OF heuristic-method: a tangent is a specific kind of heuristic-method — a reasoning strategy where one explores related ideas by branching away from the main topic, using serendipitous discovery as the search mechanism.

A promise is maintained for the sake of covenant: covenants are constructed from mutual promises, and the practice of promising exists (in this context) to establish and sustain covenantal bonds. Law 8d: servant (promise) points at master (covenant). The designed purpose of promise-making in a covenantal framework is to further the covenant.

equality SERVES justice: equality is a principle built and maintained for the sake of justice. The designed purpose of equality (as a social and political concept) is to further the operation of justice. Law 8d: for whose sake? equality points at justice as the master concept.

Equality IS a specific kind of principle — a normative standard for fair treatment and distribution. A competent speaker would call equality 'a principle.' Law 9: specific→general, and the sense is the political-philosophical sense of equality as a governing standard, per its accepted definition.

Mediation is built and maintained for the sake of justice — it provides a structured path for disputing parties to reach fair, voluntary resolutions when formal adjudication is unavailable or insufficient. Law 8d: the servant (mediation) points at the master (justice). Not DEPENDS_ON: justice operates without mediation, and mediation can serve other masters (e.g., corporate harmony).

Silence is strategically deployed within communication — pauses, emphatic quiet, and deliberate non-response are all communicative acts. Silence serves the operation of communication by providing contrast, emphasis, and non-verbal messaging. Law 8d: servant (silence) points at master (communication).

A heuristic method IS a specific kind of cognitive strategy — a rule-of-thumb or practical approach that aids thinking and problem-solving. A competent speaker would call a heuristic 'a strategy for thinking.' Law 9: specific→general. Sense: heuristic-method as deliberate mental shortcut, not as an accidental departure.

A tangent in discourse IS a specific kind of digression — a relatively direct, purposeful departure from the main topic. A competent speaker would call a tangent 'a digression' (specifically one that follows a logical or associative line). Per Law 9: specific→general, tangent files against nearest kind digression.

A bell IS a specific kind of instrument — a struck idiophone (per Hornbostel-Sachs classification) that produces sound by the vibration of its own body. Per Law 9: a competent speaker calls a bell 'an instrument.' Files against nearest kind instrument.

Mediation is designed and maintained for the sake of conflict resolution. Per Law 8d: for whose sake? The servant (mediation) points at the master (conflict-resolution). Mediation would not exist as a practice without the purpose of resolving disputes between parties.

Promises are built and maintained for the sake of cooperation. Per Law 8d: a promise creates reliable commitments that enable parties to coordinate and trust each other's future actions. Remove promises and cooperative arrangements requiring future performance collapse.

Bells are designed and maintained for the purpose of signaling — summoning, warning, marking time, or calling attention. Per Law 8d: the servant (bell) points at the master (signaling). Remove bells and signaling capacity diminishes significantly; the designed purpose of bells is to signal.

A promise is the foundational building block of contracts. Per Law 8d: promises are built and maintained for the sake of creating binding commitments (contracts). A contract without promises would be empty text; promises give contracts their operative force.

An anvil IS a specific kind of tool — a passive artifact (heavy metal block) that extends the smith's hammering capacity by providing a rigid, resilient work surface. Per Law 11c: passive artifacts qualify as tools (extending human capacity). Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call an anvil 'a tool'.

An envelope is a specific kind of container — a paper or material pouch for letters and documents. A competent speaker would call an envelope 'a container' (Law 9). The direction is specific→general: envelope→container.

A gazetteer is a specific kind of catalog — a reference catalog listing places/locations with descriptive information. A competent speaker would call a gazetteer 'a catalog' of places. Direction: specific (gazetteer)→general (catalog).

A heuristic method is a specific kind of method — one that uses practical techniques and rules-of-thumb rather than guaranteed algorithms. A competent speaker would call a heuristic method 'a method'. Direction: specific→general.

Courage IS a specific kind of virtue — the capacity to act rightly in face of fear or danger. Law 9: specific→general, competent speaker calls courage 'a virtue.' Epochs: courage=0.21, virtue=0.03 — virtue is older/more-foundational, consistent with INSTANCE_OF direction. This pins the sense of courage as moral virtue, not recklessness or aggression.

Courage IS a specific kind of compassion — the capacity to act rightly on behalf of others despite fear. Law 9: specific→general. Epochs: courage=0.21, compassion=0.09 — compassion is older/more-foundational. Pins courage as moral courage toward others, not mere personal boldness.

A digression is a specific kind of discourse — speech or writing that departs from the main topic. A competent speaker calls a digression 'a kind of discourse' (deviant discourse). Direction: specific(digression)→general(discourse). Solid per Law 9.

A gazetteer is built and maintained for the sake of geographical reference — its designed purpose is to provide authoritative place-data for lookup. Per Law 8d: servant(gazetteer)→master(reference). The gazetteer serves the reference function.

The concept of tangent is maintained for the sake of mathematical practice — it serves mathematical reasoning, proof, and calculation. Per Law 8d: servant(tangent)→master(mathematics). A mathematical concept exists to serve its discipline.

Envy DERIVED_FROM comparison — the capacity to compare oneself to others existed first and fed into the specific emotional experience of envy. Per Law 7 (which-came-first-test): comparison is a basic cognitive capacity predating the named emotion of envy. Comparison came first and provided the mechanism envy builds on.

A soundboard is built and maintained for the sake of music — its designed purpose is to amplify the acoustic output of stringed instruments so they produce audible music. Law 8d: servant(soundboard)→master(music).

A soundboard is built into an instrument for the sake of the instrument's acoustic function - it amplifies string vibrations so the instrument produces audible sound. Law 8d: servant(soundboard)->master(instrument).

A bridge is a physical part mounted on the soundboard — it transfers string vibrations directly into the wooden panel. Soundboard is the whole; bridge is a component. Law 10: CONTAINS is whole-and-part only.

A clamp IS a specific kind of tool — a holding device used to secure objects during work. Per Law 9: specific→general, a competent speaker calls a clamp 'a tool'. Direction: clamp (specific)→tool (general).

INSTANCE_OF (Law 9): a digression IS a specific kind of rhetorical device — a technique that departs from the main topic to add emphasis, context, or digressive interest. A competent speaker would call a digression 'a rhetorical device'. Direction: specific(digression)→general(rhetorical-device). Files against the nearest kind.

Tangent is a rhetorical technique that operates within discourse — it deliberately departs from the main thread of conversation or argument. Per Law 8's removal test: remove discourse and tangent stops operating (it has no function outside discourse). Per Law 8b, this is object-level, not meta-level: tangent's dependency is on the specific practice of structured exchange, not language in general. Epoch test confirms: discourse (0.12) predates tangent (0.18), consistent with DEPENDS_ON direction.

Law 9: codpiece INSTANCE_OF clothing. A codpiece IS a specific kind of clothing — a garment designed to cover the crotch area, historically worn as part of men's fashion from the 16th-17th centuries. A competent speaker would call a codpiece 'a piece of clothing.' Direction: codpiece (specific) → clothing (general). Files against the nearest kind.

Law 9: tangent INSTANCE_OF rhetorical-device. A tangent IS a specific kind of rhetorical device — a technique that deliberately departs from the main thread of conversation or argument. A competent speaker would call a tangent 'a rhetorical device.' Direction: tangent (specific) → rhetorical-device (general). Files against the nearest kind. This corrects the previously struck DEPENDS_ON→discourse edge with a proper kind-of relationship.

Kiln is a specific kind of tool (Law 9): an artifact designed to extend human capacity for high-temperature material transformation. Competent-speaker test: 'a kiln is a tool' is straightforward — it extends thermoregulation capacity to fire materials. No ladder rung exists between kiln and tool that would make this a leap.
Humming IS a specific kind of sound — a low, continuous, vibratory sound produced by the human voice with closed lips. Competent-speaker test: 'humming is a sound.' Law 9 satisfied.

An envelope is designed and maintained for the sake of communication — its purpose is to contain, protect, and enable the delivery of written correspondence. Per Law 8d: servant (envelope) → master (communication). Remove communication as a practice and an envelope ceases to have any function.

An envelope is designed to protect the confidentiality of its contents — to prevent unauthorized access to written messages. Per Law 8d: the servant (envelope) points at the master (privacy). Its designed purpose is to further privacy by enclosing content.

An anvil is built and maintained for the sake of craft — specifically metalworking craft. Its designed purpose is to serve as the foundational work surface for forging metal. Per Law 8d: servant (anvil) → master (craft). Without craft, an anvil is just a heavy metal block.

A tangent is a rhetorical device deliberately used for the sake of rhetorical strategy — to create a purposeful digression within argument or narrative. Per Law 8d: servant (tangent) → master (rhetoric). Its designed purpose within discourse is to serve rhetorical effect.

An envelope IS a specific kind of tool — an artifact that extends human capacity for communication through containment and protection. Competent-speaker test: an envelope is a tool (in the broad kingdom sense per Law 11c).

Law 8d: Humming is maintained for the sake of music — it is a form of vocal music-making, producing melody and harmony. The servant (humming) points at the master (music). Built and practiced for music's sake.

Law 7: Song (as structured vocal music) existed first and fed into lullaby as a specialized form. The which-came-first test: the concept of song broadly predates the specific concept of lullaby, which is a song derivative aimed at soothing.

Humming is a specific kind of vocalization — the map of a vocal act that produces sustained tone through exhaled breath without articulated speech. Competent-speaker test: humming is a kind of vocalization.

Per Law 8d: the kiln is built and maintained for the sake of craft — it is the specialized high-temperature firing tool for ceramic and metalwork craft. Its designed purpose is to serve the craft domain. The servant (kiln) points at the master (craft). Remove craft and the kiln has no purpose.

Per Law 8d: resonance is maintained and studied for the sake of music — musical instruments rely on acoustic resonance to produce and enrich their tones. The designed purpose of exploiting resonance in instrument design serves music. The servant (resonance as a concept applied to instruments) points at the master (music).
Humility operates as a disposition toward truth — intellectual humility corrects self-inflation and aligns belief with reality. The servant (humility) points at the master (truth-seeking).

Sacrifice is the practice of giving up something valuable for the sake of a beloved person, cause, or ideal. Its designed purpose is to express and further love. Per Law 8d: servant (sacrifice) points at master (love).
Humility enables reciprocity by correcting self-inflation — a proud person cannot genuinely give and receive as equals. The servant (humility) serves the master (reciprocal exchange).

Verification is maintained and designed for the purpose of establishing truth. Per Law 8d: servant (verification) points at master (truth). Its entire function is to confirm or refute claims — without truth as its target, verification has no purpose.

Ritual is maintained and designed for the purpose of expressing and reinforcing love. Marriage ceremonies, anniversary celebrations, love letters — all designed to further love's operation. Per Law 8d: servant (ritual) points at master (love).

Measurement is designed and maintained for the purpose of verification — quantifying phenomena to establish factual claims. Per Law 8d: servant (measurement) points at master (verification). Without verification as its target, measurement has no function.

Resonance is a specific amplification mechanism: a system absorbs energy preferentially at its natural frequency, amplifying the response. Any competent speaker would call resonance 'an amplification phenomenon.' Per Law 9: specific→general kind-of relation. The note pins the physical sense — resonant amplification of oscillatory systems.

Humility corrects self-inflation and the overestimation of one's own importance — exactly the mechanism that creates cognitive bias. Intellectual humility is the designed practice of counteracting bias in self-assessment. Per Law 8d: humility (servant) points at bias correction (master). The servant serves by design: a humble disposition actively corrects biased self-judgment.

Feedback loops are designed and maintained to regulate systems — sensing deviation and correcting course. Self-regulation is the master purpose; feedback loops are the servant mechanism. Per Law 8d: remove the feedback loop and self-regulation (as an active process) stops operating. The servant→master direction is correct.

Biases (systematic errors in judgment) DERIVED_FROM heuristics (mental shortcuts). Kahneman and Tversky established that heuristics produce specific biases. Heuristics existed first and fed into biases as their error pattern. Historical-causal per Law 7.

Humility is a specific kind of virtue — a character quality of recognizing one's own limitations and avoiding self-inflation. Per Law 9: a competent speaker would call humility 'a virtue.' Files against nearest kind. Direction: humility (specific) → virtue (general). The note pins the sense to intellectual/moral virtue, not social standing.

Vocalization is produced and maintained for the sake of communication — its designed purpose is to further communication's operation. Per Law 8d: servant (vocalization) points at master (communication). While vocalization can produce non-communicative sounds (coughing, singing for personal pleasure), the concept vocalization as a category is built around communicative sound production. Remove vocalization and communication loses a primary channel, but vocalization's operational direction remains toward expression and information transfer. Note pins the communicative sense of vocalization.

A clamp IS a specific kind of fastener — a device that holds objects together by pressure. Per Law 9: specific→general. Files against nearest kind, since fastener is more specific than tool. Dir test: clamp is a kind of fastener, not the reverse.

Echo is a specific kind of resonance phenomenon — reflected sound waves that return with sufficient delay to be perceived distinctly. Per Law 9: specific→general. Echo IS a resonance (a specific pattern of sound reflection). Echo is a kind of resonance, not the other way around.

Resonance as a concept DEPENDS_ON dissonance: the concept of resonance (sympathetic vibration at matching frequencies) is defined in contrast to dissonance (clashing frequencies). Remove the concept of dissonance and resonance as a distinguishable concept stops operating — you lose the oppositional frame that makes the concept useful in music theory and acoustics.

Parable is built and maintained for the sake of teaching (Law 8d). A parable is a narrative device whose designed purpose is to teach moral or spiritual lessons through analogy. Servant (parable) points at master (teaching). By design and sustained practice in religious, philosophical, and educational traditions.

Per Law 8d: servant (legend) → master (memory). A legend is a narrative construct deliberately fashioned to preserve and transmit cultural memory across generations. Its designed purpose is memory-preservation — remove the concept of legendary narrative and the mechanism for intergenerational cultural memory loses a key mode of operation.

Per Law 8d: servant (ritual) → master (dignity). Rituals are designed and maintained to affirm, honor, and enact human dignity — rites of passage, honors, memorials all serve to recognize worth. Remove ritual as a practice and dignity loses a constitutive mode of public affirmation.

Memento mori is maintained for the sake of meaning — contemplation of finitude clarifies what matters, grounding values in the reality of limited time. Per Law 8d: the servant (memento mori) points at the master (meaning). Remove memento mori as a practice and the structured pathway to confront existential finitude for value-clarification disappears.

Intelligence as a mapped human capacity is deployed and maintained for the sake of problem-solving. Per Law 8d: the servant (intelligence) points at the master (problem-solving). The designed purpose of intelligence as a construct — in psychology, AI, education — is to identify and further capacity for novel problem resolution.

A parable IS a specific kind of narrative — a short story designed to illustrate a moral or spiritual lesson. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call a parable 'a narrative' (specifically, a didactic one). Files against nearest kind: narrative is more specific than tool or discourse.

Resonance IS a specific kind of wave phenomenon — the amplification of oscillatory motion when a system is driven at its natural frequency. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls resonance 'a wave phenomenon.'

Dissonance IS a specific kind of wave phenomenon — the interference pattern created by overlapping waves of mismatched frequencies, producing amplitude variation perceived as harshness. Law 9: specific→general. Files against nearest kind (wave).

Pre-test: which existed first? Property is older and more general than the specific concept of symmetry. Pre-test for INSTANCE_OF: symmetry IS a specific kind of property — the property of invariance under transformation. A competent speaker would call symmetry 'a property' (specifically, a relational property describing balance and invariance). Law 9: specific→general.

Pre-test which-came-first: oscillation (back-and-forth motion as a concept) existed before resonance (specific amplification at natural frequency). The broader concept of oscillatory motion fed into the later refinement of resonance as a distinct concept. Law 7 satisfied.

A fastener (bolt, nail, rivet, clip) IS a specific kind of tool — an artifact that extends human capacity to join materials. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls a fastener 'a tool.' Note: Law 11c diminishing applies to tool as heavy target, but edge is true.

In music theory and general aesthetics, dissonance serves harmony: the concept of dissonance (tension, clash, lack of congruence) functions to create contrast against harmony, making harmonic resolution meaningful. Per Law 8d: servant (dissonance) → master (harmony). The dissonance-harmony dialectic is by design in musical practice.

Memento mori is a practice maintained and deployed for the sake of wisdom: contemplation of mortality is designed to produce clear-eyed understanding and virtuous living. Per Law 8d: the servant (memento-mori) points at the master (wisdom). The definition explicitly states it is performed 'for wisdom/virtue.'

Patronage is the practice of providing financial and material support for artists and creative work. It is maintained for the sake of art — enabling artists to create without economic destitution. Per Law 8d: the servant (patronage) points at the master (art). A designed purpose, not incidental benefit.

Remove oscillation (the concept of back-and-forth motion) and resonance (amplification at natural frequency) stops operating as a concept — it cannot be understood without its oscillatory foundation. This is a present-tense functional dependency (Law 8), distinct from the historical DERIVED_FROM Seth filed. Both can be true: resonance historically derives from oscillation AND depends on it operationally.

Resonance (amplification at natural frequency) IS a specific kind of amplification. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call resonance 'a type of amplification.' Pinned to the physics sense: amplification as increase in magnitude/intensity.

Memento mori IS a specific kind of practice — a contemplative practice. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls memento mori 'a practice.' Pinned to the philosophical/religious sense: a repeated discipline or exercise, not a single action.

Dissonance (tension, clash, lack of congruence) IS a specific kind of wave phenomenon — a wave of discord in its broadest sense. In music and general aesthetics, dissonance manifests as a disruptive wave pattern that opposes harmonic wave structure. A competent speaker would call dissonance 'a kind of wave' in the kingdom's broad sense of wave (a propagation of disturbance through a medium).

Resonance (amplification at natural frequency) IS a specific kind of wave phenomenon — a wave behavior where oscillation amplitude peaks at characteristic frequencies. A competent speaker calls resonance 'a kind of wave' in the kingdom's broad sense of wave as propagation of disturbance through a medium.

An echo (reflected sound that returns to the listener) IS a specific kind of wave phenomenon — a wave that has been reflected and propagates back. A competent speaker would call an echo 'a kind of wave.' Pinned to the acoustic sense.

Oscillation (back-and-forth motion) IS a specific kind of wave phenomenon — a periodic wave that moves between extremes. A competent speaker calls oscillation 'a kind of wave' in the kingdom's broad sense of wave as propagation of disturbance.

An echo (reflected sound that returns to the listener) IS a specific kind of sound event — namely, a reflected sound. A competent speaker would call an echo 'a kind of sound' in the sense of a sound with the property of having been reflected and returning. Pinned to the acoustic sense: sound as an auditory event, of which echo is a specific type.

Resonance (amplification at natural frequency) IS a specific kind of pattern — a standing pattern of oscillatory amplification. A competent speaker would describe resonance as 'a pattern of amplification.' Pinned to the physics sense: pattern as a recognizable, repeatable configuration of amplitude over time/frequency.

A wave IS a specific kind of oscillation — namely, a propagating oscillation where the disturbance moves through a medium or field. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls a wave 'an oscillation' qualified by propagation. Pinned to the physics sense: wave as a propagating oscillatory disturbance.

A wave IS a specific kind of pattern — a spatial-temporal pattern of periodic variation. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call a wave 'a pattern' — specifically a repeating pattern in space and time. Pinned to the pattern-as-structure sense.

Patronage fundamentally requires mutual obligation to operate. Remove the concept of obligation and patronage collapses — it becomes mere charity or nothing. The patron-client relationship is constituted by reciprocal duties, not just transactions. This passes the Law 8 removal test.

Patronage IS a specific kind of exchange — an asymmetric, ongoing exchange of resources for loyalty/services/support. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call patronage 'a kind of exchange' (distinguished by its asymmetry and duration). Pinned to the economic sense.

Dream operates through memory processes — drawing from stored memories, recombining them, and creating memory traces. Remove memory (the capacity to store and retrieve past experience) and dream as a phenomenon stops operating: there would be nothing to dream with. This is object-level, not meta-level: it's about the dream phenomenon's mechanism, not about the concept requiring memory to be said.

Courtesy is maintained and deployed for the sake of dignity — in social interaction, courtesy exists to preserve and honor the dignity of others. The servant (courtesy) points at the master (dignity). Per Law 8d: the designed purpose of courtesy is to sustain dignity in social relations. A competent speaker recognizes courtesy as serving the end of dignity.

An echo literally IS a reflected sound — without reflection, echo stops operating entirely. The removal test of Law 8 passes cleanly: remove reflection and there is no echo. This is not metaphorical or incidental; reflection is constitutive of echo's operation.

Courtesy IS a specific kind of etiquette — a subset of manners focused on preserving dignity in social interaction. Per Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls courtesy 'a kind of etiquette' (distinguishing it from other etiquette forms like formalism or politeness). Not DEPENDS_ON — this files kind-of.
Echo IS a specific kind of wave — a reflected sound wave that returns to the listener. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls echo 'a wave' (propagating, reflected sound disturbance).

Dissonance is maintained for the sake of harmony — in music and perception, dissonance creates tension that makes harmony perceptible and meaningful. Law 8d: servant (dissonance) points at master (harmony). The designed purpose of dissonance in musical practice is to serve harmonic resolution.

Sound IS a specific kind of wave — an acoustic/mechanical pressure wave propagating through a medium. Per Law 9: specific→general, a competent speaker would call sound 'a wave' (specifically, an acoustic wave). This pins the physics sense: sound as a type of mechanical wave.

An echo requires sound to exist — remove sound and echo ceases to operate entirely. An echo IS a reflected sound; without sound there is nothing to reflect. Law 8: remove Y and X stops operating. Sound is constitutive to echo's existence.

Symmetry IS a specific kind of pattern — an invariant pattern under transformation. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call symmetry 'a type of pattern' (invariance pattern). This is not using pattern — it IS a kind of pattern.

Limen (threshold) IS a specific kind of boundary — the boundary between perceptible and imperceptible states, or between one state and another. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would describe limen as a type of boundary concept.

A gate IS a specific kind of mechanism — a device that controls passage through an opening. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker calls a gate 'a mechanism' (a mechanism for controlling access/passage).

A hallucination requires perception to operate — it is a perceptual experience without corresponding external stimulus. Remove perception and hallucination ceases to operate entirely. Law 8: present-tense dependency, not mere association.

Positional encoding is a technique invented specifically for use in transformer neural networks. Remove neural networks as a context and positional encoding loses its purpose and application entirely. Law 8: removal test passes.

Belonging is maintained and experienced for the sake of meaning — the feeling of being part of something larger serves the construction of meaning in human life. Law 8d: servant (belonging) points at master (meaning). The designed purpose of belonging is to provide meaning through connection.

Philanthropy DERIVED_FROM altruism: the concept of altruism predates philanthropy and fed into it. Philanthropy is the institutionalized, structured form of altruistic concern — organized giving emerged from the older, more basic concept of selfless concern for others. Historical which-came-first: altruism came first.

Beats serve rhythmic organization — the regular pulse that beats provide is built to structure rhythmic patterns in music, poetry, and movement. Law 8d: servant (beat) points at master (rhythm). The designed purpose of beats is to further rhythmic experience.

Meter as a concept requires beat to operate — meter is the system of organizing beats into patterns, and without the concept of a regular pulse (beat), meter cannot function. Law 8: remove beat and meter ceases to operate. The removal test passes: meter has no operational meaning without beat.

Dissonance as a concept originated in musical theory — the interval relationship between sounds — and was later generalized to psychology, sociology, and aesthetics. Law 7: music existed first and fed into the concept of dissonance.

Resonance requires wave to operate — it is the amplification of a wave at its natural frequency. Remove wave and resonance ceases to function: there is no wave to amplify. The removal test of Law 8 passes.

Resonance serves harmony — its physical amplification at natural frequencies is what makes harmonic intervals rich and sustained. The designed purpose of exploiting resonance in music and acoustics is to further harmonic structure. Servant (resonance)→master (harmony) per Law 8d.

Merit IS a specific kind of value — the assessment of worthiness or desert based on qualities or achievements. Per Law 9: specific→general; a competent speaker would call merit 'a value'. Merit narrows 'value' to assessed worthiness, not intrinsic worth.

Tag IS a specific kind of label — a short identifier used to categorize or classify items. Per Law 9: specific→general; a competent speaker would call a tag 'a label'. A tag is a label specialized for classification purposes.

Dissonance as a musical concept NEEDS resolution to operate — dissonance IS the tension that demands resolution. Remove resolution and dissonance ceases to function as a musical concept (becomes mere noise). The removal test of Law 8 passes: X cannot operate without Y. This is constitutive, not incidental.

Positional encoding was invented specifically for use in transformer architectures (Vaswani et al. 2017) — the attention mechanism lacks recurrence and thus cannot capture position on its own. Positional encoding was created to fill that gap. Law 7 which-came-first: transformer architecture predates positional encoding as a named technique.

Nostalgia is maintained for the sake of memory — it preserves emotional connection to past experiences, serving as an affective mechanism that keeps memory meaningful and alive. Law 8d: servant (nostalgia) points at master (memory). Not a dependency — nostalgia doesn't need memory to operate, but is designed to further memory's role.

Capitalism is organized for the sake of exchange — it is an economic system designed to facilitate and maximize production, distribution, and trade. Law 8d: servant (capitalism) points at master (exchange).

Tension is the effect; pressure is the cause. The concept of tension as a distinct state of strain from opposing forces developed after pressure was already understood as concentrated force. Pressure existed first and fed into the more nuanced concept of tension — when forces balance, the resulting condition is tension.

Dissonance IS a specific kind of tension — the state of strain produced by clashing or incongruent elements (notes, colors, ideas). A competent speaker would call dissonance 'a tension'. The note pins the musical/psychological sense of tension as strain-from-opposition. Law 9: specific→general.

Harmony IS a specific kind of resolution — the state reached when clashing or dissonant elements resolve into a stable, consonant configuration. In music, harmony is the resolved state of simultaneous tones. A competent speaker would call harmony 'a resolution' (of dissonance). The note pins the musical sense: harmony as resolved-consonance. Law 9: specific→general.

Merit is a specific kind of assessment — the evaluation of worthiness or desert based on qualities or achievements. A competent speaker would call merit 'an assessment.' Law 9: specific→general with the right kind-of relationship.

Capitalism needs markets to operate right now — remove markets and capitalism collapses. Markets are the mechanism through which capitalism's exchange, pricing, and allocation functions. Law 8 removal test satisfied: capitalism cannot operate without functioning markets. Capitalism already has DERIVED_FROM market (markets preceded capitalism historically), and DEPENDS_ON captures the present-tense need.

Rites are designed and maintained for the sake of belonging — they create and reinforce group identity, shared identity, and social cohesion. The servant (rite) points at the master (belonging). Per Law 8d: the purpose of a rite is constitutively to produce and sustain belonging, not merely to incidentally benefit it.

Nostalgia is maintained for the sake of identity — it connects present self to past experience, reinforcing personal and collective narrative continuity. The servant (nostalgia) points at the master (identity). Per Law 8d: nostalgia's designed function is to produce and sustain identity through temporal anchoring, not merely incidentally benefit it.

Consonance (harmonious combination of sounds) is maintained for the sake of music — it creates the pleasant auditory experience that music aims to produce. The designed purpose of consonance in musical practice is to serve musical aesthetics. Law 8d: servant (consonance) points at master (music).

Consonance IS a specific kind of harmony — the partial or full acoustic harmony where simultaneous sounds blend without perceptual clash. A competent speaker would call consonance 'a kind of harmony' (specifically acoustic harmony). Law 9: specific→general.

Consonance is a perceptual phenomenon — the experience of sounds blending without clash. Remove sound and consonance ceases to operate entirely. This is object-level (not meta-level Law 2b): consonance IS a property of sound, not a concept that merely needs language to be said.

Rites need symbolism to operate — remove symbols and rituals become meaningless gestures. The removal test (Law 8): without symbolic meaning, rites cease to function as rites. This is object-level constitutive need, not meta-level 'needs language to be said.'

Merit is an assessment of worthiness or desert — it needs evaluation to operate. Remove evaluation and merit ceases to function as a concept. The removal test (Law 8): merit cannot exist without the process of evaluation it presupposes.
Formal verification uses mathematical logic to prove properties of systems. Remove logic and formal verification ceases to operate — it has no formal machinery to work with. The removal test passes.

Merit is an assessment of worthiness — it needs the concept of value to operate now. Remove value (the concept of worth/importance) and merit ceases to function as a concept of assessed worth. This passes the removal test (Law 8): merit cannot operate without a framework of value.

A simulacrum is a representation that replaces the original — it needs representation to operate as a concept. Remove representation and a simulacrum cannot function as the concept it is. This is the removal test (Law 8): without representation, simulacrum ceases to operate.

Merit as a concept exists to enable comparing worth between entities. Its designed purpose is to serve the operation of comparison — you invoke merit precisely to rank, weigh, or discriminate value across candidates. The servant (merit) points at the master (comparison).

Heuristics are cognitive shortcuts designed specifically to serve decision-making under constraints (time, information, computation). Remove the heuristic and decision still occurs, but the heuristic's designed purpose is to make decisions faster or more robust. Servant→master: heuristic→decision.

Spectrum is built and maintained for the sake of analysis — its designed purpose is to decompose complex signals into constituent components, making structure visible. Law 8d: for whose sake? Analysis. The note shows purpose by design: spectrum analyzers, spectrograms, and spectral decomposition methods are all instruments and methods created specifically to serve analytical work.

An overtone is a frequency component of a sound — it is a sound phenomenon. Remove sound and overtones literally cease to operate. This passes the object-level removal test (Law 8): overtones depend on sound for their very existence as acoustic events.

Gateway is built and maintained for the sake of memory — its designed purpose is to provide access to stored information. Law 8d: the servant (gateway) points at the master (memory). A gateway without a memory to access is functionally empty; its existence is teleologically oriented toward enabling memory.

A gateway is maintained for the sake of systema_constructum_knowledge — its designed purpose is to organize and provide access to the knowledge structure. Law 8d: the servant (gateway) points at the master (systema_constructum_knowledge). Without the knowledge to structure, a gateway is just a door.

An overtone IS a specific kind of sound — a frequency component of a sound wave. A competent speaker would say 'an overtone is a sound.' Law 9: specific→general. The removal test and chronology are irrelevant for INSTANCE_OF.

A harmonic series is defined as a sequence of overtones (integer multiples of a fundamental frequency). Remove overtones and the concept loses its components — it cannot operate without them. Law 8: present-tense removal test. The concept of a harmonic series needs the concept of overtone to function.

A clamp's function is to apply and maintain pressure on an object. Remove pressure from the concept and the clamp loses its entire mechanism — it stops operating. Law 8: present-tense removal test. A clamp that does not apply pressure is not a clamp.

Pressure IS a specific kind of force — specifically, force distributed over an area. A competent speaker would say pressure is a type of force. Law 9: specific→general. The nearest kind is force, not something broader like energy or physics.

The harmonic-series concept CONTAINS the overtone concept as its constitutive elements. The series IS literally composed of overtones (integer multiples of a fundamental). Per Law 10: overtone is a part inside the whole (the series). Test: from harmonic-series → overtone, the series contains its components.

Spectrum (as an analytical method) IS BUILT FOR THE SAKE OF harmonic-series — its designed purpose is to visualize and analyze harmonic series. Per Law 8d: servant (spectrum) points at master (harmonic-series). Removing the need to analyze harmonic-series removes the purpose of spectrum.

A simulacrum IS a specific kind of representation — a copy or imitation that stands in for something else, often one that may not originally exist. Per Law 9: specific→general; a competent speaker would call a simulacrum 'a representation.' The nearest kind is representation (not image, not copy, as those are more specific subtypes).

Spectrum analysis OPERATES by measuring frequency components of a signal. Remove measurement and spectral analysis ceases to function — you cannot decompose or measure frequencies without measurement. Per Law 8 removal test: remove measurement and spectrum stops operating as a concept/method.

Nostalgia as a concept requires the concept of time — specifically, the distinction between past and present — to operate. Nostalgia IS a sentimental longing for the past; remove time (the past/present distinction) and nostalgia loses its entire referent and cannot operate. Per Law 8 removal test: remove time and nostalgia ceases to function. This is not sayable-dependency — the concept literally cannot operate without temporal reference.

Timbre is the quality that distinguishes different types of sound — it is the 'color' of a sound. Per Law 8 removal test: remove sound and timbre ceases to operate (there is no sound to have timbre). Timbre is not sound itself (not identity), but it is a property OF sound that needs its referent to function. Remove the referent and the property cannot operate.

Per Law 8 removal test: mechanical advantage IS a concept about how force is amplified by simple machines. Remove force and mechanical advantage cannot operate — its entire referent (force amplification) collapses. Object-level dependency: mechanical advantage specifically picks out force relationships, not general physics.

Integrity is maintained for the sake of trust — the practice of moral consistency and honesty exists to build and sustain trust in relationships and institutions. Per Law 8d: the servant (integrity) points at the master (trust). Remove integrity as a social practice and trust becomes significantly harder to establish and maintain.

Nostalgia is maintained for the sake of belonging — it connects present individuals and communities to their shared past, reinforcing social bonds and collective identity. Per Law 8d: nostalgia serves belonging. Remove nostalgia's connective function and the maintenance of belonging across generations weakens.

Playful interaction is maintained for the sake of learning — it engages participants in low-stakes exploration that builds skills and knowledge. Per Law 8d: playful interaction serves learning. Remove the playful framework and much of the motivation for exploratory learning disappears.

Equilibrium as a concept requires measurement to operate — you cannot determine whether a system is in equilibrium without the ability to measure its state. Remove measurement and equilibrium has no operational meaning (no way to verify balance). DEPENDS_ON passes Law 8 removal test.

The Systema Constructum game concept is built on and derives from the corporation-of-corporators idea: a network of agents (corporations/corporators) building a shared taxonomy. The game concept came after and was fed by the earlier concept of interconnected corporate entities.
Remove sound and polyphony stops operating entirely — it is a sonic phenomenon that requires sound as its medium. Object-level dependency, not sayability.

Per Law 8 removal test: pitch is a perceptual attribute OF sound. Remove the concept of sound and the concept of pitch literally ceases to operate — pitch has no domain without sound. This is a genuine object-level dependency (Law 2b), not a meta-level sayability issue.

Per Law 8d: for whose sake. Polyphony as a musical technique is maintained for the sake of music — it is a method of musical expression, a way to create richer musical textures. The designed purpose of polyphony is to further music as an art form. The servant (polyphony) points at the master (music).

The concept of an overtone — a resonant frequency component above the fundamental — depends on the harmonic series as its framework. An overtone is meaningful precisely as a member of the harmonic series (the nth partial above the fundamental). Remove the concept of a harmonic series and the overtone concept has no structure to sit in.

Harmonic series is a physical/perceptual property of sound — the set of integer-multiple frequencies that naturally accompany a vibrating body. Remove sound and the harmonic series concept has no domain: it is a pattern within sound, not a standalone phenomenon.

Intuition is rapid, non-analytical judgment operating on perceptual data. Remove the concept of perception and intuition has no input to work with — it cannot generate judgments from nothing. The removal test is satisfied: without perception as a concept, intuition ceases to operate.

Reflective practice is designed and maintained for the sake of learning — its entire purpose is to generate insight and deeper understanding. Per Law 8d: for whose sake? The servant (reflection) points at the master (learning). Remove learning and reflective practice has no designed purpose remaining.

Intuition operates by drawing on accumulated knowledge patterns and stored experience. Remove knowledge and intuition has no content to draw from — it stops operating as rapid non-analytical judgment. The concept needs the concept of knowledge to function: intuition IS pattern-recognition-based judgment drawn from what is known.

Polyphony IS a specific kind of counterpoint. Counterpoint is the technique of combining independent melodic voices; polyphony is the practice of doing so — two or more independent melodic lines performed simultaneously. A competent speaker would call polyphony 'a form of counterpoint.' Law 9: specific→general.

A digital-physical interface IS a specific kind of interface. Interface is the general category of connection points between systems; digital-physical interface is the specific case that bridges digital and physical domains. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call a digital-physical interface 'an interface.'

Intuition as a cognitive process is maintained for the sake of decision-making — its designed purpose is to produce rapid, non-analytical judgments. Per Law 8d: the servant (intuition) points at the master (decision-making).

The concept of pitch (as a musical/perceptual correlate of frequency) needs the concept of frequency to operate. Without the frequency concept — cycles per unit time — the pitch concept loses its quantitative framework and cannot be precisely defined or compared. Law 8 removal test: remove frequency and pitch stops operating as a defined musical concept.

The concept of noise in information theory and communications IS defined in opposition to signal — it is signal minus information. Remove the concept of signal and noise loses its operative definition: without signal to contrast against, there is no noise as a concept. Law 8 removal test: X stops operating when Y is removed.

An overtone needs the harmonic-series concept to operate as a meaningful musical term. Remove the harmonic-series (the ordered sequence of frequencies at integer multiples of a fundamental) and an overtone becomes just any higher-pitched sound — it loses its specific meaning as a member of a harmonic series.

A harmonic series is a mathematical sequence of frequencies. It needs the frequency concept (cycles per unit time) to define each term in the series. Remove frequency and the harmonic-series collapses — it cannot specify what the harmonics are without measuring their rates.

Consonance as a musical concept IS the quality of frequency ratios that appear in the harmonic series (2:1, 3:2, 4:3). Remove the harmonic-series concept and consonance loses its defining criterion — it becomes a subjective feeling rather than a defined acoustic relationship. The removal test passes: without harmonic-series, consonance as a concept cannot operate.

Homeostasis is a specific kind of equilibrium — the self-regulating steady state maintained by biological systems through feedback loops. Equilibrium is the general concept of balanced stability; homeostasis is the active biological instance of that concept. Direction (specific → general) is correct per Law 9.

Melody is built or maintained for the sake of expression — its designed purpose in music is to convey emotion, narrative, and identity. A melody without expressive intent is just a sequence of pitches. The servant (melody) points at the master (expression), per Law 8d.

An overtone is defined as a frequency component above a fundamental pitch. Remove the concept of pitch and overtone loses its operative framework — it cannot specify what frequency it is above. Per Law 8 removal test: X stops operating without Y.

Timbre is the quality distinguishing sound sources at the same pitch and loudness. It is defined by the overtone structure (which overtones exist, their amplitudes and evolution). Remove the concept of overtone and timbre loses its defining mechanism — it cannot distinguish sound qualities. Per Law 8 removal test: X stops operating without Y.

An overtone is defined as a frequency component above a fundamental pitch. Remove the concept of frequency and overtone cannot specify what kind of value it is — it stops operating as a musical term. The removal test passes.

Harmonic-series is the analysis of the overtone structure of sound. Remove the concept of overtone and harmonic-series has nothing to analyze — it ceases to operate as a musical analytical framework. Per Law 8 removal test: no overtone concept = no harmonic-series operation.

Consonance is defined as the quality of harmonic compatibility between pitches, determined by the relationship of their overtone series. Remove the concept of overtone and consonance cannot operate — there would be no framework for describing how pitch relationships are perceived as stable or unstable. This is a constitutive dependency, not mere association.

Harmony combines simultaneous pitches into chordal structures. Remove pitch and harmony has no operational element — there are no pitches to harmonize. The concept collapses entirely without pitch. Constitutive dependency.

Melody is a sequence of pitched notes organized temporally. Remove pitch as a concept and melody has nothing to be a sequence of — it collapses entirely. Pitch is the fundamental element from which melody is constructed; the removal test passes clearly.

Melody is organized temporally — notes arranged in specific rhythmic patterns. Remove rhythm and melody loses its temporal structure, becoming just a set of pitches with no ordering. Rhythm provides the temporal framework that makes a melody coherent. The removal test passes.

Polyphony is a musical technique designed and maintained for the sake of richer expression — enabling multiple independent voices to convey complex emotional and narrative content simultaneously. Its designed purpose is to extend what a single voice can express.
