Intuition is a cognitive construct designed and maintained for the sake of decision-making — enabling rapid judgment without full analytical processing. Its designed purpose is to serve decision contexts where speed or incomplete information makes deliberation impractical.

Algorithmic processes are designed and maintained for the sake of automation — providing step-by-step methods that can be systematically executed to perform operations without human intervention. Their purpose is to enable reliable, repeatable automation.

Polyphony is a specific musical technique and construct — a kind of music organized around multiple simultaneous independent voices. It passes the 'is X a specific kind of Y' test: a polyphony is a kind of music. Prechecked: both polyphony and music exist and are ACCEPTED.

Melody is a specific musical construct — a kind of music organized as a sequence of pitched notes in temporal patterns. A melody is a kind of music. Prechecked: both melody and music exist and are ACCEPTED.

Tuning is the practice of adjusting instruments or voices to correct pitch. Remove the concept of pitch and tuning has no target — it ceases to operate. Per Law 8 removal test: X needs Y operating now. Tuning NEEDS pitch to function as a concept.

Flow (psychological immersion state) requires equilibrium — a balance between challenge and ability that allows sustained attention. Remove equilibrium and flow loses its operational condition; the removal test passes per Law 8.

Tempo is the measured speed or rate of a rhythmic pattern. Remove rhythm as a concept and tempo has nothing to measure the speed of — it ceases to operate. The removal test passes cleanly: tempo needs rhythm to function as a concept.

An interval names the distance between two pitches. Remove the concept of pitch and an interval has nothing to measure — it ceases to operate. The removal test passes: intervals need pitch as their constitutive referent.

Flow is a psychological state of deep immersion requiring sustained attention. Remove the concept of attention and flow loses its cognitive mechanism — it ceases to operate. Attention is a constitutive prerequisite for the flow state.

Counterpoint is a specific technique within polyphony — the contrapuntal treatment of independent melodies. A competent speaker would say 'counterpoint is a kind of polyphonic technique.' Edge-test: polyphony (0.09) predates counterpoint (0.21). Law 9: specific→general.

Cadence is a harmonic progression that establishes or temporarily rejects tonal resolution. Remove the concept of harmony and cadence has nothing to measure — it ceases to operate (Law 8 removal test). Harmony is the system of pitches that cadence navigates; cadence operates as a moment within that system. This is an operational dependency, not a shared condition of conceptuality (Law 2b).

Harmonics is the concept of integer-multiple frequencies relative to a fundamental. Remove the concept of frequency and the harmonic series (n·f₀) loses all mathematical meaning — it ceases to operate. The removal test passes: the concept needs frequency as its constitutive referent.

Spectral envelope describes the distribution of energy across frequencies. Remove the concept of frequency and the spectral envelope has no axis — it ceases to operate as a concept. The removal test passes cleanly.
Tuning is the practice of adjusting instrument pitch to a reference. Remove the concept of frequency and tuning has nothing to measure — pitch IS a frequency concept. The removal test passes cleanly.

A waveform is the mapping of signal amplitude onto a temporal axis — it is itself a measurement construct. Remove measurement as a concept and waveform has no framework for encoding or interpreting signal morphology. The removal test passes.

A formant IS a resonant frequency band of the vocal tract. Its entire explanatory mechanism is resonance — the vocal tract amplifying specific harmonics. Remove the concept of resonance and formants lose their defining principle: they become unexplained spectral peaks with no operational framework.

Loudness perception is fundamentally frequency-dependent: the same SPL at different frequencies produces different perceived loudness (equal-loudness contours). The concept of loudness as a perceptual construct cannot operate without frequency — the cochlea's frequency analysis and the definition of loudness units (phon, sone) are all frequency-relative.

A formant is a resonant frequency band that amplifies specific harmonics in the vocal tract spectrum. The concept of formant requires harmonics — formants are defined by how the vocal tract shapes the harmonic series. Remove harmonics and formant has nothing to act upon; it cannot operate as a concept.

Tuning is the practice of adjusting an instrument or voice to match a reference pitch. Remove the concept of reference and tuning has nothing to adjust to — no standard, no target, no operation. The dependency passes the removal test: without a reference concept, tuning cannot function. Direction tested: tuning exists because references exist (references came first conceptually).

Timbre (tone quality) as a perceptual construct is determined by the shape of the spectral envelope — the distribution of energy across frequencies. Remove the concept of spectral envelope and timbre as a construct has no acoustic basis to operate on. The removal test passes: without spectral-envelope, timbre collapses. Direction tested: spectral-envelope (as a signal concept) predates timbre (as its perceptual mapping).

Formant is defined as a peak in the spectral envelope — the resonant band amplifies specific frequencies within the envelope shape. Remove the concept of spectral envelope and formant loses its defining context (where the peaks exist). Constitutive dependency.
A phrase is a structured unit of language. Remove the concept of language and 'phrase' as a linguistic construct loses all operation — it exists only within language systems. Constitutive dependency.

An interval is a measured quantity of separation (in time, space, or pitch). Remove the concept of measurement and interval loses its operation — it exists as a quantified gap. Constitutive dependency.
Flow as a concept IS change over time — the movement or passage of matter/energy/state. Remove time and flow loses its defining operation. Constitutive dependency.
Formant is a resonance peak within a sound's frequency spectrum. Remove the concept of sound and formant has no acoustic referent — its entire domain is a phenomenon of sound.

Loudness is a human-made perceptual construct for quantifying sound intensity. Remove perception and loudness as a perceptual magnitude loses its referent. The concept operates within the domain of subjective experience.

Timbre as a perceptual construct IS the experience of spectral envelope shape — remove spectral envelope and timbre loses its defining property. The relationship passes the removal test: no spectral envelope concept, no basis for timbre perception.

A waveform is a representation of signal variation over time. Remove time and waveform loses its defining dimension — waveforms are fundamentally functions of time (amplitude vs. time). This is object-level, not meta-level: waveform's operation requires temporal reference to function as a concept.

The onset of a sound is its temporal beginning point. Remove time and onset has no temporal framework — 'beginning' is inherently a temporal concept. Object-level dependency: onset operates as a temporal marker within sound events.

Loudness is the perceptual magnitude of sound intensity, which is physically grounded in amplitude. Remove amplitude and loudness loses its physical referent — loudness IS the perception of amplitude variation. Object-level dependency: loudness operates by mapping amplitude to subjective intensity.

Phrase structure depends on syntactic rules to function as a meaningful unit of language. Remove the concept of syntax — the structured rules governing word combination — and phrase loses its organizing principle; it becomes a mere sequence without grammatical coherence.

Phrase is a linguistic construct for grouping words into meaningful units. It is built and maintained for the sake of communication — phrases make speech tractable for both speaker and listener, structuring information into communicable chunks. The designed purpose of phrasing is to facilitate the transfer of meaning.

The concept of harmonics — integer-multiple frequency relationships — was developed and refined for the sake of music. Harmonics serve music by providing the theoretical framework for chord construction, pitch relationships, tuning systems, and timbral analysis. The designed purpose of the harmonics concept is to explain and enable musical structure.

Spectral envelope — the concept of overall frequency spectrum shape — derives from the prior concept of frequency. Frequency existed first and provided the dimensional framework within which spectral-envelope was built.
Onset as a temporal concept derives from the prior, broader concept of time. Time existed first; onset is a specific temporal construct built from it.

Waveform is a specific kind of representation — it visually or numerically represents signal data over time. A competent speaker would describe a waveform as 'a representation' of how a signal varies.

Amplitude is a specific kind of property — it is a measurable physical property describing the magnitude of a wave or oscillation. A competent speaker would call amplitude 'a property' of waves and signals.

Interval as a musical/auditory concept — the perceived distance between two pitches — needs the concept of frequency to operate. Intervals are ratios or differences in frequency; remove frequency and interval as a measurable acoustic concept ceases to function.

A harmonic series IS a specific kind of pattern — a mathematical pattern of integer-multiple frequencies that occur naturally with vibrating bodies. A competent speaker would call a harmonic series 'a pattern of frequencies.' Law 9: specific→general.

Amplitude as a quantified concept needs measurement to operate — it is defined as a measurable magnitude of a wave. Remove measurement and amplitude as a quantified construct has no operational framework. Object-level: amplitude's function as a measurable quantity requires measurement as a concept.

Play is a specific kind of leisure activity — voluntary activity done for enjoyment rather than practical purpose. A competent speaker would describe play as 'a form of leisure.' Law 9: specific→general. This files against the nearest kind correctly.

An interval is the basic building block of harmony — chords and harmonic progressions are constructed from intervals. The designed purpose of interval concepts in music is to serve the construction and analysis of harmony. Law 8d: for whose sake? interval points at harmony.

The spectral envelope — the overall shape of a sound's frequency content — is what gives a sound its distinctive timbre. A trumpet and a piano playing the same note differ because their spectral envelopes differ. The designed purpose of the spectral-envelope concept is to serve the explanation and analysis of timbre. Law 8d: for whose sake?

Friction as a physical concept existed first and fed into the more specific concept of damping. Damping is friction applied systematically to oscillatory motion — the which-came-first test passes: friction predates damping by millennia.

In audio analysis, the concept of onset is defined by detecting an increase in amplitude above a threshold. Remove amplitude and onset as an analytical concept loses its operational meaning — there would be no way to detect or quantify the beginning of a sound event. This passes Law 8's removal test: X (onset) needs Y (amplitude) to operate now.

The musical concept of harmonics requires interval to describe relationships between partials. The harmonic series is quantified as intervals (octave=2:1, perfect fifth=3:2, major third=5:4). Remove interval and harmonics can only be listed as frequencies — they lose their musical relational structure. This passes Law 8's removal test: harmonics as a musical concept needs intervals to operate.

Oscillation as a concept requires equilibrium to operate — you need an equilibrium state to oscillate around. Remove the concept of equilibrium and oscillation stops operating as a meaningful concept. The removal test: no equilibrium, no oscillation.

An overtone is a specific member of the harmonic series. A competent speaker would describe an overtone as 'a member of the harmonic series.' This files against the nearest kind: overtone already DEPENDS_ON harmonic-series for its physical mechanism, and INSTANCE_OF pins its categorical relationship.

The concept of onset was developed and maintained for the sake of audio analysis — it serves to segment sounds into analyzable phases (attack, decay, sustain, release). Its designed purpose is analytical: without analysis as a goal, the onset concept would have no reason to exist.

The concept of trustworthiness was developed and is maintained for the sake of enabling cooperation. It serves as a social mechanism that allows cooperative behavior to flourish by signaling reliability. Remove trustworthiness and cooperation as a structured social practice collapses — this is its designed purpose.

The concept of prestige was developed and is maintained for the sake of social hierarchy — it serves as a mechanism for establishing status differentiation and maintaining hierarchical structures within groups. Remove prestige and the social hierarchy mechanism it supports ceases to operate.

Transient as a concept is created and maintained for the sake of audio analysis. Its parameters (duration, amplitude rise time, spectral content) exist to segment sounds into analyzable regions. Remove the analytical purpose and transient as a defined construct loses its reason for existing. The designed function is to serve analysis workflows in audio processing and music information retrieval.

FFT's operation is defined as an efficient algorithm for computing the DFT. Remove the DFT — the mathematical transform that decomposes signals into frequency coefficients — and FFT has nothing to compute. The dependency is constitutive: FFT is the 'how' of DFT computation, DFT is the 'what'.

DFT is a specific algorithm — a defined computational procedure for transforming time-domain samples to frequency coefficients. A competent speaker would describe DFT as 'an algorithm.' This is the nearest kind: DFT is not a broader category that algorithm fits into, nor is it a part of algorithm. Files INSTANCE_OF correctly.

FFT is a specific algorithm — an efficient computational method for DFT. A competent speaker would describe FFT as 'an algorithm.' This is the nearest kind: FFT is not a broader category. Files INSTANCE_OF correctly.

Privacy is the concept of boundaries between self and other — personal, spatial, informational. The removal test: without boundary as a concept, privacy cannot operate. Privacy IS boundary-drawing applied to the self. Identity is not dependency here — privacy is not 'just' boundary (it's a specific application), but it constitutively needs the boundary concept to function.

Feedback is a process where output reflects back into the system as input. The concept constitutively depends on reflection — not just acoustic reflection but the general concept of something bouncing back to its source. Remove reflection and feedback has no mechanism. The removal test passes.

Overtone is the concept of a frequency component above the fundamental frequency of a sound. The removal test: remove harmonics (as a concept of frequency relationships) and overtone ceases to operate — individual frequency components are just frequencies, not 'overtones.' The concept of an overtone is only meaningful within a harmonic framework.

Timbre is the perceptual quality that distinguishes sounds with the same pitch and loudness. The removal test: remove harmonics as a concept and timbre loses its primary perceptual dimension — the harmonic content distribution is what timbre primarily encodes. Without the harmonic concept, timbre as a distinct perceptual category cannot operate.

Resonance is the concept of a system amplifying oscillations at specific frequencies. The removal test: remove harmonics and resonance loses its organizing principle — resonance peaks occur at harmonic frequencies because harmonic relationships define which frequencies reinforce each other. Without harmonics, resonance is unstructured amplification.

Harmonic series is a specific pattern of harmonics — the sequence of integer-multiple frequencies (fundamental, 2f, 3f, 4f...). Files against nearest kind: a competent speaker calls a harmonic series 'a set of harmonics.' The precheck confirms no existing harmonic-series↔harmonics edge.

Equilibrium as a maintained, dynamic state requires feedback to self-regulate. Remove feedback (the concept of a system's output affecting its future input) and dynamic equilibrium cannot operate — it has no mechanism for correction. Static balance is not equilibrium in the systems sense; dynamic equilibrium IS.

Onset is the concept of something beginning. The removal test: remove the concept of time and onset cannot operate — there is no 'before' to begin from. Different from the existing DERIVED_FROM (chronological); this is present-tense operation (Law 8).

Phase is a mathematical concept parameterizing position in a periodic cycle. Remove mathematics and phase cannot operate — it is not just sayable in math but defined by mathematical formalism (angle, fraction of period). Law 8 removal test passes.

Harmony is a specific configuration of harmonics — the pleasing combination of multiple frequencies heard as a unified chord. A competent speaker calls harmony 'a kind of harmonic structure.' Nearest kind is harmonics. Law 9: specific→general.

spectral-envelope is a specific kind of property — it is the property describing the distribution of energy across frequency components of a sound. A competent speaker would call it 'a property of sound.' Files against nearest kind: property.

interval is the measured difference between two points (pitch, time, frequency). Remove measurement — the concept of quantified difference — and interval cannot operate: there is no framework for expressing or comparing distances. The removal test: no measurement, no interval.

Phase is the concept of position within a cycle of a periodic phenomenon. Remove oscillation and phase cannot operate — phase is specifically defined as a position in a cycle, and cycles are the domain of oscillation. This is a genuine operational dependency, not a meta-level sayability claim.

Timbre is the quality of sound that distinguishes different sources at the same pitch and loudness. It is determined by the frequency content (spectral envelope, harmonics) of a sound. Remove frequency and timbre cannot operate — the concept of timbre has no operating mechanism without frequency as its domain.

Damping is the concept of progressive decay in an oscillating system through energy dissipation. The removal test: remove equilibrium and damping cannot operate — damping is defined as the gradual return TO equilibrium, so without the concept of an equilibrium state, the notion of 'decaying toward rest' loses its reference frame entirely. Damping requires equilibrium as its attractor state.

Transient is the concept of a phenomenon that exists only for a limited duration. The removal test: remove interval (the concept of measurable duration between boundaries) and transient cannot operate — without the notion of temporal span or duration, nothing can be 'temporary' vs. 'permanent.' Transient as a concept requires interval as its framework for distinguishing short-lived from enduring phenomena.

Damping is a specific kind of process — the process of progressive energy dissipation in an oscillating system. A competent speaker would call damping 'a process of decay.' Files against nearest kind, Law 9.

Reconciliation is built and maintained for the sake of achieving resolution between conflicting parties. Its designed purpose is to produce resolution — the servant (reconciliation) points at the master (resolution). Law 8d: this records the true relation of purpose, not need or kind.
Transient is a specific kind of process — a phenomenon that exists only for limited duration. A competent speaker would call a transient 'a brief process or event.' Files against nearest kind, Law 9.

Violence is employed for the sake of coercion — forcing compliance through threat or use of force. Its designed purpose in social contexts is to coerce. The servant (violence) points at the master (coercion). Law 8d: purpose by sustained practice, not incidental benefit.

The envelope (ADSR model) contains attack as a constituent phase — the attack is literally one part inside the whole envelope structure. A competent speaker says 'the envelope has an attack phase.' Files Law 10: CONTAINS is whole-and-part only.
A melody is structurally composed of pitches — the pitches are the constituent elements that the melody arranges in sequence. Files Law 10: CONTAINS.
Attack is a specific kind of phase — the initial phase of a sound's amplitude envelope. A competent speaker says 'attack is a phase of the envelope.' Files against nearest kind (phase), Law 9.
Violence is a specific kind of force — the application of physical power to compel or harm. A competent speaker would say 'violence is a form of force.' Files against nearest kind (force), Law 9.

Contempt is a specific kind of emotion — a complex attitude involving disgust and superiority toward another. A competent speaker says 'contempt is an emotion.' Files against nearest kind (emotion), Law 9.

The concept of attack (acoustic phase of sound onset) depends on the concept of sound to operate. Remove the concept of sound and attack as an acoustic concept loses its entire referent — you cannot describe an attack phase without reference to sound. This is not meta-level: attack operates on the object-level concept of sound, not just its shareability.

The impulse-response concept (characterizing LTI systems via their response to a Dirac delta input) depends on the concept of signal. Remove the concept of signal and impulse-response loses its domain — signals are what impulse responses describe and process. Without signals as a concept, there is nothing for an impulse response to characterize.

The transient concept (a phenomenon existing only for limited duration) depends on the concept of time to operate. Remove time as a concept and duration loses meaning — transience is defined by temporal boundedness. The removal test: without the concept of time, the concept of a transient (limited-duration phenomenon) cannot function.

The amplitude-envelope is a structured temporal model composed of named constituent segments. Attack is the first constituent part — the initial rise phase — of the envelope's temporal structure. Whole-and-part: the envelope (whole) contains attack (part), just as a car (whole) contains an engine (part). The ADSR model defines attack as a specific segment within the envelope's temporal architecture.

attack is defined in audio/signal processing as the initial rise phase OF an amplitude envelope. The removal test: remove the concept of envelope and attack as an audio concept loses its operational meaning — there is no framework within which attack operates. This is operational dependency, not meta-level (Law 8b): attack is a PART-CONCEPT of the envelope, not just named alongside it. Files the direction: attack→envelope because attack needs the envelope concept to function.

onset (the beginning point of a sound's amplitude rise) is conceptually parasitic on attack (the initial rise phase). In audio processing, onset IS the attack phase — the onset event marks the start of the attack. Remove the concept of attack and onset as an audio concept has no operational role. The removal test holds: onset needs attack to have meaning in its domain.

Damping is a specific kind of dissipation — the dissipation of organized mechanical or electrical energy in oscillatory systems, reducing amplitude over time. A competent speaker calls damping 'a form of dissipation.' Files against nearest kind per Law 9.

The concept of impulse response is defined through convolution: an impulse response is the output of a linear system when the input is a Dirac delta function, and computing the system's output for any input requires convolution with that impulse response. The removal test: remove convolution and impulse response as an analytical concept stops operating — you cannot characterize or use an impulse response without convolution.

Transient as a concept in audio engineering describes the brief initial portion of a sound's amplitude envelope. Remove sound and this concept loses its domain entirely — transient is defined relative to acoustic events. The removal test passes: without sound, the transient concept as used in audio stops operating.

An impulse response is a structured concept with identifiable phases: the initial transient, possible oscillation, and steady-state. The transient (brief initial portion) is a constituent phase of the impulse response — a part in the whole-and-sense, analogous to attack being a phase of the amplitude envelope.

Pinned sense: 'phase' as a temporal stage of a system's response (transient phase vs steady-state phase). A transient is a specific kind of temporal phase — the brief initial stage before the response settles. A competent speaker would call a transient 'a phase of the response.' Law 9 satisfied.

An impulse response is a representational construct: it encodes a system's behavior as a time-domain function. It is not the physical system itself but a map of how the system responds — a human-made representation for analysis and prediction.
An amplitude envelope is a human-made representational construct that describes how the amplitude of a signal varies over time. It is a model/map of amplitude behavior, not the signal itself.

Test: remove signal now and amplitude-envelope stops operating. An amplitude envelope IS a description of how a signal's amplitude varies over time — without the concept of signal, there is no amplitude-envelope. The concept constitutively requires signal to function.

Test: amplitude-envelope is a specific kind of envelope. A competent speaker would call an amplitude-envelope 'an envelope' (specifically, the amplitude type). The general category is 'envelope' (a curve outlining extremes), and amplitude-envelope pins the specific domain (signal amplitude).

Test (SERVES): impulse-response is built and maintained for the sake of measurement — specifically, measuring a system's behavior. An impulse response characterizes a system for measurement purposes. The servant (impulse-response) points at the master (measurement). Law 8d: this records the designed purpose, not a need relation.

A phasor is a human-made construct representing a sinusoidal signal. Without the concept of signal, a phasor has nothing to represent and thus cannot operate. The phasor's purpose is to encode signal information.

Phasor IS a specific kind of representational construct: a human-made encoding of sinusoidal signal parameters (amplitude, phase) as a complex number. A competent speaker would call a phasor a representation.

Filter is designed and maintained for the sake of measurement — its purpose is to isolate, condition, or shape signal content so that meaningful measurements can be taken. The servant (filter) points at the master (measurement). This is a genuine teleological relation: engineers build filters specifically to serve measurement tasks, and the filter's parameters (cutoff, Q) are chosen to enable accurate measurement.

Remove convolution now and impulse-response stops operating: in linear time-invariant systems, the impulse response's entire function — characterizing the system — works through convolution (output = input convolved with impulse response). Without the convolution operation, the impulse response loses its operational mechanism and cannot serve its constitutive purpose. This is not meta-level: it's the mathematical mechanism that makes impulse responses work.

Remove the concept of phase now and phase-shift stops operating: phase-shift is defined as a displacement relative to a reference phase. Without the concept of phase (angular position within a cycle), there is nothing for the shift to displace. Present-tense operational dependency per Law 8.
Bandwidth specifies the frequency range over which a signal or system operates. Without the concept of signal, bandwidth has no referent and ceases to operate. The removal test passes cleanly.

Phasor is a mathematical construct for representing sinusoidal signals. Mathematics existed first and fed into the phasor concept — phasors derive their formalism from complex number theory and trigonometry, both branches of mathematics.

Convolution is a mathematical operation. Remove mathematics and convolution ceases to operate entirely — its definition, computation, and application all live within mathematical analysis. The removal test passes cleanly.

Onset is the concept of a starting point in time. Remove the concept of time and onset ceases to operate — a starting-point-without-time is incoherent. While onset also DERIVED_FROM time (time existed first), it also DEPENDS_ON time (onset needs time to operate now). Different test, different edge.

Remove signal — does filtering stop operating? Yes. A filter's entire operation is to select, reject, or reshape signal content. Without the concept of a signal, a filter has nothing to filter, no referent to operate on, and no purpose. The removal test passes: filter needs signal to function.

Remove frequency — do intervals stop operating? Yes. Musical intervals and physical intervals are defined as frequency ratios or frequency differences. Without frequency as a concept, intervals cannot be quantified, compared, or used. The removal test passes: interval needs frequency to operate.

Overshoot is a phenomenon observed when a system's response exceeds its target before settling — it is identified through and derived from the impulse-response (or step-response) of a system. Impulse-response existed first as a characterization method, and overshoot is a property derived from analyzing impulse/step responses.

Phase shift is introduced and measured for the sake of measurement — specifically, for determining system delay, phase response, and time-of-flight. Its designed purpose in signal processing and acoustics is to enable phase-based measurements. The servant (phase shift) points at the master (measurement).

Musical and physical intervals are derived from frequency ratios and differences. The concept of interval as a quantified relationship between two frequencies was built upon the pre-existing concept of frequency. Frequency existed first and fed into the interval concept.

Pinned sense: phasor as a representation of sinusoidal signals at a specific frequency. Remove frequency and phasors lose their meaning — a phasor without frequency is just a complex number with no signal to represent. The removal test passes: phasor stops operating as a signal-representation concept without frequency.

Bandwidth is the range of frequencies a system can handle or a signal can occupy. Remove frequency and bandwidth is incoherent — bandwidth is measured in Hz and denotes a frequency span. The removal test passes. Pinned sense: bandwidth as a frequency-domain concept.

Remove frequency and frequency-response has no independent variable — the concept becomes incoherent. A frequency-response is literally a function of frequency. This is a clear object-level dependency, not meta-level: the concept's operation depends on frequency as its defining parameter.

Bandwidth defines the operational range of a frequency-response — the frequency span over which the response is meaningful. Remove bandwidth and frequency-response loses its practical boundary: you cannot determine where the response is relevant without the bandwidth concept. The removal test passes: without bandwidth, a frequency-response cannot specify its domain of validity.

Resistance (DC opposition to current) existed first. Impedance extends this concept to AC circuits by adding frequency-dependent reactance as the imaginary component. The historical and conceptual lineage is clear: resistance is the special case of impedance at zero frequency.

Step-response (Heaviside step input characterization) predates and conceptually feeds into impulse-response (Dirac delta input characterization). Which-came-first test: step-response epoch 0.01, impulse-response epoch 0.18. You can derive impulse-response from step-response via differentiation, establishing the conceptual lineage.

Phase-shift is a concept within frequency response analysis (phase angle shift per frequency). Which-came-first: frequency-response epoch 0.01, phase-shift epoch 0.06. Phase shift is a derived concept within the broader frequency-response framework.

Group-delay requires frequency-response to operate: τ_g(ω) = -dφ/dω is defined as the negative derivative of the phase component of a frequency-response. Without the frequency-response concept, group-delay is incoherent.

Impulse-response requires frequency-response: the two are Fourier transform pairs, and the concept of impulse-response as a system characterization derives from the frequency-response framework. Remove frequency-response and impulse-response loses its broader analytical context.

Reactance (X = ωL or 1/(ωC)) is fundamentally a function of frequency. Remove frequency from the concept and reactance ceases to operate — its defining equations and physical meaning require frequency as a parameter.

Group delay τ_g(ω) = -dφ/dω is the negative derivative of phase with respect to frequency. The phase component provided by phase-shift is constitutive to group-delay's operation — remove phase-shift and group-delay has no definition.

Impulse-response characterizes a system's output by convolving the impulse with the input signal. Convolution is the constitutive operation — remove convolution and impulse-response as a system characterization tool ceases to operate.

A filter is defined by its frequency response (passband, stopband, cutoff). Remove frequency-response and the filter's defining characterization mechanism ceases to operate — filters are designed, specified, and understood through their frequency response.

Overshoot is a feature measured from a step response — the maximum peak above steady-state during the transient. Remove step-response and overshoot as a concept has no measurable referent and ceases to operate.

Group delay was developed as a derived concept from frequency response analysis: τ_g(ω) = -dφ/dω extracts timing information from the phase component of a frequency response. Frequency-response existed as a characterization tool first; group-delay was later derived to describe the temporal consequence of that phase behavior.

Overshoot is a parameter derived from step-response analysis: it quantifies the maximum peak above steady-state during a system's step response. The step-response concept predates overshoot as a named parameter; overshoot was later derived to characterize transient quality in step-response measurements.

Impedance is defined as Z = R + jX, where X is reactance. Reactance is the imaginary component literally contained within the impedance construct — a part-of relationship, not identity or kind. The impedance concept decomposes into two constituent parts: resistance (real) and reactance (imaginary).

Spectral-leakage (epoch 0.99) was understood as an artifact of Fourier analysis before windowing (epoch 2.5) was developed as a mitigation technique. The concept of spectral-leakage existed first and fed into the creation of windowing as a response — which-came-first: spectral-leakage predates windowing by a significant margin.

Impedance is defined as Z = R + jX where X is reactance. Reactance is the imaginary component literally contained within the impedance construct — it is a literal part-of relationship per Law 10. The impedance concept is built from two constituents: resistance (real part) and reactance (imaginary part).

A filter is defined by its frequency-selective behavior — its entire operation is to select, reject, or reshape based on frequency content. Remove frequency from the concept and filter ceases to operate: there is no domain on which a filter operates without frequency. This passes the Law 8 removal test.

Group delay τ_g(ω) = -dφ/dω is the negative derivative of phase with respect to frequency. It fundamentally operates on the concept of phase itself — remove phase and group-delay has no referent. Pinning the sense per Law 11d: we refer to phase (the angular component of a complex signal), not phase-shift (a change in phase).

Ringing is sustained oscillation after a transient in an underdamped system. It requires overshoot — without overshoot there is no initial peak to oscillate around, and ringing ceases. The removal test: remove overshoot and ringing cannot occur.
Ringing is observed and quantified in the step response of a system — the sustained oscillations following a step input. Remove step-response and ringing has no standard test or observation protocol.

Ringing is the concept of sustained oscillation in underdamped systems. Damping is the mechanism that suppresses oscillation — ringing specifically describes what happens when damping is INSUFFICIENT. Remove damping and ringing loses its operational basis: the concept of underdamping is what distinguishes ringing from other oscillatory phenomena.

Spectral leakage is caused by the convolution of the signal spectrum with the window function spectrum in the frequency domain. Remove convolution from the concept and spectral leakage ceases to operate — there is no mechanism for leakage without convolution. The removal test passes: without the convolution mechanism, the concept has no operational basis.

Ringing is a specific kind of oscillation — sustained oscillation after a transient. A competent speaker would call ringing 'a type of oscillation.' Per Law 9, this is INSTANCE_OF, not DEPENDS_ON: it's about kind-of membership, not operational dependency.

Windowing functions are designed and maintained for the sake of measurement accuracy — their entire purpose is to reduce spectral leakage artifacts that would corrupt measurements. The servant (windowing) points at the master (measurement). Per Law 8d: this is teleology, not dependency.

Impedance matching is deliberately designed to ensure reliable signal transmission in communication systems — preventing reflections and power loss. The designed purpose of impedance management is to further communication operation. Per Law 8d: teleological relation, servant (impedance)→master (communication).

Phase-shift is a concept within frequency-domain analysis that represents time-delay relationships. The concept of time existed long before phase-shift as a frequency-domain construct. Which-came-first test: time predates phase-shift.

Ringing is defined as sustained oscillation that occurs AFTER a transient in a system. The transient is the initial response that triggers the oscillatory behavior. Remove the transient and ringing ceases to operate — there is no 'after the transient' without the transient. This passes the removal test (Law 8): ringing's operation requires the transient as its starting condition.
The FFT operates on signal data — it transforms signals from time domain to frequency domain. Remove the concept of signal and the FFT has nothing to operate on; the removal test passes.

Resonance is the phenomenon of amplified oscillation at a specific frequency. Remove frequency and resonance ceases to operate — it is fundamentally defined by the frequency relationship between driving force and natural frequency.

The FFT is a computational algorithm for computing the discrete Fourier transform. Remove computation and the FFT ceases to operate — it is fundamentally a computational procedure. Per Law 8 removal test: the algorithm needs computation to function now.

Phase-shift is a concept within frequency-domain analysis that represents time-delay relationships in terms of frequency. Remove frequency and phase-shift ceases to operate — it is defined by angular frequency relationships. Per Law 8 removal test: the concept's operation requires frequency.

Ringing is the concept of sustained oscillation that occurs when a system is excited — in signal processing, this oscillation IS the system's impulse response manifesting underdamped behavior. Remove the concept of impulse-response and ringing has no operational mechanism: the impulse response defines how any system responds to excitation, and ringing specifically describes the underdamped case of that response. The removal test passes: ringing as a signal-processing concept ceases to operate without impulse-response.

Spectral leakage is the artificial spreading of signal energy across frequency bins in a DFT, caused by the rectangular window's Fourier transform being a sinc function. The sinc function's side lobes are the direct mathematical cause of leakage — energy 'leaks' into adjacent bins because the sinc function has non-zero sidelobes. Remove the concept of the sinc-function and spectral leakage has no mechanism: the spreading of energy IS the sinc function's behavior in the frequency domain. The removal test passes.

Impedance is a complex quantity Z = R + jX, decomposed into two constituent parts: resistance (real) and reactance (imaginary). Reactance is literally one of the two parts that make up impedance as a whole — a structural decomposition, not an incidental property. CONTAINS is the right arrow (whole→part, Law 10).

A filter operates by selecting or blocking frequency components. Remove frequency from the conceptual vocabulary and filter has no operational mechanism — its entire function (passband, stopband, cutoff) is defined in terms of frequency. The removal test passes: no frequency concept, no filter concept. Constitutive dependency, not mere association.

Bandwidth is operationally defined as the range of frequencies where a system's frequency response meets performance criteria (e.g., -3dB points). Remove frequency-response and bandwidth ceases to have any operational definition — it is not a standalone concept but a derived measure of frequency-response shape.

Attack is the initial rising phase of a transient envelope — a structural component. Transient as a temporal construct CONTAINS attack (rise), decay, sustain, and release as constituent temporal parts. This is a whole-to-part decomposition of the transient envelope.

Group delay is operationally defined as the negative derivative of phase-shift with respect to angular frequency. Remove phase-shift and group delay ceases to have any operational definition — it is not a standalone concept but a rate-of-change measure derived from phase-shift behavior.

The Nyquist criterion is a specific theorem in signal processing — a provable statement about sampling rates. 'A theorem' is the nearest kind. Law 11c acknowledges universality but does not bar the edge.

Aliasing is the artifact that occurs specifically when the Nyquist criterion is violated. The concept of aliasing is only meaningful in relation to the Nyquist limit: remove the Nyquist criterion (the rule about minimum sampling rate) and aliasing ceases to be a defined concept — it stops operating as a signal-processing diagnostic.

spectral-leakage is the artificial spreading of signal energy across frequency bins in a discrete Fourier transform. It is defined entirely within the context of DFT analysis. zero-padding is a signal-processing technique where zeros are appended to a discrete signal before computing its DFT, to improve interpolated frequency resolution. spectral-leakage is a specific kind of estimation error: the artificial spreading of signal energy across frequency bins in a DFT that does not reflect the true signal spectrum. Anti-aliasing-filter is a signal-processing circuit or algorithm designed for the sake of sampling — it attenuates out-of-band frequencies to ensure sampling produces faithful discrete representations. Its entire design purpose is to serve sampling quality.

Convolution serves measurement: it is the fundamental operation for characterizing system responses through measured impulse responses and for extracting signal properties via matched-filter detection. Overshoot is a constituent feature of transient response — the initial peak exceeding the final value during the transient phase. In engineering practice, overshoot is treated as one of the key components (alongside rise time, settling time, and ringing) that characterize the transient response.

Ringing is specifically sustained oscillation in underdamped systems. Remove the concept of damping and the ringing concept — as underdamped oscillation persisting after excitation — ceases to operate. The underdamped/overdamped distinction is fundamental to defining what ringing is.

Spectral density analysis is designed for the purpose of measuring how signal power distributes across frequencies. Its entire utility in engineering is to provide a measured quantity — the spectral density — that serves measurement tasks in audio, RF, and vibration analysis.

Frequency resolution as a signal-processing parameter is designed to serve measurement accuracy — it defines the finest detail at which a system can distinguish separate frequency components. Its purpose is to enable precise frequency measurement, not to describe a physical property.

A power spectrum is computed to measure the distribution of signal power across frequency bins. Its designed purpose is to serve measurement of power content — it is an instrument of spectral measurement, not a standalone physical description.

Damping as a concept (energy dissipation in oscillating systems) predates ringdown. Ringdown describes the specific observable phenomenon — the decaying oscillation — that results from damping. Digital identity is a construct built and maintained specifically for the sake of authentication — its designed purpose is to verify identity in digital contexts. Spectral leakage IS a specific kind of artifact — an unintended consequence introduced by the analysis method (Fourier transform on finite-length signals). Ringdown IS a specific kind of transient response — it is the decaying oscillation that occurs when a system returns to equilibrium after a disturbance. A competent speaker calls ringdown 'a transient response'. Law 9.

Window functions are designed and applied specifically to improve spectral analysis — their purpose is to reduce spectral leakage and improve frequency resolution. The Laplace transform generalizes the Fourier transform — it existed after FT and built upon it. Digital archives are deliberately designed and maintained for the sake of memory — they preserve information for future retrieval, continuity, and historical preservation. The purpose is by institutional design, not incidental. Law 8d: servant (digital-archive) points at master (memory).

Spectral resolution — the ability to distinguish adjacent frequency components — is fundamentally limited by filter design. Spectral leakage (energy spreading across frequency bins due to finite observation) was identified first, and window functions (Hamming, Hanning, etc.) were derived specifically to mitigate it. The which-came-first test passes: the problem predates the solution.

A cepstral coefficient is a specific type of signal feature — a numerical representation extracted from a signal that captures distinctive characteristics. A competent speaker would call a cepstral coefficient 'a feature.' INSTANCE_OF direction (specific→general) is correct.

A calculator operates on numbers — arithmetic computation is its entire function. Remove the concept of number and a calculator cannot operate: there would be nothing to calculate. The removal test is conclusive.

The magnitude spectrum is obtained by applying a frequency-domain transform (Fourier, Laplace, or Z-transform) to a signal. Remove the Fourier transform concept and the magnitude spectrum cannot be computed — the amplitude values at each frequency are the modulus of the complex transform output. This is an operational dependency.

The cepstrum (quefrency-domain representation) was derived from the cepstral-analysis technique (Bogert 1963). The technique came first and produced the cepstrum as its output concept. Which-came-first test passes.

Cepstral analysis fundamentally relies on the Fourier transform — its core operation is the inverse FT of the log magnitude spectrum. The Fourier transform (1822) predates cepstral analysis (1963). Which-came-first test passes.

Cepstral analysis takes the logarithm of the magnitude spectrum as a core step. The mathematical concept of logarithm (1614, Napier) predates cepstral analysis (1963) by centuries. Which-came-first test passes.

Cepstrum is a specific kind of spectral analysis — it represents a signal's spectral content in the quefrency domain rather than the frequency domain. A competent speaker calls a cepstrum 'a form of spectral analysis.' Nearest kind is spectral-analysis (not a leap to a higher category).

Cepstral analysis is a specific kind of spectral analysis technique — it analyzes spectral content by transforming to the quefrency domain. A competent speaker would call cepstral analysis 'a type of spectral analysis.' Files against nearest kind.

Power spectrum is a specific kind of spectral analysis — it represents the distribution of signal power across frequency. A competent speaker would call a power spectrum 'a form of spectral analysis.' Files against nearest kind.

Cepstrum is designed and maintained for the sake of diagnostic applications. In practice, cepstral analysis extracts features from vibration signals to detect bearing faults, gear defects, and machinery anomalies — the quefrency-domain representation separates convolution components, enabling diagnostic feature extraction that frequency-domain methods cannot achieve. Its designed purpose in industrial applications is to further diagnostic operations.

Calculator is designed and maintained for the sake of computation — its purpose is to perform arithmetic and mathematical operations on behalf of the user. Remove computation from the picture and the calculator has no purpose. Law 8d: X SERVES Y means X is built for the sake of Y.

Shelf is a specific kind of apparatus — a flat passive artifact designed to support and hold objects. A competent speaker would describe a shelf as 'a piece of apparatus' for storage. The shelf extends human storage capacity through a simple physical structure.

Calculator operates on numbers — remove number as a mathematical concept and the calculator cannot function. The removal test (Law 8) passes: X stops OPERATING without Y. Calculator needs number to compute anything.

The magnitude spectrum is designed and maintained for the sake of analysis — it maps each frequency to its amplitude to enable inspection of a signal's spectral content. Remove analysis as the purpose and the magnitude spectrum has no reason to exist; it is a tool built to serve analytical inquiry into signals.

The concept of quefrency was invented by Bogert (1963) within the framework of cepstral analysis and has no operational meaning outside it. Remove cepstral analysis and quefrency ceases to operate — there is no independent use for the quefrency concept. This is constitutive: quefrency is defined by its role within cepstral analysis.

Spectral centroid is a spectral feature computed to serve analysis — it represents the center of mass of a spectrum, used in audio and signal analysis to characterize timbre and spectral shape. Remove analysis as its purpose and it has no standalone function. Its designed purpose is to further analytical understanding of signals.

Calculator is designed and maintained for the sake of arithmetic — it performs arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division) on behalf of users. Remove arithmetic and the calculator has no purpose. The teleological arrow points correctly: servant (calculator)→master (arithmetic).

The concept of aliasing as a named signal processing phenomenon emerged from the practice of sampling — it was identified when engineers noticed that undersampling caused different frequency components to become indistinguishable. Sampling (the practice) predates aliasing (the concept). The which-came-first test: sampling existed first and fed into the concept of aliasing.

Spectral leakage's magnitude is directly controlled by the window function applied to the signal. Remove window-function and spectral leakage (as a quantifiable phenomenon in spectral estimation) stops operating — the leakage would be unbounded and undefined. The window function determines the leakage pattern through its Fourier transform properties.

Spectral centroid is computed from the magnitude spectrum: it is the center of mass of the spectrum, calculated as the weighted average of frequencies using magnitudes as weights. Magnitude spectrum existed first as a representation; spectral centroid is derived from it. Which came first? The magnitude spectrum representation predates the centroid statistic.

Magnitude spectrum maps each frequency to its amplitude — it is a specific kind of spectrum. The filer pins the sense: magnitude (amplitude vs. frequency), not phase spectrum or complex spectrum. Law 9: magnitude-spectrum is a specific case of the general spectrum.

Cepstral analysis operates through the cepstrum — it is the process of analyzing via quefrency-domain transformation. Remove cepstrum and cepstral analysis ceases to operate: the removal test passes. Law 8: present-tense operational dependency, not mere historical association.

Magnitude spectrum is computed from the Fourier transform — the FT existed first as a mathematical tool (1822), and the magnitude spectrum representation (magnitude vs. frequency) was derived from it by taking the absolute value of complex FT coefficients. Which-came-first test: FT predates magnitude spectrum.

Linearity as a mathematical/system property was derived from the ancient concept of proportionality — the homogeneity part of linearity (f(ax)=af(x)) is the generalization of proportionality from scalars to functions. Which-came-first: proportionality is ancient (Euclid's Book V), linearity as a formal property came much later.

The discrete Fourier transform was derived from the continuous Fourier transform by extending it to discrete sequences. FT existed first as a mathematical tool (1822); DFT was derived from it as the discrete analog. Which came first test: FT predates DFT and fed into DFT's formulation.

Cepstral analysis is a specific kind of signal processing technique — it transforms and analyzes signals in the cepstral (quefrency) domain. A competent speaker would describe cepstral analysis as a signal processing method. Nearest kind per Law 9.

Cepstral analysis operates through the FFT which is a linear transform. Remove linearity and the FFT stops operating correctly — cepstral analysis collapses because its core computation requires the linear superposition property. This is a present-tense operational dependency (Law 8), not a meta-level observation.

Cepstrum is a specific kind of variable — it is the independent variable in the cepstral (quefrency) domain. A competent speaker would describe the cepstrum as a variable representing time-like distances in the frequency domain. Law 9.

SNR is designed and maintained for the sake of analysis — it quantifies signal quality to serve analytical assessment in communications, audio, and measurement. The engineered purpose is to provide a basis for analytical decisions (Law 8d: for whose sake?).

Spectral centroid is computed as the center of mass of the magnitude spectrum — a weighted average of frequencies using magnitudes as weights. Remove the magnitude spectrum and spectral centroid computation stops operating entirely. Law 8 present-tense removal test passes.

The cepstrum is computed from the magnitude spectrum: take the log of the magnitude spectrum, then apply the inverse Fourier transform. The magnitude spectrum existed first as a concept; the cepstrum was derived from it.

Filter design is a specific technique within the field of signal processing — it designs filters to shape signal spectra. A competent speaker would describe filter design as 'a signal processing technique.' INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.
Spectral analysis is a specific signal processing technique that examines the frequency content of signals. A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing method.' INSTANCE_OF per Law 9.

Cepstrum is a signal processing technique for analyzing signals in the quefrency domain. A competent speaker would describe cepstrum as 'a signal processing method.' INSTANCE_OF direction specific→general is correct.

The concept of cepstrum-coefficient needs the concept of cepstrum to operate: coefficients are defined as values within the cepstrum. Remove cepstrum and cepstrum-coefficients cease to have any operational meaning. This passes the removal test of Law 8.

The power spectrum is computed as the squared magnitude of the Fourier transform. Remove fourier-transform and the power spectrum has no operational basis — it cannot be computed or defined without it. Removal test passes: X without Y ceases to operate.

The cepstrum is the sequence of cepstrum-coefficients indexed by quefrency. Each cepstrum-coefficient is a constituent part — the cepstrum IS the collection of these values, making this a whole-part relation.

The cepstrum computation fundamentally requires the discrete Fourier transform: cepstrum = IDFT(log(|DFT(x)|²)). Remove DFT and the cepstrum cannot be computed. The DFT concept predates cepstrum (1820s vs 1963).

The cepstrum-coefficient is computed via the inverse DFT of the log-power spectrum: c[n] = IDFT(log(|X[k]|²)). The DFT concept (1820s) predates cepstral coefficients (1963, Bogert). Which-came-first test passes: DFT existed first and fed into cepstrum-coefficient.

The cepstrum-coefficient is computed as IDFT(log(|X[k]|²)). The logarithm concept (1600s, Napier/Bregg) predates cepstrum-coefficients (1963, Bogert). Logarithm is used as the mathematical machinery in the computation. Which-came-first test passes.

Quefrency is the independent variable of the cepstrum domain. The cepstrum as a whole concept CONTAINS quefrency as a constituent dimensional concept — it is a part of how the cepstrum is defined and operates.

Cepstrum-coefficient needs quefrency as its independent variable dimension. Remove the concept of quefrency (the time-like axis in the cepstral domain) and cepstrum-coefficients lose the conceptual framework that gives them meaning and order — they become an unindexed bag of numbers rather than a meaningful sequence.

The cepstrum representation exists to support cepstral-analysis as a diagnostic technique. The designed purpose of the cepstrum concept is to further cepstral-analysis — its application in fault detection, speech processing, and audio analysis. For whose sake? The cepstral-analysis (Law 8d: servant→master).

Spectral-centroid is computed as the weighted mean frequency of the power spectrum: Σf·P(f)/ΣP(f). Remove the power-spectrum concept and the spectral-centroid cannot be computed — it is literally the center-of-mass of the power spectrum. The removal test passes: no power-spectrum, no spectral-centroid.

Cepstrum-coefficients are computed (c[n]=IDFT(log|X[k]|²)) specifically to enable spectral analysis of signals — their designed purpose is to further spectral-analysis as a diagnostic technique in fault detection, speech processing, and engineering. The coefficients serve the analysis, not the other way around.

Statistical-analysis needs measurement to operate: data must be measured before it can be analyzed. Remove measurement and there is no data to subject to statistical techniques. This passes the present-tense removal test.
Statistical-analysis needs data to operate: remove the concept of data and the entire practice loses its subject matter. The removal test passes — statistical-analysis cannot function without data.

A cepstrum-coefficient is a characteristic extracted from a signal for analysis purposes. It is a specific kind of feature used in signal processing and pattern recognition (e.g. MFCC features in speech processing).

Cepstrum-coefficients are computed specifically to serve signal-processing: they are features extracted from signals for pattern recognition within signal-processing pipelines (speech recognition, fault detection). For whose sake? The coefficients point at signal-processing as their master domain.

SNR needs measurement to operate now: remove the concept of measurement and SNR has no data to compute — signal power and noise power are both measurement-derived quantities. The removal test passes: no measurement, no SNR operation.

Magnitude-spectrum is computed specifically to serve signal-processing: it represents signal power distribution across frequency for diagnostic and analytical purposes. For whose sake? The spectrum points at signal-processing as its master domain.

Cepstrum-coefficients are computed from the power spectrum (c[n]=IDFT(log|X[k]|²)). Remove the power-spectrum concept and cepstrum-coefficients cannot be computed — the removal test passes as present-tense operational necessity.

Cepstral-analysis is the analysis technique performed IN THE cepstral domain, specifically for extracting features from signals. For whose sake? Signal-processing — cepstral methods (MFCC, etc.) are designed as diagnostic tools within signal-processing pipelines.

Spectral-analysis extracts frequency-domain information from signals for diagnostic purposes. For whose sake? Signal-processing — spectral analysis is a core technique within signal-processing, not a standalone practice.

MFCC is a feature extraction technique specifically designed for signal-processing applications (speech recognition, audio classification). For whose sake? Signal-processing — the entire pipeline (Mel filterbank, DCT) exists to serve diagnostic analysis of signals. Valid SERVES (Law 8d).

MFCC builds on the cepstrum-coefficient concept: it computes coefficients in the cepstral domain (log power spectrum via DCT). Cepstrum-coefficient as a mathematical concept existed before MFCC was devised. Which came first? cepstrum-coefficient. Valid DERIVED_FROM (Law 7).

Cepstral coefficients are computed as IDFT of the log power spectrum. The IDFT is the inverse Fourier transform, which is a direct application of Fourier analysis. Remove the Fourier-transform concept and cepstrum computation has no mathematical operation to perform. The removal test passes: cepstrum-coefficient stops operating without Fourier-transform.

SNR is a ratio of signal power to noise power. The concept of power (in physics/engineering) predates SNR by centuries. SNR derives from applying the power concept to compare signal vs noise levels. Which came first? Power measurements and concepts existed long before SNR was formalized.

Autocorrelation is computed via the Wiener-Khinchin theorem: autocorrelation function = IDFT of power spectrum. The standard computational method (FFT-based) requires Fourier transform. Remove Fourier-transform and autocorrelation has no efficient computational method — it stops operating in practice. The removal test passes operationally.

MFCC is a specific kind of cepstral analysis — it applies cepstral-domain methods (Mel filterbank + DCT) to extract features. A competent speaker would call MFCC 'a cepstral analysis technique'. Nearest kind: cepstral-analysis already exists as the general method class.

The cepstrum was developed and is maintained for the sake of signal processing — speech analysis, fault detection, and related applications. For whose sake? Signal processing. The cepstrum is a tool designed to serve signal processing tasks.

The mel-scale was created and is maintained for the sake of signal-processing — specifically speech recognition, audio analysis, and music information retrieval. For whose sake? Signal-processing. The scale is a tool designed to serve this domain's need for perceptually-uniform frequency representation. SERVES direction (servant→master) is correct.

MFCC as a concept contains the cepstral-domain as a constituent part — the MFCC pipeline is defined by transforming signals into the cepstral domain, and the domain concept is constitutive to MFCC's operation. The cepstral-domain is a structural component of what MFCC is.

The cepstral-domain is the whole representational space; the cepstrum is a constitutive part within it — the domain is defined by the cepstrum function plotted against quefrency. Whole-and-part relation: the domain concept contains the cepstrum concept as its defining element.

MFCC was derived from the cepstrum concept: the cepstrum (Bell Labs, 1963) predates MFCC (1980s). MFCC extends the cepstrum idea by adding Mel-scale filterbanks and DCT for speech processing. Which came first? Cepstrum — unambiguously historical.

MFCC derives from the mel-scale: the mel-scale (Stevens et al. 1937) predates MFCC by decades. MFCC uses triangular mel-scale filterbanks as its core frequency warping mechanism. Which came first? Mel-scale — unambiguously historical.

Cepstrum-coefficient operates within the cepstral-domain representational space. Remove the cepstral-domain concept and cepstrum-coefficient cannot be defined or computed. Present-tense operational dependency.

The cepstral-domain concept was derived from the power spectrum: the construction procedure takes the power spectrum → log → IDFT. Which came first? Power spectrum (Fourier analysis concept, predates cepstrum by decades). Historical derivation.

Mel-filterbank (1980s, newer) derives from mel-scale (Stevens et al. 1937, older). The filterbank is built by applying triangular windows spaced according to the mel scale. Which-came-first: mel-scale predates mel-filterbank by decades.

A unit is a human-made standard of measurement designed for the purpose of quantifying physical and abstract quantities. Per Law 8d: unit SERVES measurement — the entire reason a unit exists is for the sake of measurement. Without measurement as its purpose, a unit would have no function.

Sympathy (as a concept of emotional resonance and understanding between persons) is a human-made social construct designed for the purpose of facilitating interpersonal communication and emotional connection. Per Law 8d: sympathy SERVES communication — it is built/maintained for the sake of enabling communication between people.

The cepstrum is computed as the inverse Fourier transform of the log of the Fourier transform of a signal. Remove the Fourier transform and the cepstral domain cannot operate — the cepstrum is defined through it. Present-tense constitutive dependency (Law 8), not mere historical association.

The mel scale is a perceptual frequency scale: m = 2595 * log10(1 + f/700). It maps physical frequency (Hz) to perceived pitch. Remove the concept of frequency and the mel scale has nothing to map from — it stops operating entirely. This is a present-tense constitutive dependency (Law 8), not just historical.

MFCC (mel-frequency cepstral coefficients) is designed and maintained for the purpose of extracting spectral features from audio signals. Its built purpose is to serve spectral analysis — specifically, to provide a compact, perceptually-motivated representation of the spectrum for downstream processing. Per Law 8d: servant→master, MFCC points to spectral-analysis as its designed purpose.

Harmonic is a specific kind of overtone: an overtone whose frequency is exactly an integer multiple of the fundamental. A competent speaker would describe a harmonic as a kind of overtone. Per Law 9: specific→general. Not all overtones are harmonics (inharmonic overtones exist), but every harmonic is an overtone.

The cepstral domain is a mathematical framework deliberately designed and maintained for the purpose of signal processing — specifically for extracting features from signals that are not easily captured in the frequency domain. Per Law 8d: cepstral-domain SERVES signal-processing because its designed purpose is to further signal-processing operations. The servant (cepstral domain) points at the master (signal processing).

MFCC is deliberately designed and maintained for the sake of pattern recognition — specifically audio-based pattern recognition tasks like speech recognition and speaker identification. Per Law 8d: the designed purpose of MFCC is to serve pattern recognition operations. The servant (mfcc) points at the master (pattern recognition).
The cepstral domain contains quefrency as its fundamental dimension — just as the frequency domain contains frequency, the cepstral domain is organized around quefrency. Law 10: whole-and-part.

MFCC is a specific type of feature used in speech recognition and audio analysis. A competent speaker would describe MFCC as 'a feature'. Nearest kind: feature (my accepted cepstrum-coefficient INSTANCE_OF feature confirms feature is the general class).

MFCC was specifically designed and is maintained for speech recognition — it extracts spectral features optimized for distinguishing phonemes and words. Law 8d: for whose sake? Speech recognition. The servant (MFCC) points at the master (speech recognition).

The mel filterbank is a specific kind of filter (a bank of triangular bandpass filters spaced on the mel perceptual scale) used in signal processing. A competent speaker would describe it as 'a filter'. Direction is specific→general (Law 9). Filter is the nearest accepted kind.

The cepstrum is designed and maintained for the purpose of anomaly detection — particularly in signal processing for detecting echoes, periodic structures, and anomalies in audio and mechanical signals. Law 8d: for whose sake? The servant (cepstrum) points at the master (anomaly-detection). Designed purpose.

A cepstrum-coefficient requires quefrency to operate — the coefficient IS a value measured in quefrency units. Remove quefrency (the conceptual dimension of the cepstral domain) and the coefficient has no operational meaning. This is present-tense operation, not historical origin.

The cepstrum (the function/operation) existed first and fed into the cepstrum-coefficient (the numerical values extracted from it). Which came first: the cepstrum concept, or its coefficients? The cepstrum came first — coefficients are derived values from the cepstrum function.

The mel filterbank is deliberately designed and maintained for spectral analysis — it shapes the frequency response to match human perception, enabling spectral feature extraction. Law 8d: for whose sake? Spectral analysis.

The mel filterbank is a deliberate component of the MFCC computation pipeline — it shapes frequency response into mel-scaled bands before cepstral coefficient extraction. MFCC as a whole is designed to consume the mel filterbank's output. Law 8d: for whose sake? MFCC.

A cepstrum-coefficient operates only within the conceptual space of the cepstral domain — it IS a value in quefrency, the domain's dimension. Remove the cepstral domain concept and the coefficient has no operational meaning (not merely sayability — its mathematical definition presupposes the cepstral domain). Removal test: the coefficient's operation requires the domain to exist as its conceptual space.

The cepstrum was introduced by Bogert, Healy, and Harris in 1963 as a mathematical operation. Cepstral liftering — applying a window in the cepstral domain — is a later technique that builds on the cepstrum concept. Which came first: the cepstrum, or liftering? The cepstrum came first.

Cepstral liftering is designed and maintained for the sake of speech recognition — it smooths spectral envelopes in feature extraction (e.g., delta-delta MFCC computation) and is a standard step in speech processing pipelines. The lifter exists to serve the speech recognition task.

Zero-crossing-rate is a specific kind of audio feature: a numerical descriptor computed from a signal for use in classification and analysis. A competent speaker would call ZCR 'a feature' — it is a standard feature in audio analysis and music information retrieval.

The mel filterbank operates on the frequency spectrum — it maps physical frequency bins into mel-scaled bands. Remove the concept of frequency and the filterbank has no input to operate on. The removal test passes: no frequency, no filterbank.

Spectral-flatness is a specific kind of signal processing feature — a numerical descriptor computed from a power spectrum for use in classification and analysis. A competent speaker would call spectral-flatness 'a feature'. INSTANCE_OF direction (specific→general) is correct.

The cepstrum is used for the sake of speech recognition — it enables spectral envelope estimation, which is central to phoneme identification and speech feature extraction. Cepstral analysis (including MFCC) is a standard component of speech processing pipelines.
The cepstral domain is the conceptual space parameterized by quefrency. Quefrency is the fundamental dimension of the cepstral domain — it is contained within the domain as its defining parameter.

Spectral-flatness is computed directly FROM a power spectrum — it is the ratio of geometric to arithmetic mean of spectral power values. Remove the power spectrum and spectral-flatness has no input to operate on; the removal test passes.
Spectral-flux measures the rate of change of the power spectrum over time. It operates on the power spectrum — remove it and spectral-flux has no input to operate on. Removal test passes.

The cepstrum is designed for the sake of pattern recognition — it extracts structural features from signals (spectral envelopes via quefrency analysis) that are used in classification, anomaly detection, and recognition tasks. Direction: cepstrum (servant) → pattern-recognition (master).

The cepstral domain was derived from the fourier-transform: Bogert, Healy, and Harris (1963) computed the cepstrum by applying the FFT to the power spectrum. Which came first: fourier-transform (1822/1827, Fourier) or cepstral domain (1963)? The fourier-transform is older and fed directly into the construction of the cepstral domain.

Spectral-flux is a specific kind of signal processing feature — a numerical descriptor measuring power spectrum change over time. A competent speaker would call spectral-flux 'a feature.' Files against nearest kind (Law 9), consistent with spectral-flatness also being a feature.

Cepstral liftering smooths spectral envelopes which are used as features in pattern recognition (speech, audio classification). It is designed for the sake of pattern recognition pipelines. SERVES direction correct: liftering→pattern-recognition.

Cepstral liftering operates within the cepstral domain (quefrency space). Cepstral-domain (epoch 0.15, 1963) predates liftering (epoch 0.82). Which came first: cepstral-domain. DERIVED_FROM correct direction, Law 7.

MFCC computation produces cepstral coefficients via mel-scale DCT pipeline. Cepstral-coefficient concept (1963) predates MFCC feature extraction (late 1980s). Which came first: cepstral-coefficient. DERIVED_FROM direction correct, Law 7.

Spectral-centroid computes the center of mass of a spectrum — it is a specific kind of signal processing feature. Files against nearest kind. A competent speaker would call spectral-centroid 'a feature'.

Cepstrum computes the quefrency-domain representation of a signal — it is a specific kind of signal processing feature. Files against nearest kind. A competent speaker would call cepstrum 'a feature'.

Zero-crossing-rate counts how many times a signal crosses its zero baseline per unit time. This requires measurement of amplitude crossings over a time window. Remove measurement and the concept stops operating — you cannot count or rate zero crossings without measuring amplitude and time intervals.

Cepstral-subtraction estimates and removes noise from the cepstrum. It operates on cepstral representations. Remove cepstrum and cepstral-subtraction cannot operate — it has no domain to work in. The removal test passes: the concept requires the cepstrum to function.

Harmonic (the overtone concept) is built for musical analysis — it explains how sounds combine in music, guides instrument design, and underpins musical notation. Its designed purpose is to further music's operation and understanding.

The concept of harmonic requires frequency as its operative dimension — harmonics are integer multiples of a fundamental frequency. Remove frequency (the concept of periodic rate) and the concept of harmonic cannot operate: there is no domain in which to locate or compute a harmonic.

Arithmetic operates on numbers — addition, subtraction, multiplication, division are all operations defined over numbers. Remove the concept of number and arithmetic stops operating: there is nothing to operate on.

Spectral analysis decomposes signals into their frequency components. Remove frequency (the concept of periodic rate per unit time) and spectral analysis cannot operate: frequency IS the domain it analyzes. The removal test passes — no frequency concept means no spectral analysis.

Zero-crossing-rate operates as a signal processing technique — counting signal zero crossings requires signal processing methodology. Remove signal processing as a framework and zero-crossing-rate has no operational context. The removal test passes.

The cepstrum is a specific kind of technique within homomorphic filtering — it applies a logarithmic transform, FFT, and inverse FFT to produce a quefrency-domain representation. A competent speaker would describe the cepstrum as 'a homomorphic filtering technique.' Files against the nearest kind (Law 9): homomorphic-filtering is the nearest established type, not an abstract universal. The note pins the sense of cepstrum as the signal processing technique, matching its accepted definition.

Each cepstral coefficient is a value indexed by quefrency — the quefrency parameter determines which coefficient is being referenced. Remove quefrency as the quefrency-domain measure and a cepstral coefficient loses its defining parameter: there is no way to identify, order, or distinguish coefficients without quefrency. The removal test passes operationally.

MFCC computation uses cepstral liftering (cepstral-domain windowing) to smooth the cepstral coefficients and isolate the spectral envelope from fine structure. Remove liftering from the MFCC pipeline and the resulting coefficients lose their intended smoothing purpose — they become raw cepstral coefficients, not mel-frequency cepstral coefficients as used in speech recognition. Liftering is a designed step in the MFCC procedure.

Homomorphic filtering (the log-FFT-iFFT technique) existed first and produced the cepstrum as its output representation. The quefrency-domain concept was derived from the homomorphic filtering pipeline — ask which existed first: homomorphic filtering predates and feeds into the cepstrum.
