Cepstral liftering is a technique that applies windowing in the cepstral (quefrency) domain to smooth spectral coefficients. It is a specific kind of signal processing operation.

Homomorphic filtering operates by first taking the logarithm of the signal (converting convolution into addition), then FFT, then filtering in frequency domain, then IFFT, then exponential. The logarithmic transform is the indispensable first step — remove it and the technique cannot convert multiplicative convolution into additive operations. This is a present-tense operational dependency, not historical association.

Spectral contrast measures the difference between peaks and valleys in the power spectrum, producing a feature vector that captures the tonal characteristics of a sound. It was specifically designed and is maintained for the purpose of timbre analysis and musical instrument classification. The designed purpose is to serve timbre representation — spectral contrast → timbre follows the servant→master direction of SERVES.

Cepstral liftering applies windowing in the quefrency (cepstral) domain to smooth the cepstral coefficients, which directly produces a smoothed spectral envelope estimate. It is specifically designed and used for spectral envelope extraction — removing liftering from an envelope estimation pipeline destroys the smoothing that defines the technique. Liftering exists for the sake of spectral-envelope estimation.

Spectral contrast quantifies the difference between peaks and valleys in a spectral representation — this computation fundamentally requires the power spectral density as input. Remove the power spectrum and spectral contrast has no data to operate on. This is a present-tense operational dependency: spectral contrast cannot function without the power spectrum as its computational substrate.
Spectral rolloff is a specific kind of spectral feature used in audio analysis. A competent speaker describes it as a feature — it quantifies a property of the spectral energy distribution.

Cepstral subtraction is a noise-reduction technique that operates on cepstral coefficients, subtracting noise-dominated coefficients from speech coefficients. The cepstral coefficients (the DCT-based quefrency-domain representation) existed first and provided the representational basis that cepstral subtraction derives from. Ask which existed first: cepstral coefficients (derived from homomorphic filtering in the 1970s) predate the cepstral subtraction technique.

Cepstral subtraction is a specific technique within the broader domain of signal processing. It manipulates signals in the cepstral domain to remove noise — a clear case of signal processing. A competent speaker would describe it as a kind of signal processing.

Homomorphic filtering is a specific technique within signal processing that separates convolution into additive components via a transform domain. It operates on signals to extract desired properties — squarely within signal processing. A competent speaker would describe it as a kind of signal processing.

Spectral contrast is a specific kind of audio feature — it measures the difference between peaks and valleys in the power spectrum, producing a feature vector for timbre characterization. A competent speaker would call it 'a feature'. Per Law 9, this is clean INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind.

Homomorphic filtering operates directly on the cepstrum — it applies filtering in the quefrency (cepstral) domain. Per Law 8's removal test: remove cepstrum and homomorphic filtering stops operating. This is a present-tense operational dependency, distinct from the existing DERIVED_FROM which records historical precedence.

Zero-crossing-rate counts the rate at which a waveform crosses zero amplitude. Per Law 8's removal test: remove the waveform and ZCR has nothing to measure — the computation stops operating. Genuine operational dependency.

Spectral rolloff computes the frequency below which X% of total spectral energy is contained — this requires a power spectrum as input to accumulate magnitudes. Remove the power spectrum and spectral rolloff cannot operate. Genuine DEPENDS_ON per Law 8's removal test.

MFCC computation applies a mel-scale filterbank to the FFT output as a necessary step — remove the mel-filterbank and MFCC cannot produce mel-scaled representations. Present-tense operational dependency per Law 8.

Cepstral subtraction is a noise-reduction technique designed to improve speech signal quality for downstream speech recognition. Its purpose is to further speech recognition's operation by removing noise contamination from cepstral features. SERVES per Law 8d — for whose sake? Cepstral subtraction → speech recognition.

Spectral rolloff is designed and maintained for the purpose of characterizing timbre — it captures the spectral centroid-like property of where energy concentrates, directly relating to the perceptual attribute of brightness/timbre. Per Law 8d: for whose sake? The rolloff feature points at timbre as its master.

Cepstral liftering applies a quefrency-domain window to the cepstrum to isolate or modify specific quefrency components. It operates directly on the cepstrum — remove the cepstrum as an object and liftering has nothing to apply the window to. Present-tense operational dependency per Law 8.

Cepstral subtraction operates on cepstral coefficients — it subtracts noise-dominated coefficients from speech coefficients. Remove cepstral coefficients as the operand and subtraction has nothing to operate on. Present-tense operational dependency per Law 8.

The mel-scale filterbank was developed first as a model of human auditory frequency resolution (Byrne and Greenberg, 1981). The mel-spectrum is computed by applying this pre-existing filterbank to a power spectrum. Which-came-first test: filterbank concept predates mel-spectrum as a named construct.

Mel spectrum is computed and maintained for the purpose of furthering speech recognition. Its mel-frequency channelization approximates human auditory perception, making it an effective front-end for speech feature extraction. By design, the mel-spectrum exists to serve speech recognition systems.

MFCC is computed from the mel-spectrum via discrete cosine transform of its log values. The mel-spectrum concept and computation predates the named MFCC construct (Davis and Mermelstein, 1980). Which-came-first: mel-spectrum existed first and fed into MFCC creation.

A cepstrum coefficient is a specific kind of cepstral coefficient — it is the numerical value at a specific quefrency point in a cepstrum. Cepstral coefficient is the general category of coefficients in any cepstral representation; cepstrum coefficient refers specifically to values in the quefrency-domain cepstrum.

MFCC is a specific kind of cepstral coefficient — it uses Mel-frequency scale cepstral coefficients extracted via DCT from a mel-spectrum. A competent speaker in signal processing would call MFCC 'a type of cepstral coefficient'.

The cepstral domain is a representational space for signal analysis. Cepstral coefficients are the fundamental numerical parameters that populate this domain — each coefficient is a value at a specific quefrency point. The domain CONTAINS these coefficients as its constitutive elements.
Quefrency is the fundamental dimension/axis of the cepstral domain, analogous to frequency in the Fourier domain. It is a conceptual element contained within and constitutive of the cepstral domain.

The cepstrum contains quefrency as a fundamental dimension — each point in the cepstrum is indexed by quefrency. Just as the cepstral domain contains quefrency, the cepstrum itself (as a concrete representation) contains it as a constitutive parameter.

The cepstrum is a concrete representation that requires the cepstral domain as its conceptual framework. Remove the cepstral domain concept and the cepstrum loses its organizing framework — it cannot operate as a representational concept without the domain that defines its space.

A cepstral coefficient is a numerical value at a specific quefrency point. Remove quefrency as the indexing dimension and the coefficient loses its positional meaning — it cannot operate as a coefficient without the quefrency axis that gives it a coordinate.

The mel-spectrum is computed by applying the mel filterbank to a power spectrum. Remove the power spectrum and there is no input to transform — the mel-spectrum computation stops entirely. Present-tense dependency confirmed.

A formant is a resonance peak in the vocal tract transfer function that shapes which harmonics are amplified. Remove harmonics (the discrete spectral components produced by vocal fold vibration) and there is nothing for the formant to shape — the formant concept loses its function as a spectral envelope modulator of harmonic content. Present-tense dependency.

Onset detection identifies the beginning of acoustic events by analyzing changes in the spectral representation (energy, spectral flux, spectral contrast). Remove the spectral representation and onset detection has no signal to analyze — it stops operating entirely. Clear present-tense dependency.

Spectral bandwidth measures the range of frequencies covered by a spectral representation. Remove the spectral representation and there is no spectrum to measure bandwidth across — the concept of spectral bandwidth loses its referent. Present-tense dependency.

Spectral bandwidth is a specific kind of signal processing concept: it measures the spread of frequencies in a spectral representation, a technique used throughout signal analysis. 'Spectral bandwidth is a signal processing measure' — competent speakers would call it a Y.
Sympathy is a specific kind of emotion: the feeling of pity and sorrow for someone else's misfortune. 'Sympathy is an emotion' — a competent speaker would call it a Y.

Statistical analysis requires mathematical operations (probability theory, distributions, hypothesis testing) to function now. Remove mathematics and statistical analysis has no framework to operate — not a historical association but a constitutive present-tense dependency.

MFCCs (Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients) are a specific type of cepstral coefficient set. The MFCC computation pipeline produces cepstral coefficients as its output. Remove cepstral coefficients and MFCCs have no output — the concept stops operating entirely.

A power spectrum is a specific type of spectral representation that shows the distribution of signal power across frequency. 'Power spectrum is a spectral representation' — a competent speaker would call X a Y. Files against nearest kind per Law 11.

Cepstral liftering applies a filter in the cepstral domain to transform cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstral coefficients and liftering has no data to operate on — the process ceases to function. Genuine operational dependency per Law 8.

The cepstrum is a specific type of spectral representation: it displays signal characteristics as amplitude versus quefrency (the frequency-like domain of the cepstral transform). A competent speaker would call it a spectral representation. This files against the nearest kind — spectral-representation, not the more general power-spectrum.

The mel-spectrum is a specific type of spectral representation: it displays signal power distributed across the mel frequency scale (a perceptual frequency scale). A competent speaker would call it a spectral representation. This edges mel-spectrum to its nearest kind.

Spectral-energy IS a specific kind of spectral representation: it presents signal energy as a function integrated over frequency within an analysis window. A competent speaker would call spectral energy a spectral representation. Files against nearest kind in the spectral analysis hierarchy.

Statistical analysis IS a specific kind of data analysis — it applies statistical methods (probability, inference, estimation) to analyze data. A competent speaker would call statistical analysis 'a form of data analysis'. Files against nearest kind.

Spectral bandwidth was derived from spectral representation — the concept of measuring frequency spread only makes sense after spectral representations existed. Spectral bandwidth measures the spread of frequencies within a spectral representation, which historically followed and conceptually depends on the prior existence of spectral representation as a concept.

DERIVED_FROM test: window-functions (the concept of applying a weighting function to signal segments for spectral analysis) predate and enabled short-time Fourier transform. STFT applies window functions to time-localize the Fourier analysis — the windowing concept is the foundational piece that STFT derives from.

DERIVED_FROM test: the power spectrum concept existed first and fed into spectral flux. Spectral flux measures the rate of change of the power spectrum over time — it is a derived metric built on the power spectrum foundation. The note pins the sense: spectral flux as a specific measure DERIVED FROM the broader power spectrum concept.

DERIVED_FROM is not applicable here — this is INSTANCE_OF. power-spectral-density IS a specific kind of spectral representation: it presents signal power as a function of frequency. A competent speaker would call PSD 'a spectral representation'. Files against the nearest kind.

Spectral bandwidth measures the spread of energy across frequencies in a spectrum. Remove power-spectrum and spectral bandwidth has nothing to measure — it stops operating. DEPENDS_ON (Law 8 removal test).

DERIVED_FROM test (historical): The Fourier transform concept (continuous, 1822) predates the FFT algorithm (Cooley-Tukey, 1965). The FFT is an efficient computational method for computing the discrete Fourier transform — it derives from and extends the Fourier transform concept.

spectral-energy IS a specific kind of feature: a measurable characteristic of a signal in the frequency domain. A competent speaker in signal processing would call spectral energy 'a spectral feature' or 'a feature.' Nearest kind: no more specific category between spectral-energy and feature.

DERIVED_FROM (historical): The concept of resonance (vibrational amplification at natural frequencies) predates and informed the concept of formants in speech. Formants are specifically vocal-tract resonance peaks — they derive from applying the general concept of acoustic resonance to speech production.

MFCC computation operates on the power spectral density as its primary input: the pipeline extracts the PSD (or power spectrum), applies mel-scale filterbank, takes log, then DCT. Remove power-spectral-density as a concept and MFCC has nothing to operate on — it cannot function. DEPENDS_ON (Law 8 removal test).

The cepstrum is computed by taking the FFT of the log power spectrum: cepstrum = IDFT(log(PSD)). Remove power-spectral-density and the cepstrum has no input — it stops operating. DEPENDS_ON (Law 8 removal test).

Spectral energy (the integral or sum of spectral power across all frequencies) is derived from the power spectral density. The PSD concept existed first and provided the mathematical basis: spectral energy = integral of PSD over frequency. DERIVED_FROM historical test passes — the general concept of PSD predates the specific metric of total spectral energy.

Periodogram computes |DFT|² — the squared magnitude of the discrete Fourier transform. Remove Fourier transform and the periodogram has no operational mechanism. Valid present-tense DEPENDS_ON per Law 8.

The periodogram is a spectral estimation technique whose sole purpose is to produce an estimate of the power spectral density. Periodogram did not exist before PSD — it is defined as a method to estimate PSD. Which came first? The concept of spectral power density came first; the periodogram was invented to derive it.

Mel-spectrum is the power spectrum transformed by the mel-filterbank. Remove the mel-filterbank concept and mel-spectrum has no operational definition — it is nothing without the filterbank. Present-tense DEPENDS_ON per Law 8.

FFT is an algorithm whose entire operational purpose is to compute the discrete Fourier transform efficiently. Remove DFT and FFT has no mechanism or purpose — present-tense removal test (Law 8) passes. DFT (epoch 0.06) predates FFT (0.83).

Periodogram is a specific kind of spectral estimation method — it estimates frequency content from finite samples via DFT magnitude. A competent speaker says 'the periodogram is a spectral estimation technique.' Nearest kind: spectral-estimation.

Bartlett method is a specific kind of spectral estimation technique — a competent speaker would say 'the Bartlett method is a spectral estimation technique'. Periodogram (1940s) predates Bartlett's averaging approach (1948); this edge pins the kind relation.
Welch method IS A spectral-estimation technique — it estimates frequency content from finite samples. Competent speaker says 'the Welch method is a spectral estimation technique.' Nearest kind.

Power spectrum existed first and fed into spectral energy. Spectral energy is computed by integrating a power spectrum — the power spectrum is the source from which spectral energy is derived. Which-came-first test (Law 7): power spectrum concept predates spectral energy as a named scalar quantity.

Remove nyquist-frequency (the concept of the max representable frequency at fs/2) and the aliasing concept loses its defining bound — aliasing cannot operate as a defined concept without the nyquist threshold. Present-tense constitutive dependency, not chronology.

Welch method needs window-function to operate now — each segment must be multiplied by a window (Hamming, Hanning, etc.) before computing the periodogram. Remove windowing and the method collapses into a simple averaged periodogram, which is not Welch. The windowing is a required algorithmic step, not optional.

Periodogram existed first (1920s) and fed into Welch method (1967). Welch is a modification of the periodogram approach — it applies windowing and averaging to reduce variance. Which-came-first: periodogram predates Welch by decades. Welch builds on the periodogram concept.

A filter-bank is a specific kind of spectral estimation technique: it estimates the power distribution across frequency bands by passing a signal through parallel band-pass filters. 'A filter-bank is a kind of spectral estimation' — the nearest kind is spectral-estimation.

A spectrum-analyzer is a specific kind of signal processing instrument: it applies signal processing techniques (FFT or filter-bank) to convert time-domain signals into frequency-domain representations. 'A spectrum-analyzer is a Y' where Y = signal processing instrument.

The Bartlett method (1948) is a direct modification of the periodogram approach: it divides a signal into non-overlapping segments, computes a periodogram for each, and averages them. Periodogram (1920s, Pigot) existed first and fed into the Bartlett method. Which-came-first: periodogram clearly predates Bartlett.

The Nyquist frequency (half the sampling rate) is a concept derived from sampling theory. Nyquist (1928) formalized the maximum representable frequency within the framework of sampling. Which-came-first: sampling as a concept predates the specific frequency-limit concept.

Bartlett method is a specific kind of signal processing technique: it estimates power spectral density by dividing a signal into segments, computing periodograms, and averaging. 'A Bartlett method is a kind of signal processing technique' — competent speaker test passes. Note: spectral-estimation already exists as a more specific kind; Bartlett is also directly a kind of signal processing (nearest kind check: Bartlett is a method/technique, signal-processing is the domain. If spectral-estimation is the nearest kind, this edge may be subsumed later. But since bartlett has no accepted INSTANCE_OF edge yet, filing is legal per Law 11e.)

Welch method is a specific kind of signal processing technique: it estimates power spectral density by applying windowing and averaging to periodogram segments. 'A Welch method is a kind of signal processing technique' — competent speaker test passes. Filed because welch-method has no accepted INSTANCE_OF edge yet.

A band-pass-filter IS a specific kind of filter: it passes frequencies within a defined band (f_L to f_H) and attenuates everything else. A competent speaker would call it 'a filter'. Nearest kind per Law 11e.

A spectral-envelope IS a specific kind of spectral-representation. It represents the smooth, coarse shape of a spectrum, filtering out fine structure and harmonic detail. A competent speaker would call it 'a spectral representation' — it represents spectral energy distribution, albeit in a smoothed form. Files against the nearest kind.

A spectrum-analyzer IS a specific kind of instrument: a device that applies signal processing (FFT or filter-bank) to convert time-domain signals into frequency-domain representations. 'A spectrum analyzer is a measuring instrument.' Nearest kind: instrument is accepted and more precise than signal-processing.

A filter-bank IS a specific kind of filter: it is a compound filter structure consisting of parallel band-pass filters that split a signal into multiple frequency bands. 'A filter-bank is a kind of filter' — a bank of filters operating in parallel. Nearest kind: filter is accepted.

The cepstral-envelope is derived from the spectral-envelope concept, generalized from the frequency domain to the quefrency domain. Both represent the smooth, coarse shape of a spectrum — one in frequency space, the other in the cepstral (quefrency) domain. The spectral-envelope concept came first (epoch 0.89 vs 0.99) and the cepstral variant derives from it by re-mapping the concept.

The cepstral-envelope is derived from the cepstrum concept. A cepstrum is the basic quefrency-domain representation of a signal; the cepstral-envelope is a specific derived construct that extracts the smooth envelope from the cepstrum, analogous to how the spectral-envelope extracts the envelope from a power spectrum. The cepstrum concept came first (epoch 0.80 vs 0.99) and feeds into the envelope concept.

Which existed first? The general concept of a filter (any device or algorithm that selectively passes or attenuates signal components) predates the band-pass variant. The band-pass-filter is a specific instantiation where the pass region is bounded on both sides. The general concept fed into the specific one.

Remove the concept of a filter — does a filter-bank stop OPERATING? Yes. A filter-bank is a structure of parallel filters; its entire function is to apply multiple filters simultaneously. Without the concept of a filter, the filter-bank has no operation. The filter-bank needs filters to function now, not just historically.

A cepstral-envelope IS a feature: it is a specific type of signal-processing feature extracted from a cepstrum by isolating low-quefrency components. A competent speaker would call it a feature — it represents a measured/derived property used for analysis. The nearest kind is 'feature', not a more abstract category.

The cepstrum concept is derived from the spectrum: quefrency-domain analysis operates on the Fourier transform of the log-power spectrum. The spectrum existed first and directly fed into the construction of the cepstrum concept. Which-came-first test passes.

The spectral-envelope is derived from the raw spectrum: it extracts the smooth, coarse shape from the fine spectral detail. The spectrum concept existed first and the envelope is a transformation applied to it. Which-came-first test passes.

A spectral-peak is a specific type of signal-processing feature — a local maximum in a spectral distribution. Spectral peaks are extracted to characterize sounds, detect events, and identify tonal content. Competent speaker would call it a feature. INSTANCE_OF to nearest kind.

Which-came-first: the spectrum concept predates and feeds into spectral-peak. A spectral peak is a feature identified within a spectrum — you need the spectrum concept first to identify peaks within it. The spectrum existed first and directly fed into constructing the spectral-peak concept.

A spectrum analyzer is built and maintained for the sake of spectral analysis — its designed purpose is to perform spectral analysis on signals. The servant (spectrum-analyzer) points at the master (spectral-analysis). Remove spectral-analysis as a purpose and the device loses its reason for being.

A spectral envelope is extracted and maintained for the sake of spectral analysis — its purpose is to characterize the coarse shape of spectra for analysis and classification. The servant (spectral-envelope) points at the master (spectral-analysis). Remove spectral-analysis and the envelope loses its analytical purpose.

Which-came-first: the fourier-transform (decomposition of signals into frequency components) existed before mfcc (mel-frequency cepstral coefficients). MFCC is built on FFT-based spectral analysis, which derives from the Fourier transform concept.

A mel-frequency spectrogram is a specific kind of spectrogram where the frequency axis is mapped to the perceptual mel scale. Which-rung: mel-frequency-spectrogram → spectrogram → time-frequency-representation. Pin sense: spectrogram as the general class of visualizations showing signal energy distribution over frequency and time.

Cross-correlation is a specific kind of correlation measuring similarity between two signals as a function of time lag. A competent speaker would call it 'a correlation method'. Pin sense: correlation as the general statistical measure of relationship between variables.

Which-came-first: the mel-frequency-scale (1930s psychoacoustic research) predates MFCCs (1980s speech recognition). The mel scale is a foundational building block used in computing MFCCs — MFCCs would not exist without the mel-frequency mapping that defines their frequency axis.

Which-came-first: the mel-frequency-scale (1930s) predates cepstral-envelope (1990s speaker recognition). Cepstral-envelope computation uses the mel-frequency scale to map spectral content into perceptual bins before extracting the envelope. The mel scale is a foundational step in computing cepstral-envelopes.

Spectrograms are computed via short-time Fourier transform (1940s concept). MFCCs use mel-frequency spectrograms, which are computed by applying the STFT first and then warping to the mel scale. Chronologically: STFT predates mel-frequency spectrograms. STFT is the fundamental computation that produces any spectrogram, mel-warped or not.

A filter bank is a collection of band-pass filters arranged in parallel, each passing a different frequency sub-band. The band-pass filter concept predates the filter bank architecture. A filter bank is structurally composed of multiple band-pass filters — the band-pass filter is the constituent element.

which-came-first: mel-frequency-scale (1930s psychoacoustic research) predates mel-frequency-spectrogram (developed for audio/speech processing). A mel-frequency-spectrogram is computed by applying a STFT then warping the frequency axis using the mel-frequency-scale. The mel scale is a foundational building block — the spectrogram would not exist without it.

which-came-first: cepstral-envelope (introduced early 1980s as a speech feature) predates MFCCs (1980s, but built on cepstral-envelope). MFCC computation pipeline uses cepstral-envelope extraction as a core step — the cepstral coefficients in MFCCs are derived from the cepstral envelope.

which-came-first: cepstrum (1970s, Bogert/Healy/Holmes) predates spectral-envelope as a formalized feature (1980s speech processing). The cepstral-envelope method for estimating spectral envelope uses the cepstrum as its computational foundation — taking the inverse Fourier transform of the log spectrum to isolate the envelope component in quefrency.

which-came-first: mel-frequency-spectrogram (1980s) predates MFCC (1980s) and is its structural foundation. MFCC computation requires extracting the mel-frequency-spectrogram as an intermediate step before applying the DCT — Y existed first and fed into X.

which-came-first: DCT (1974, Ahmed/Natarajan/Rao) predates MFCC (1980s) and is a constitutive computational step. MFCC computation applies the DCT to the log mel-spectrogram coefficients to produce the final features — Y existed first and fed into X.

which-came-first: correlation (19th century statistics) predates cross-correlation (developed for signal processing, 20th century). Correlation is the general concept from which cross-correlation was derived as a specialized variant for comparing two distinct signals.

hamming-window was specifically designed to reduce spectral leakage in Fourier-based spectral estimation. Its purpose by design is to improve spectral estimation accuracy — hamming-window SERVES spectral-estimation.

zero-padding (appending zeros to a signal) was specifically designed to increase the apparent frequency resolution of FFT output. Its purpose is to serve FFT by interpolating the frequency domain — zero-padding SERVES fft.

phase-response is a specific kind of frequency-response: while frequency-response broadly describes how a system modifies signal amplitudes across frequencies, phase-response specifically describes the phase shift component. A competent speaker would call phase-response a frequency response.

DFT (1822 Fourier series, 1965 Cooley-Tukey FFT) predates DCT (1974, Ahmed/Natarajan/Rao). DCT is a variant of DFT that uses only cosine basis functions — it came from Fourier analysis and fed into later signal processing. Which-came-first test: fourier-transform is older and fed into discrete-cosine-transform.

Cepstral envelope computation applies DCT to the log mel-spectrogram coefficients to extract the envelope shape. DCT (1974) predates the cepstral-envelope technique and is a constitutive computational step in its calculation. Which-came-first: DCT is older and fed into cepstral-envelope.

The mel-scale (perceptual frequency scale, 1930s Stevens/Volkmann/Newman, refined 1970s) predates the mel-frequency-spectrogram (1980s). The mel-frequency-spectrogram is built by warping the spectrogram onto the mel scale — which-came-first: mel-scale is older and fed into mel-frequency-spectrogram.

Fourier analysis (1822) predates modern spectral decomposition techniques (mid-20th century). Spectral decomposition — representing a signal as a sum of frequency components — is built on the Fourier transform. Which-came-first: fourier-transform is older and fed into spectral-decomposition as the foundational mathematical tool.

The cepstrum (1976, Bogert et al.) predates the cepstral-domain as a formalized concept. The cepstral-domain is the conceptual space derived from and named after the cepstrum technique — it is the domain in which cepstra are computed and interpreted. Which-came-first: cepstrum is older and fed into the cepstral-domain concept.
Cepstral domain operates on quefrency obtained via DCT; DCT is the core computational engine of quefrency analysis. Which-came-first: DCT (1974) predates cepstral-domain formalization.
Cepstral envelope computation starts from the log mel-spectrogram; DCT is then applied to it. Which-came-first: mel-frequency-spectrogram (1980s) predates the cepstral-envelope technique.
Mel-frequency-spectrogram builds on the spectrogram which is derived from FFT. Which-came-first: Fourier transform (1822/1965) predates mel-frequency-spectrogram (1980s).
Cepstral envelope is a specific kind of spectral estimation technique: it estimates the spectral envelope via quefrency analysis. A competent speaker would call it 'a spectral estimation method'.

MFCC computation uses mel-frequency warping as a constitutive step: the spectrogram is warped onto the mel scale before DCT. The mel-scale warping transforms linear frequency into perceptual frequency space.

Cepstral envelope is a technique operating within the cepstral domain (quefrency space). The cepstral domain provides the conceptual framework (quefrency analysis) within which the cepstral envelope is defined and computed.
Cross-correlation is a specific signal processing technique that measures similarity between two signals as a function of displacement. It is a canonical instance of signal processing operations.
Spectral decomposition IS a form of spectral representation — it represents a signal as a decomposition into frequency components. This is the nearest kind for spectral-decomposition.

Spectral decomposition (Fourier analysis, 1822; mid-20th century techniques) predates cepstral-envelope (1980s). Cepstral-envelope computation requires spectral decomposition: the cepstrum is the inverse FFT of the log power spectrum, and the power spectrum itself comes from spectral decomposition via FFT. Which-came-first (Law 7) passes cleanly.

Spectral decomposition predates MFCC (1980s). MFCC computation begins with STFT, which is a form of spectral decomposition — it decomposes the signal into frequency components over time. Without spectral decomposition, MFCC coefficients cannot be computed. Law 7 passes.

Spectral decomposition (1822 Fourier → mid-20th century techniques) predates the cepstrum (1976, Bogert et al.). The cepstrum is computed as IFFT(log|FFT(x)|) — the FFT is spectral decomposition, and the cepstrum is derived from the spectral representation. Which-came-first (Law 7) passes.

Spectral decomposition (Fourier analysis, 1822) predates spectral-envelope extraction techniques (1970s). The spectral envelope is the smooth envelope of the power spectrum, which itself comes from spectral decomposition. Without spectral decomposition, there is no spectrum to extract an envelope from. Law 7 passes.

Fourier transform (1822) predates the Laplace transform (1780s Laplace, but the modern operational form postdates Fourier's analytical framework). The Laplace transform generalizes the Fourier transform: setting s = iω in the Laplace integral recovers the Fourier transform. The mathematical relationship is direct — Laplace extends Fourier to the complex plane.

Mel-frequency-spectrogram derives from frequency-warping: it applies mel-scale warping (linear-to-perceptual frequency transformation) to a spectrogram. The warping concept predates the mel-spectrogram technique.

Cepstral-envelope is derived from cepstrum-coefficients: it is obtained by smoothing/filtering the cepstral coefficients to extract the slowly-varying envelope shape, discarding the fine-structure (residual) components.

Mel-frequency-spectrogram (1980s) derives from spectral decomposition: its computation begins with STFT, a time-frequency spectral decomposition, followed by mel-scale warping. Spectral decomposition (Fourier analysis, 1822) predates and enables the mel-spectrogram. The which-came-first test passes.

Cepstral-envelope is a specific kind of spectral-envelope: it is the smooth envelope of the log-magnitude cepstrum, analogous to how spectral-envelope is the smooth envelope of the magnitude spectrum. Files against the nearest kind.
Spectral-envelope is a specific kind of spectral estimation: it estimates the slowly-varying spectral shape of a signal by smoothing the power spectrum. Files against nearest kind.

Cepstral-envelope computation takes the logarithm of the spectrum before applying the inverse FFT. The logarithm is essential: without log-compression, the cepstrum cannot separate convolution from multiplication, which is the whole point of the quefrency domain. Logarithm predates and feeds into cepstral-envelope.

MFCC IS a spectral feature: it is a specific type of numerical descriptor extracted from a signal's cepstral representation, capturing the short-term power spectrum's envelope shape. MFCCs are among the most widely used spectral features in speech and audio recognition. Files against nearest kind — spectral-feature is the immediate category of descriptors.

MFCC (1980s) derives from cepstrum (1963): MFCC computation requires extracting cepstral coefficients from the signal (via FFT, then log, then DCT), then optionally warping to mel scale. The cepstrum concept predates and is constitutively needed for MFCC — without the cepstrum, there are no cepstral coefficients to form the MFCC.

STFT (1940s, Dennis Gabor) derives from the Fourier Transform (late 1800s, Fourier): it applies Fourier analysis to short time windows, extending the basic transform to time-varying signals. Which-came-first test: Fourier Transform (c. 1822) predates STFT by over a century.

Cepstral-lifter operates in the cepstral domain and derives from the cepstrum concept. The lifter is a technique built upon the cepstrum. Cepstrum conceptually and historically precedes the lifter technique.

Spectral-envelope is a specific kind of spectral-feature: it describes the overall shape of a spectrum via smoothed amplitude values. A competent speaker would call a spectral envelope 'a spectral feature' (Law 9). Nearest kind: spectral-feature has no intermediate category between it and spectral-envelope.

MFCC (Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients) is a specific kind of cepstral-coefficients where the frequency scale is warped to the mel scale. A competent speaker would call MFCC 'a cepstral coefficient' (Law 9). Nearest kind: no intermediate category between cepstral-coefficients and MFCC.

Cepstral-coefficients IS a specific kind of spectral-representation. It represents the spectral content of a signal in the quefrency domain — a transformation of the frequency-domain representation. A competent speaker would call cepstral coefficients 'a spectral representation.' Nearest kind check: spectral-representation is not already reached via an accepted INSTANCE_OF ladder from cepstral-coefficients.

Spectral-envelope derives from cepstral-coefficients. The cepstral approach to spectral envelope estimation: compute cepstral coefficients (FFT→log magnitude→IDFT), truncate/apply lifter, then IDFT again to recover the smoothed envelope. The cepstral coefficients are the intermediate representation from which the envelope is derived. Which-came-first: cepstral method (1970s) predates cepstral-envelope estimation technique.

Shelf IS a specific kind of furniture. A shelf is a flat horizontal surface supported at the edges, designed for storage or display — a competent speaker would call it 'a piece of furniture.' Nearest kind: shelf is not already reached from furniture via accepted INSTANCE_OF edges.

Cepstral-lifter is a technique specifically designed and maintained for the sake of cepstral-analysis. Its purpose is to shape the cepstral coefficients for analysis purposes (e.g. vowelform extraction, speech enhancement). The lifter exists to serve the broader analytical activity.

The cepstrum (1963) derived from the needs and methods of signal processing. It was invented by applying signal-processing operations (FFT, log, IFFT) to exploit the periodic structure in spectra. Signal processing as a field predates and enables the cepstrum concept.

STFT was developed within and derives from the field of signal processing. It addresses a specific signal-processing need — analyzing non-stationary signals — by extending Fourier methods to the time-varying domain.
Spectral-feature concepts derive from signal processing — they are the measurable properties of signals' spectra that engineers and researchers extract and use within signal processing workflows.

Spectral-flatness IS a specific kind of spectral feature: it quantifies how noise-like vs tonal a spectrum is (Glaisher's constant / geometric-to-arithmetic mean ratio). A competent speaker would call spectral-flatness 'a spectral feature.' Nearest kind confirmed.

Zero-crossing-rate IS a specific kind of spectral feature: it measures the rate at which a signal crosses zero amplitude, used as a proxy for spectral centroid in audio analysis. A competent speaker would call zero-crossing-rate 'a spectral feature.' Nearest kind confirmed.

Pitch-detection algorithms and concepts derived from signal processing research — cepstral, autocorrelation, and spectral methods all originate in DSP. Signal processing provided the mathematical framework. Historical direction per Law 7.

Cepstral-lifter as a concept derives from the need for cepstral-analysis — the liftering technique was developed to enable spectral envelope extraction and speech enhancement, which are forms of cepstral analysis.

Cepstral-lifter derives from mel-filterbank — the concept of cepstral liftering was developed building on the mel-scale frequency analysis framework. Mel-filterbank (the concept of filtering in mel-scale bands) predates and fed into the general concept of cepstral liftering.

Cepstral-coefficients as a concept derive from the cepstrum (1963, Bogert et al.). The coefficients are the specific numerical values obtained from the cepstrum computation — the cepstrum concept came first and fed into the concept of working with these coefficients directly.

The cepstral-lifter technique operates directly ON cepstral coefficients — it modifies them (lifting) to emphasize or suppress quefrency ranges. Remove cepstral coefficients and the liftering technique has nothing to operate on; it stops functioning. Present-tense dependency confirmed.

Zero-crossing-rate analysis derives from signal processing — it is a signal processing technique for estimating signal characteristics from waveform zero crossings. Signal processing as a field predates ZCR and provides the mathematical framework for its use.

Cepstral-lifter derives from cepstral-coefficients — the liftering technique is a manipulation of cepstral coefficient amplitudes. You cannot lifter without coefficients: the coefficient concept must exist first for liftering to operate on it. Historical development: coefficients (1963) → liftering technique (1970s-80s).

Spectral-envelope IS a specific kind of spectral-estimation. It estimates the slowly-varying envelope of a signal's spectrum — one of several estimation methods (alongside LP, cepstral, parametric). A competent speaker would call spectral envelope estimation a type of spectral estimation.

Cepstral-coefficients derive from the cepstrum. The cepstrum (1963, Bogert et al.) established the quefrency domain concept; cepstral coefficients are the specific numerical values obtained from the cepstrum computation. The cepstrum existed first and fed into coefficient-based methods.

Spectral-bandwidth IS a specific kind of spectral-feature. It measures the width of the frequency content of a signal — a quantitative property derived from the spectral representation. A competent speaker would call bandwidth 'a spectral feature'.

DERIVED_FROM: cepstral-coefficients (the cepstrum) existed first and fed into cepstral-envelope. The envelope is computed by windowing the cepstral coefficients (cepstral liftering) and transforming back — the coefficients are the input from which the envelope is derived. Which-came-first: coefficients are the fundamental representation; the envelope is a processed version.

The cepstrum concept (quefrency-domain representation) existed first; liftering is a technique derived from it — a modification operation that applies windowing to the cepstrum itself. You cannot lifter without a cepstrum to operate on.

Spectral-decomposition (FFT-based decomposition of signals into frequency components) existed first as the foundational technique; the cepstral-transform builds directly on this by taking the log magnitude of the spectrum and inverting it to produce the cepstrum. The transform's first and critical step is spectral decomposition.

A cepstral-lifter IS a specific kind of liftering — a window function applied in the quefrency domain. Liftering is the general technique; the cepstral-lifter is the domain-specific instance used in cepstral analysis.

MFCC computation derives from the cepstral-transform: the transform's output (the cepstrum) is the necessary input to MFCC's subsequent DCT and coefficient extraction steps. The cepstral-transform existed first and provides the quefrency-domain representation that MFCC builds upon.

The cepstral-envelope is computed by applying liftering (quefrency-domain windowing) to the cepstral coefficients. Liftering is the core operation that produces the envelope from the raw cepstrum — it existed as a technique and the envelope is derived by applying it.

MFCC computation derives from mel-filterbank: the mel-scale filterbank extracts band energies from the spectrum, which is the foundational step before the DCT produces cepstral coefficients. The mel-scale frequency warping (originating from mel-filterbank research) is integral to the MFCC derivation.

Liftering derives from homomorphic-filtering: liftering is the quefrency-domain windowing operation that forms the filtering step in homomorphic filtering pipelines. Homomorphic filtering (transform→filter→inverse-transform) existed first as a framework, and liftering is the specific quefrency-domain technique derived from it.

Spectral subtraction needs spectral decomposition (FFT) to operate now — it transforms the signal to the frequency domain, estimates and subtracts noise, then reconstructs. Remove spectral decomposition and spectral subtraction stops working.

spectral-subtraction IS a specific kind of signal-processing technique. It operates on signals in the frequency domain to reduce noise — a concrete instance of the broader discipline of signal processing.

The cepstrum concept (quefrency-domain representation) existed first — coined by Bell Labs in 1967. The cepstral-transform is the algorithmic procedure that computes it, derived from the earlier concept of the cepstrum. Which-came-first: cepstrum as a concept predates the transform algorithm.

Remove liftering (quefrency-domain windowing) and you cannot compute a cepstral-envelope — the envelope IS produced by applying the window operation. Liftering is the operational mechanism without which the envelope concept has no working procedure.

Remove the cepstrum (quefrency-domain representation) and the cepstral-envelope has no data to operate on. The envelope is a transformation OF the cepstrum — it depends on the cepstrum as its input domain.

cepstral-subtraction IS a specific kind of signal-processing technique. It operates in the cepstral domain to remove noise — a concrete instance of signal processing, parallel to spectral-subtraction which operates in the frequency domain.

The cepstrum (quefrency-domain representation) was conceived first — coined at Bell Labs in 1967. Cepstral-subtraction is a noise reduction technique derived from the cepstrum concept, applying subtraction in the quefrency domain. Which-came-first: cepstrum predates the subtraction technique.

Per Law 7 DERIVED_FROM: which came first? Cepstral-transform (algorithm that computes the cepstrum) exists first and feeds into cepstral-envelope. The envelope cannot be extracted without the cepstral data produced by the transform. Direction: cepstral-envelope depends on cepstral-transform as its data source.

Per Law 8d SERVES: cepstral-envelope is extracted specifically to capture the slowly-varying spectral structure, which directly encodes pitch information. Its designed purpose includes enabling pitch estimation from the quefrency-domain representation. Servant (cepstral-envelope)→master (pitch-detection).

Per Law 8d: spectral subtraction is designed and maintained specifically for the purpose of reducing noise from signals. Its entire algorithm — estimate noise spectrum, subtract it, reconstruct — is aimed at noise reduction as its goal. The technique exists to serve the noise-reduction objective.

Per Law 8d: cepstral subtraction is a noise reduction technique operating in the quefrency domain. Its designed purpose is to attenuate noise by subtracting noise estimates in the cepstral representation. It exists to serve the noise-reduction objective.

Per Law 7: cepstral-transform (the algorithm that computes the cepstrum) predates cepstral-subtraction (a noise reduction technique operating in the cepstral domain). The transform produced the quefrency-domain representation that cepstral-subtraction later built upon to attenuate noise. Which came first: transform, then subtraction technique.

Per Law 7: spectral-analysis (estimating the frequency content of signals) predates spectral-subtraction (a noise reduction technique that operates on spectral estimates). The analytical concept came first and fed into the subtraction technique. Spectral subtraction requires spectral analysis as its foundation.

Per Law 9: cepstral-envelope IS a specific kind of signal processing construct — it is a signal representation extracted through processing. A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing concept.' Files against the nearest established kind.

Per Law 10: cepstral-transform produces cepstral coefficients, and the cepstral-envelope is extracted as a component/aspect of that output. The transform whole contains the envelope as part of its computational result.

Cepstral-envelope operates on cepstral coefficients — remove cepstral analysis (the procedure producing cepstral coefficients) and the envelope has no data to transform. Constitutive operational dependency: remove Y and X stops operating (Law 8).

Cepstral-analysis operates in the quefrency domain; it needs the cepstral transform (log-FFT-inverse-FFT pipeline) to produce quefrency data. Remove the transform and analysis has no quefrency representation to work on — present-tense operating dependency, not historical.

Cepstral-coefficients are the numerical outputs of the cepstral transform. Remove the transform and the coefficients cease to exist — they are produced by the transform, not independently available. The coefficients depend on the transform operating to generate them.

Liftering operates in the quefrency domain. Remove the cepstral transform and there is no quefrency representation for liftering to operate on. Present-tense operating dependency: liftering needs the transform's output to function.

The cepstral-lifter derives from homomorphic filtering. Homomorphic filtering (the broader technique of transform→filter→inverse-transform) was developed in the 1960s. The cepstral-lifter is a specialized application of the homomorphic filtering pipeline applied specifically in the quefrency (cepstral) domain for speech processing. The broader technique existed first and fed into the specialized cepstral variant.

The mel scale (1937, Stevens-Volkmann-Newman) was developed from the concept of pitch perception to create a scale where equal steps are perceived as equal pitch intervals. Pitch as a perceptual concept existed before the mel frequency scale was created to quantify it.

The mel scale is designed and maintained for the sake of speech recognition and audio analysis. It underpins MFCCs, mel-filterbanks, and mel-spectrograms — the standard representations in speech processing systems.

Cepstral coefficients are computed via the cepstral transform pipeline: FFT → log magnitude → IFFT. The Fourier transform is the foundational operation that enables the quefrency-domain analysis from which cepstral coefficients are derived.
Noise reduction is a specific kind of signal processing — techniques (filtering, spectral subtraction, wavelet denoising, etc.) applied to reduce unwanted noise while preserving the desired signal.
A spectral peak is a specific kind of spectral feature — it is the local maximum in a frequency spectrum, representing the strongest frequency component in a given band.

A spectrum analyzer is built on the Fourier transform: it decomposes a signal into its frequency components using FFT or equivalent Fourier analysis. The concept of analyzing a spectrum derives directly from Fourier analysis.

Noise reduction operates on signals using signal processing techniques (filtering, spectral subtraction, FFT-based methods). Remove signal processing and noise reduction stops operating — present-tense operational dependency (Law 8). The edge-test confirms signal-processing is the older/more-foundational concept.
bit-rate is a specific kind of measurement — it measures the rate of bit processing, transmission, or storage per unit time. The note pins the INSTANCE_OF sense: 'is a specific kind of'.

Phonemes are language-specific: each language has its own phoneme inventory and no phoneme exists outside a particular language. The removal test holds — remove language and phonemic distinction ceases to operate. Object-level dependency: a phoneme IS a language-internal unit of sound contrast.

The mel scale (1937, Stevens-Volkmann-Newman) existed first as a perceptual frequency mapping. The mel-spectrogram builds on this by applying mel-scale filterbanks to a time-frequency decomposition. Which existed first: the mel frequency scale predates the mel-spectrogram concept by decades.

The mel-spectrogram is designed and maintained for the sake of speech recognition and audio classification. It underpins most modern speaker identification, keyword spotting, and acoustic model training systems.

The spectrogram (time-frequency decomposition via STFT) existed first as a fundamental signal analysis tool. The mel-spectrogram extends it by mapping the frequency axis to the mel scale. Which existed first: the spectrogram predates the mel-spectrogram by decades.
Spectral subtraction IS a specific kind of noise reduction technique. It estimates noise from quiet periods and subtracts it from the signal spectrum. Files against nearest kind.
Cepstral subtraction IS a specific kind of noise reduction. It operates in the quefrency domain, estimating and subtracting noise components from cepstral coefficients. Nearest kind: noise-reduction.
Mel-spectrogram IS a specific kind of time-frequency representation. A competent speaker would call it 'a time-frequency representation' using the mel scale. Files against the nearest kind.
Cepstral transform IS a specific kind of signal processing technique. It computes the cepstrum via FFT→log magnitude→IDFT pipeline. A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing method'.

Cepstral coefficients ARE a specific kind of spectral feature — they are numerical values derived from the cepstrum that represent spectral characteristics of a signal. A competent speaker would call them 'a spectral feature.' Files against nearest kind per Law 9.

Liftering operates in the quefrency domain: it applies a smoothing filter to the cepstrum (the quefrency representation of a signal). Remove quefrency — the concept of quefrency — and liftering has no domain on which to operate. This is a constitutive, present-tense dependency, not a meta-level claim about language.

Cepstral-subtraction directly operates on cepstral coefficients: it estimates noise in the quefrency domain and subtracts it from the cepstral coefficients. Remove cepstral-coefficients as a concept and cepstral-subtraction has no data to operate on. The removal test passes at the object level, not the meta-level.

Furniture IS a kind of tool. Per Law 11c: a shelf IS a tool — passive artifacts (shelves, jars, walls) qualify exactly as active implements do. Furniture extends human capacity for storage, organization, and spatial comfort within built environments. Files against nearest accepted kind: tool.

The mel-frequency scale concept depends constitutively on the pitch concept: the mel scale maps physical frequency to human pitch perception. Remove the concept of pitch (how humans hear high/low) and the mel scale loses its mapping target — it becomes meaningless. This is object-level dependency between two maps, not meta-level dependency on language.

Speech recognition as a discipline depends constitutively on the concept of phoneme: recognizing spoken language requires modeling the sound units that distinguish meaning within a language. Remove the phoneme concept and speech recognition loses its fundamental analytical unit — it cannot operate without distinguishing phonemic patterns. Object-level dependency between two maps.

LPC needs autocorrelation to operate now: the prediction coefficients are computed by solving the Yule-Walker equations, which are derived from the signal's autocorrelation function. Remove autocorrelation as a concept and the coefficient computation has no foundation. This is operational — not just descriptive — because the Levinson-Durbin recursion operates on the autocorrelation matrix.

LPC IS a specific kind of spectral analysis technique: it decomposes a signal into its spectral envelope (via LPC coefficients) and excitation source (via residual). A competent speaker in signal processing would classify LPC as a spectral analysis method. Files against nearest kind.

Cepstral-distance IS a specific kind of spectral feature: it is a numerical measure derived from cepstral coefficients that quantifies spectral envelope dissimilarity. A competent speaker would classify it as 'a spectral feature' for comparing spectral shapes.

Cepstral-distance requires cepstral-coefficients to operate: the distance metric is computed as a function of cepstral coefficient vectors from two spectra. Remove cepstral coefficients and cepstral distance loses its data inputs and has no operational basis.

Cepstral-distance is designed for use within speech recognition systems: comparing spectral envelopes between reference and target utterances to assess similarity, a core operation in speaker-independent speech recognition pipelines.

Cepstral-envelope is extracted specifically to characterize the spectral shape of speech signals for phonetic and speaker analysis in speech recognition pipelines. Its designed purpose is to serve speech recognition and related audio analysis tasks.

Spectral-subtraction is designed as a preprocessing step in speech recognition pipelines: it reduces noise from speech signals before feature extraction, improving recognition accuracy in noisy environments. Its designed purpose is to serve speech recognition.

A wavelet transform IS a specific kind of time-frequency representation: it provides joint time-frequency decomposition of signals using scaled wavelet functions. A competent speaker classifies it as 'a time-frequency representation' alongside spectrograms and Wigner-Ville distributions.

Spectral-flux IS a specific kind of spectral feature: it measures the rate of change of the spectral energy over time. A competent speaker classifies it as 'a spectral feature' used in audio analysis.

Spectral-centroid IS a specific kind of spectral feature: it measures the 'center of mass' of a spectrum, representing the perceptual brightness of a sound. A competent speaker classifies it as 'a spectral feature'.

Spectral-rolloff IS a specific kind of spectral feature: it measures the frequency below which a specified percentage (e.g. 85%) of spectral energy is concentrated. A competent speaker classifies it as 'a spectral feature'.
Cepstral-coefficients (developed 1963) existed first and fed into cepstral-subtraction as a noise reduction technique. The technique derives from the existence of cepstral coefficients.

pitch-class needs pitch to operate: it categorizes pitches by their equivalence classes. Remove the concept of pitch (the perceptual attribute of how high or low a sound is) and pitch-class loses its operative basis — you cannot group by pitch name without the concept of pitch itself. The removal test passes: without pitch, pitch-class cannot function.

The concept of phoneme is built for the sake of language: phonemes are the abstract sound units that distinguish meaning within a language, and the concept exists to serve the analysis, description, and teaching of language. The arrow points servant→master: phoneme serves language. This is by design/academic practice, not incidental benefit.

The wavelet transform builds directly on Fourier analysis: it replaces the fixed sinusoidal basis of the Fourier transform with localized wavelet functions that can be scaled and shifted. The mathematical formalism (mother wavelet, scaling functions) generalizes the Fourier decomposition — remove Fourier analysis and the wavelet transform loses its theoretical foundation.

Wavelet transform needs signal to operate: it decomposes and analyzes signals using wavelet functions. Remove the concept of signal and the transform has no domain to operate on. This is an object-level dependency — the transform is literally an operation ON signals.

Autocorrelation (developed 1920s-1930s by Pearson) predates linear-predictive-coding (1950s-1960s by B. S. Durbin and others). LPC coefficients are conventionally computed using the autocorrelation method, which solves the Yule-Walker equations via autocorrelation of the signal. The autocorrelation technique fed into and enables LPC computation.

The wavelet transform is built and maintained for the sake of spectral analysis — it provides time-frequency decomposition of signals, extending spectral analysis beyond the fixed-resolution limits of Fourier methods. Its designed purpose is to further spectral-analysis capability by offering multi-resolution analysis of non-stationary signals.

Wavelet-transform IS a specific kind of time-frequency-analysis: the continuous wavelet transform produces a scale-time representation (scalogram) that is a time-frequency distribution of the signal. It analyzes how spectral content evolves over time through dilation and translation of the mother wavelet, fitting the definition of time-frequency-analysis.
mel-frequency-scaled IS a specific kind of frequency-scale: it maps frequencies to a perceptual (non-linear) axis using the mel formula. A competent speaker would call it 'a frequency scale.'

Fourier transform (1820s) predates time-frequency analysis (1940s STFT, 1970s wavelets). Time-frequency analysis extended Fourier's frequency decomposition by adding temporal resolution — historical lineage confirms DERIVED_FROM.

Chroma IS a specific kind of feature: it is an audio/music feature vector used for timbral and harmonic analysis. A competent speaker would call chroma 'a feature' — specifically a music information retrieval feature. Files against nearest kind (feature).

Pitch-class is the 12-tone theoretical concept from Western music theory (centuries old). Chroma is a 12-dimensional feature vector that encodes pitch-class energy distribution — it was designed to represent pitch-class information in audio analysis. Chroma derives from and implements the pitch-class concept.

Cepstral-analysis is designed and maintained for the sake of spectral analysis — cepstral methods extract the spectral envelope (low-resolution spectral representation) from signals. Its purpose is to provide a compact, perceptually-meaningful spectral descriptor.

Mel-frequency-scaling is built and maintained for the sake of speech-recognition — it maps frequencies to a perceptual axis that approximates human auditory filtering, forming the basis of MFCC features central to ASR systems.

Spectral analysis (dating to Fourier 1820s) existed first and provided the analytical foundation that spectral reconstruction extends in the reverse direction — decomposing spectra led to the problem of reconstructing them. Chronology: analysis predates reconstruction techniques like Griffin-Lim (1984).

Envelope extraction via spectral peak-tracking derives from short-time spectral analysis (1940s STFT). The method of computing short-time spectra then tracking local maxima depends on the spectral decomposition techniques that spectral analysis established. The analysis→synthesis pipeline structure originates in spectral analysis.

Statistical analysis (as a formal mathematical discipline, dating to the 17th-18th century work of Bernoulli, Bayes, Gauss) existed first and provided the methodological foundation that parametric modeling extends. Parametric modeling is a specialized application of statistical analysis where data is fitted to a model with a fixed parameter set. Direction test per Law 7: statistical-analysis predates and fed into parametric-modeling.

Signal processing as a field (1940s-1950s) predates linear predictive coding (developed late 1950s-1960s by BesselSEN, Itakura, and Saito for speech compression). Signal processing provided the theoretical framework — autoregressive modeling, least-squares optimization — that LPC builds on. Direction test per Law 7: signal-processing existed first and fed into LPC.

The Nyquist frequency is a fundamental concept in signal processing and sampling theory. Signal processing as a field predates and provides the theoretical framework for the Nyquist frequency concept (named after Harry Nyquist's work on sampling rates in signal transmission). Direction test per Law 7: signal-processing existed first and fed into the concept of Nyquist frequency.

Fourier transform (1800s) predates wavelet transform (1980s). Wavelet transform builds on Fourier analysis, extending it with time-localized frequency decomposition. The Fourier framework fed into wavelet development.

LPC IS a specific kind of parametric modeling: it models a signal using a parametric linear prediction model (past samples linearly combined to predict future). A competent speaker would call LPC a parametric model. Specific→general, nearest kind check: parametric-modeling is the closest category.

Spectral reconstruction (Griffin-Lim etc.) needs the Fourier transform to operate now: each iteration requires forward and inverse FFT to propagate phase estimates. Remove the Fourier transform and the reconstruction algorithm stops working — not just stop being sayable. The operational dependency is direct: FFT is a computational primitive of the algorithm.

MFCCs IS a specific kind of cepstral analysis: they compute cepstral coefficients using the mel-frequency scale as part of the analysis. A competent speaker would call MFCCs 'a cepstral analysis method'. Direction: specific→general. Law 9.

MFCCs needs mel-frequency-scale to operate: the mel filter bank is the first processing stage that converts the linear spectrum to mel-frequency. Remove mel-frequency-scale and MFCCs stop operating. Law 8 removal test.
MFCCs needs a filter bank to operate: the mel filter bank converts the linear-frequency spectrum into mel-banded energy. Remove the filter bank and MFCCs stop operating. Law 8 removal test.

LPC was developed (Itakura, Besselien, Saito, 1950s-60s) specifically for speech compression and recognition. Its designed purpose is to further speech-recognition and speech-coding systems. For whose sake: LPC was built for speech recognition's benefit.

Spectral reconstruction (Griffin-Lim, phase retrieval) is used to recover phase information for speech signals, improving the quality of reconstructed audio for downstream speech recognition systems. Its designed purpose serves speech-recognition's need for high-quality feature inputs.

The mel-frequency scale was designed to approximate human auditory perception, making it the standard frequency representation for speech recognition feature extraction (MFCCs, filter banks). It serves speech-recognition's need for perception-matched frequency analysis.

Spectral subtraction operates in the frequency domain: the signal must be Fourier-transformed to compute the spectral magnitude, then the noise estimate is subtracted, then inverse FFT reconstructs the enhanced signal. Remove the Fourier transform and spectral subtraction stops operating entirely. Law 8 removal test passes.

Mel-frequency scale is a specific kind of frequency scale: it maps physical frequency to a perceptual scale using the mel formula. A competent speaker would call mel-frequency scale a frequency scale. Specific to general — correct for Law 9.

Cepstral analysis (1963, opposite of cepstrum) predates and conceptually feeds into cepstral envelope extraction. The envelope is a specific output of the broader cepstral analysis framework. Historical and conceptual precedence — correct for Law 7.

Cepstrum (1963, Oppenheim and Schafer) predates MFCC (1980s, Davis and Mermelstein). MFCC computation requires extracting cepstral coefficients from the signal — the cepstrum concept and mathematical framework fed into MFCC development. Historical chronology correct for Law 7.
parametric-modeling IS a specific kind of signal-processing: it models signals using a finite set of parameters (e.g. LPC, AR models). Specific→general per Law 9.
envelope-extraction IS a specific kind of signal-processing: it extracts the amplitude envelope of a signal via hilbert transform, rectification, or low-pass filtering. Specific→general per Law 9.

spectral-reconstruction (phase retrieval, Griffin-Lim) derives from fourier-transform: it operates on FFT-derived magnitude spectra and inverts them. fourier-transform existed first and fed into spectral-reconstruction per Law 7.
phoneme IS a specific kind of signal-processing unit: the smallest distinct segment of sound that distinguishes meaning within a language. Specific→general per Law 9.
frequency-scale IS a specific kind of signal-processing concept: a mapping scheme for representing signal frequencies (linear, mel, bark, etc.). Specific→general per Law 9.
zero-crossing-rate IS a specific kind of signal-processing metric: counts sign changes in a signal to estimate frequency/content. Specific→general per Law 9.
pitch-detection IS a specific kind of signal-processing task: estimating the fundamental frequency of a signal. Specific→general per Law 9.

power-spectral-density IS a specific kind of spectral-density: it measures power distribution across frequency for stationary signals. PSD is a specific instance of the broader spectral-density concept. Specific→general per Law 9.

Spectral reconstruction operates on frequency-domain bins (e.g. Griffin-Lim iterates on FFT magnitudes). Without a frequency-scale defining how bins map to frequencies, the reconstruction has no spectral structure to operate on — remove the frequency-scale concept and the reconstruction has no domain to work in. Constitutive, not meta-level: spectral reconstruction IS spectral-domain processing, and that domain requires a frequency scale.

Bit-rate is a measurement of data transfer (bits per unit time). It needs the concept of measurement to operate — remove measurement and bit-rate has no operational meaning. The removal test: without measurement as a concept, bit-rate cannot quantify anything. Constitutive dependency.

CQT decomposes a signal using a filter bank where each filter applies a window of increasing width (proportional to center frequency). Remove the window-function concept and CQT has no mechanism for its time-frequency decomposition. Constitutive: the algorithm IS windowed transforms stacked in scale.

bit-rate IS a specific kind of metric: it measures data transfer rate (bits per unit time). A competent speaker would call it 'a metric.' Specific→general per Law 9. Files correctly against the nearest kind.
bit-rate is designed for measuring data transfer in communication systems — its purpose is to quantify information flow for network operation and quality assessment.

frequency-scale organizes frequency-domain bins so that spectral analysis can map magnitude values to perceptually or physically meaningful frequency positions. Built for the sake of spectral analysis.
audio-restoration relies on noise-reduction techniques as a core component — remove noise-reduction and audio-restoration cannot operate, since noise removal is the primary restoration mechanism.
envelope-extraction IS a specific kind of amplitude analysis: it extracts the amplitude envelope of a signal as one of several amplitude characterization methods. Specific→general per Law 9.

mel-scale IS a specific kind of frequency-scale: it maps physical frequencies to a perceptual scale where equal distances correspond to equal musical intervals. A competent speaker calls mel-scale 'a frequency scale (perceptual).' Valid specific→general per Law 9.

MFCC computation requires applying a mel-spaced filter bank to the signal spectrum as a constitutive step. Filter banks existed before MFCC (1980s) and fed into its development. Which-came-first test passes: filter-bank (1950s) predates mfcc (1980s).

Spectral-envelope is extracted from the power spectrum using spectral analysis techniques. Spectral analysis (via FFT) came first and fed into the spectral-envelope concept. Which-came-first test passes: spectral-analysis predates spectral-envelope as a defined concept.

Amplitude-analysis is a measurement technique for signal amplitudes. The concept of measurement predates and fed into amplitude-analysis as a specialized method. Which-came-first test passes: measurement is older and more general.

Zero-crossing-rate is a measurement technique within signal processing. Signal processing as a field predates ZCR and fed into its development as a method. Which-came-first test: signal-processing → zero-crossing-rate. DERIVED_FROM direction correct.

Cepstral analysis operates by computing the FFT of a signal's spectrum, then taking the log and inverse-FFT. The fourier-transform is the core mechanism without which cepstral analysis cannot operate. Remove fourier-transform and cepstral analysis stops working.

MFCC computation constitutionally requires cepstral analysis — the cepstral domain extraction via log-FFT and inverse-FFT is a constitutive step in producing MFCCs. Remove cepstral analysis and MFCC cannot be computed.

Phase retrieval formalized the general problem of spectral reconstruction — recovering missing information from partial spectral data. Which-came-first test: spectral-reconstruction (early 1900s, Paley-Wiener) predates phase-retrieval (1960s, Gerchberg-Saxson). The concept of phase retrieval derives from the broader spectral reconstruction problem.

Constant-Q transform is a Fourier-like transform with logarithmically-spaced frequency bins where the ratio of center frequency to bandwidth (Q factor) is constant. It was derived from the Fourier transform framework by replacing the fixed sinusoidal basis with scaled window functions that maintain constant Q. The which-came-first test: Fourier transform (1807) predates CQT (1990s) and fed into its development.

audio-restoration IS a specific kind of signal processing: it applies mathematical techniques to signals (audio) to remove degradation, noise, and artifacts. A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of signal processing.' This is the nearest kind — no more specific signal-processing subcategory exists.

amplitude-analysis IS a specific kind of signal processing: it applies mathematical techniques to extract and quantify amplitude characteristics of signals (envelope detection, peak measurement, RMS). A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of signal processing.' This is the nearest kind — no 'signal-analysis' entry exists, and amplitude analysis is distinct from spectral-analysis (time-domain vs frequency-domain).

The cepstrum IS a specific kind of cepstral analysis. It is the concept of computing and analyzing the cepstral domain — a representation obtained via Fourier transform of the log power spectrum. A competent speaker would call it 'a cepstral analysis' or 'a kind of cepstral analysis technique.'

Liftering (the technique of manipulating cepstral coefficients to filter them) operates directly on cepstral analysis outputs. Remove cepstral analysis — the concept and its computations — and liftering has nothing to operate on and stops functioning. Passes the Law 8 removal test.

A frequency scale IS a specific kind of measurement. It is a system for measuring and mapping frequencies (e.g. linear, logarithmic, mel scale). A competent speaker would call it 'a kind of measurement' for frequency.

MFCCs were designed for speech recognition. Their purpose is to extract features optimized for speech processing — approximating human auditory perception to serve speech recognition systems. Per Law 8d: the designed purpose is to further speech recognition's operation. The filer leans on the sense of MFCCs as a speech feature extraction method.

The cepstrum IS a specific kind of representation: it is a representation of a signal's spectral characteristics in the cepstral domain, obtained via Fourier transform of the log power spectrum. A competent speaker would call the cepstrum 'a representation' of spectral information. Files against the nearest kind — representation is a general category for ways of encoding information.

Phase retrieval IS a specific kind of algorithm: it is an iterative computational procedure (e.g. Gerchberg-Saxton, hybrid input-output) that recovers phase from magnitude-only data. Specific→general per Law 9.

Fourier transform (1822) predates phase retrieval methods by over a century. Phase retrieval algorithms (Gerchberg-Saxton 1972, hybrid input-output) fundamentally depend on the Fourier transform as their core computational operation — they iterate FFT/IFFT to recover missing phase from magnitude data. Remove the Fourier transform and phase retrieval has no mathematical machinery to operate on. Which-came-first: fourier-transform is older and fed into phase-retrieval.

A spectrogram is computed as the magnitude of the short-time Fourier transform (STFT). Remove the Fourier transform and the spectrogram has no mathematical machinery to operate on — it literally IS the Fourier transform applied over time with magnitude extraction. A spectrogram IS a specific kind of representation: it is a visual/time-frequency representation of a signal's spectral content, mapping amplitude to color/intensity across time and frequency axes. Spectral tilt is a specific kind of spectral analysis technique: it analyzes the slope of spectral energy across frequency. A competent speaker would call it 'a spectral analysis method.' INSTANCE_OF specific→general.

Delta cepstral coefficients are a specific kind of feature: they are extracted acoustic descriptors that compact vocal tract information into a feature vector for downstream classification. Mel-spectrogram is a specific kind of feature: it represents signal energy distribution across mel-frequency bins and time frames, forming a compact acoustic descriptor used directly in classification and recognition pipelines. Fundamental frequency is a specific kind of measurement: it quantifies the lowest frequency component of a periodic signal, expressed in Hz. Per Law 9: a specific measurement technique is an INSTANCE_OF the general concept of measurement.

Cepstral analysis (the technique) predates cepstral coefficients (the data output). Cepstral analysis emerged in the 1980s; cepstral coefficients are the numerical outputs derived from it. The newer concept (coefficients) derived from the older one (analysis technique). DERIVED_FROM per Law 7.

Cepstral mean normalization operates ON cepstral coefficients — it computes their frame-wise mean and subtracts it. Remove cepstral coefficients and CMN has nothing to operate on; it stops functioning. Present-tense constitutive dependency per Law 8.

Spectrum is the frequency-domain representation of a signal, obtained by applying the Fourier transform. Remove Fourier transform and spectrum ceases to exist as a concept — spectrum IS the Fourier-domain output.
