Spectral bandwidth measures the spread of spectral energy around the centroid. It requires a spectrum as input — remove spectrum and spectral bandwidth cannot be computed. Valid present-tense DEPENDS_ON per Law 8.

CMN is built and maintained for the sake of speech recognition: it removes channel-induced spectral shifts so that speech features become speaker-invariant, directly improving recognition accuracy. The designed purpose of CMN is to serve ASR systems.

Nyquist frequency is a specific frequency concept: the highest frequency that can be accurately represented at a given sampling rate (half the sampling rate). It is a kind of frequency limit, not a discipline or property.

Chroma is a specific pitch-class representation: it folds all octaves of the pitch spectrum into 12 pitch classes, representing the equivalence of pitches separated by octaves in music. Chroma is a particular form of pitch-class encoding.

Method-of-loci IS a specific kind of mnemonics technique. A competent speaker would call method-of-loci 'a mnemonic' — it is a particular technique within the mnemonics class.

Spectrogram needs spectrum to operate now: it is a time-varying representation of spectral content. Remove the concept of spectrum and the spectrogram loses its data domain entirely — it stops functioning as a representation. The removal test passes.

Mel-spectrogram needs spectrum as its data foundation: it transforms spectral magnitudes using the mel scale. Remove spectrum and there is no underlying representation for the mel transform to work on. Removal test passes.

Phonemes are the fundamental acoustic-linguistic units that speech recognition systems target for identification. The concept of phoneme serves the practice of speech recognition by providing its unit of classification.
Phoneme IS a specific kind of unit — the basic segmental unit of speech sound in a language. Specific→general INSTANCE_OF.

The bark-scale IS a specific kind of frequency scale — a psychoacoustic mapping of physical Hz to perceptual critical-band number. A competent speaker would call the bark-scale 'a frequency scale' (specifically, a psychoacoustic one). Clear INSTANCE_OF against the nearest kind.

Mel-frequency scaling IS a specific kind of frequency warping — it warps the linear frequency axis into the perceptual mel scale. A competent speaker calls mel-frequency scaling 'a frequency warping' method. Nearest-kind INSTANCE_OF.
Pitch detection needs frequency to operate: it finds the fundamental frequency of a signal. Remove the concept of frequency and pitch detection loses its entire data domain. Removal test passes.

Envelope extraction needs magnitude-spectrum to operate: it computes the slow-varying amplitude envelope from spectral magnitude data. Remove magnitude-spectrum and envelope extraction has no data domain. Removal test passes.
Frequency warping needs frequency to operate: it transforms the frequency axis non-linearly. Remove the concept of frequency and frequency warping loses its entire data domain. Removal test passes.

The bark scale partitions frequency into perceptually-uniform bands designed to match human auditory perception. For whose sake: the bark scale serves speech-recognition.

Cepstral coefficients are computed directly from the spectrum: take the log of the power spectrum, then apply the inverse Fourier transform. Which existed first? Spectrum (as a frequency-domain representation) predates cepstral coefficients (coined 1963). Spectrum is the direct input domain from which cepstral coefficients are derived.

Cepstral coefficients (MFCCs and variants) are the dominant feature representation in speech recognition systems. For whose sake: cepstral-coefficients serve speech-recognition.

Griffin-Lim IS a specific kind of phase-retrieval: it is a concrete algorithm for recovering missing phase information from a magnitude spectrogram. A competent speaker would call Griffin-Lim a phase-retrieval algorithm. Nearest kind: phase-recovery and iterative-algorithm do not exist, so phase-retrieval is the nearest kind.

STFT existed first and fed into the spectrogram concept: the spectrogram is computed as the squared magnitude of the STFT output. Spectrogram is a direct derivative of STFT — take the STFT and compute |X|^2.

Cepstral transform IS a specific kind of spectral-analysis: it analyzes signals by transforming the spectrum (log magnitude) into the cepstral domain. The method of loci IS a specific kind of mnemonic: a memory technique that uses spatial visualization of familiar locations to encode and retrieve information. A competent speaker would call it a mnemonic. INSTANCE_OF specific→general. Nearest accepted kind: mnemonic.

Method of loci operates by encoding items in spatial memory and retrieving them via spatial navigation. Remove memory now and the technique stops operating — it is not merely sayable without memory, it cannot function as a memory technique. This is object-level (the technique uses memory as its mechanism), not meta-level (Law 2b).

Bark scale IS a specific kind of frequency-warping: it is a psychoacoustic frequency scale that warps linear frequency into perceptually-uniform Bark bands. A competent speaker would call the Bark scale a frequency-warping scheme. INSTANCE_OF direction correct.

Griffin-Lim operates by alternating between inverse-STFT and forward-STFT. Remove STFT and the algorithm stops operating entirely — it cannot function without the STFT/ISTFT pair. DEPENDS_ON direction correct.

Chroma feature is computed from a spectrogram: apply pitch-class profiling to time-frequency bins. Remove spectrogram and chroma-feature ceases to operate — no spectrogram, no chroma. Constitutive present-tense dependency.
Chroma-feature IS a specific kind of feature: a 12-dimensional audio representation vector. A competent speaker would say 'chroma feature is a feature.' Files against nearest kind — no rung skipped.

Pitch-class-profile operates on spectrogram data: it applies filter kernels across spectrogram frequency bins. Remove spectrogram and the profile cannot operate — no spectrogram, no input for the filters.

Pitch-class-profile IS a specific kind of filter-bank: a 12-element set of kernel functions mapping linear frequency to pitch classes. A competent speaker would say 'a pitch-class-profile is a filter bank.' Files against nearest kind.

Pitch-class-profile operates on spectrogram data which is then processed to produce chroma features. The profile is the foundational computation that chroma features build upon.

The spectrogram operates by computing magnitude spectra over successive time frames. Remove magnitude-spectrum as the underlying construct and the spectrogram has no mechanism to compute — it ceases to operate. Present-tense dependency.

The mel-spectrogram operates by applying a mel-scale filterbank to the magnitude spectrum of a signal. Remove magnitude-spectrum and the mel-spectrogram has no input — it ceases to operate. Present-tense dependency.

Phase-vocoder operates via STFT: it computes short-time Fourier transforms, manipulates the spectra, and reconstructs via inverse STFT. Remove STFT and the phase-vocoder has no mechanism — ceases to operate. Present-tense dependency.

Spectral reconstruction is built and maintained for the sake of signal processing — its designed purpose is to restore complete spectral information so that signal processing downstream can operate on it. For whose sake? The reconstruction serves the broader signal processing practice.

Hop-size is a parameter of the STFT (interval between successive analysis windows). Remove STFT as a concept and hop-size loses its operational context — it is defined relative to STFT windowing. The removal test passes: X stops operating without Y.

Phase recovery reconstructs phase from magnitude spectra using iterative FFT operations. Remove fourier-transform and phase recovery has no computational mechanism. The removal test passes.

Parametric modeling is fundamentally mathematical — it constructs models defined by parameters and equations. Remove mathematics and parametric modeling loses its entire conceptual framework. The removal test passes.

Autocorrelation is a specific signal processing technique for measuring signal self-similarity at different time lags. A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing method.' Specific→general per Law 9.

Phase retrieval is a specific signal processing technique for reconstructing signals from magnitude-only measurements. A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing method.' Specific→general per Law 9.

Mel-frequency spectrum is computed by mapping the magnitude spectrum onto the mel scale. Spectral rolloff computes the frequency below which a certain percentage of magnitude spectrum energy resides. Remove magnitude spectrum and spectral rolloff computation collapses. Removal test passes (Law 8b).

phase-vocoder operates on spectrograms — it reads magnitude and phase across time-frequency bins and modifies them for time-scale/pitch modification. Remove the spectrogram as input and the phase-vocoder has no data to process. Removal test passes.

phase-retrieval as a general mathematical problem (reconstructing signals from magnitude-only measurements) predates and generalizes the Griffin-Lim algorithm. Mel-frequency-spectrum is a specific kind of time-frequency representation that maps spectral content onto the mel perceptual scale. A competent speaker calls it a time-frequency method. Specific→general per Law 9. The nearest kind is time-frequency-representation, not spectral-representation (Law 11e).

Log-magnitude-spectrum is a specific kind of spectral representation obtained by applying a logarithmic transform to spectral magnitudes. A competent speaker calls it a type of spectral representation. Specific→general per Law 9. Nearest kind is spectral-representation (Law 11e).

Log-magnitude-spectrum is computed by applying a logarithmic transform to magnitude-spectrum values. Remove magnitude-spectrum as a concept and the input for the log transform disappears — the operation stops. Real operational dependency (Law 8b).

Dithering applies digital signal processing operations to add noise to an audio signal. Remove signal processing and dithering has no mechanism to operate. The removal test passes.

Dithering directly modifies the noise floor of a quantized audio signal — it raises the broadband noise floor to eliminate quantization distortion artifacts. Remove the concept of noise floor from understanding dithering and the technique's entire purpose is incoherent. The noise floor is the parameter dithering operates on.

Quantization as a concept predates the specific parameter bit-depth; bit-depth is the numerical parameterization of quantization resolution. Which came first? Quantization (the general concept of mapping continuous values to discrete levels) existed before the specific parameter bit-depth was introduced to specify how many levels.

The concept of a noise floor emerged from the practice of measurement — measuring systems inherently have background noise that sets a floor. Measurement (the general activity) predates the specific concept of noise floor. Which came first? Measurement as a practice.

Pre-echo as an artifact was identified through the study of spectral masking phenomena. Spectral masking (the masking of sounds by other sounds at nearby frequencies) was established as a concept first; pre-echo is a derived artifact that manifests when masking predictions fail in the time domain during transform coding. Which came first? The general concept of spectral masking.

Pre-echo IS the temporal spreading of quantization error across the codec's finite analysis window — the artifact's own accepted definition carves it by 'coding window length', and the canonical fix (short-window/granule switching) is precisely a change of windowing. Removal test: remove windowing (no finite analysis window to carry error across) and quantization error cannot spread before the transient — pre-echo stops existing as a phenomenon. Pinned sense: windowing as the technique of tapering a segment by a window function before transform, per its accepted definition.

An audio-buffer holds digital audio samples to decouple producers from consumers; its operation requires signal processing to read, write, and manage sample data in real time. Remove signal processing and the buffer cannot be accessed as an audio buffer — it becomes inert memory.

Cepstral-peak-picking is a specific pitch estimation method that emerged after cepstral analysis was established as a general framework for representing spectral envelope via the cepstrum. The general method of cepstral analysis existed first; peak-picking is a derived application.

Cepstral-peak-picking operates by computing a real cepstrum via FFT and windowing, then searching for a peak. Remove signal processing operations — FFT, windowing, cepstral computation — and the technique stops operating as a pitch estimator.

bit-depth as an audio concept specifies the number of quantization levels (2^N amplitude steps). Remove the concept of quantization and bit-depth loses its entire meaning in audio — it is the parameter that defines quantization fineness. This is a genuine present-tense dependency: the concept of bit-depth operates only in the context of quantization.

concert-hall (as a designed acoustic building type, not just any large hall) fundamentally depends on controlling reverberation-time. Architectural design of concert venues is structured around achieving target RT60 values — remove reverberation-time as a concept and the concert-hall as an acoustic design discipline collapses. The removal test passes: without the RT60 concept, concert-hall design has no operational metric.

All audio codecs require quantization as a core step — mapping continuous amplitude values to discrete levels is what enables compression. Remove quantization from a codec's operation and there is no compression, only lossless storage. This passes the Law 8 removal test: X (codec) stops OPERATING without Y (quantization).

Transform coding exists to serve codecs — it is a compression technique built specifically for inclusion within encoder/decoder systems. The servant (transform coding) points at the master (codec). Law 8d: for whose sake? For the codec's purpose of efficient data representation. Not all codecs use it, but transform coding was developed for and serves the codec use case.

Noise-floor is a specific measurable property of audio signals used in analysis and engineering, fitting the definition of audio-feature as a quantifiable characteristic extracted from audio. Specific points to general.
Dithering is a specific technique for reducing perceived quantization noise, a particular kind of noise-reduction practice applied in digital audio.

An audio-buffer is a FIFO ring buffer used in digital audio systems to temporarily hold samples. It is a specific instantiation of the general data structure concept — a bounded sequence of elements with FIFO access semantics, specialized for audio sample management. Direction: specific → general, INSTANCE_OF.

Pre-echo IS the temporal spreading of quantization error across finite analysis windows. Remove quantization entirely — no discrete amplitude levels, no quantization error — and pre-echo has no mechanism and cannot exist. The accepted definition of pre-echo carves it by reference to 'quantization error' and 'coding window length.' Removal test passes: X (pre-echo) stops existing without Y (quantization).

Transform-coding applies signal processing operations (DCT/MDCT transforms, filtering, quantization) to compress signals. Remove signal processing — no transforms, no filtering — and transform-coding has no operations to perform and ceases to work. The which-came-first test: signal-processing (epoch 0) predates transform-coding (epoch 0.11), confirming correct direction.

Dithering is built for the sake of quantization: it adds controlled random noise before quantization to mask quantization artifacts and reduce perceptible distortion. Law 8d: X SERVES Y means X is designed to further Y's operation. Dithering's sole purpose is improving quantization quality.

Concert-halls are built and maintained for the sake of sound: their design, architecture, and purpose all serve sound reproduction and auditory experience. Law 8d: servant→master, purpose-driven. Concert-halls are designed so that sound can be heard well within them.

Noise-floor is defined as a measured quantity — the baseline level of background noise in a system. Without the concept of measurement, noise-floor cannot be defined, quantified, or operated as an engineering parameter. The removal test: remove measurement and noise-floor loses its definition and operational meaning.

Transform-coding is a specific family of compression techniques that applies transforms such as DCT/MDCT within signal processing operations. It is a specific instance of signal processing, not merely dependent on it.
Binary tree is a specific kind of data structure with the constraint of at most two children per node. Specific→general.

Masking-threshold is a specific psychoacoustic construct that emerged within the broader field of psychoacoustics. The general framework of psychoacoustics existed first; the threshold concept is a derived specialization.

Masking-threshold is maintained and refined for the sake of perceptual coding systems, which use the threshold to decide which components can be discarded. The concept is developed and taught explicitly to enable perceptual coders.

Dithering IS a specific signal processing technique that adds controlled random noise before quantization. It applies a mathematical operation to signal samples to shape quantization error. Law 9: specific→general. Dithering is an instance of signal-processing, not merely dependent on it.

Codec IS a specific kind of signal-processing system. It applies encoding-decoding transforms, quantization, and entropy coding — all signal processing operations. Law 9: specific→general. A codec is an instance of signal processing, not merely dependent on it.

Pre-echo IS a specific type of quantization artifact. It occurs when quantization error in a block of samples spreads forward in time due to windowing in transform coding. Law 9: specific→general. A pre-echo is an instance of quantization error artifacts.

Noise-floor as an engineering concept is derived from psychoacoustics — the study of how humans perceive sound in the presence of other sounds. The concept of background noise level is grounded in psychoacoustic research about hearing thresholds and masking. Law 7: psychoacoustics as a discipline predates the noise-floor construct.

noise-floor depends on signal-processing for its conceptual framework. Noise floor is a measurable quantity defined within signal processing — without signal processing's mathematical framework (spectral analysis, SNR calculation), the noise-floor concept cannot operate. Law 8 removal test: remove signal-processing, and noise-floor has no analytical framework to function.

reverberation-time as a psychoacoustic metric DERIVED_FROM psychoacoustics. Psychoacoustics as the study of sound perception existed first; reverberation time is a derived construct that quantifies a specific aspect of human auditory perception of space. Law 7: which existed first? Psychoacoustics predates reverberation-time as a concept.

a-weighting DERIVED_FROM psychoacoustics. The A-weighting curve is designed to match the human ear's frequency response (40-phon equal-loudness contour), which is a psychoacoustic measurement. Psychoacoustics (study of sound perception) existed first; a-weighting is a derived engineering application of psychoacoustic findings. Law 7: which came first?

a-weighting DEPENDS_ON signal-processing. The A-weighting curve requires signal processing for its measurement and application — it is applied via weighting filters in signal processing systems. Removal test: remove signal processing, and a-weighting loses its operational framework for measuring and applying frequency weightings.
Tree is a specific kind of data structure used to represent hierarchical information with nodes connected by edges, where each node has zero or more children.

Room mode as a conceptual category for standing wave resonances was developed within the broader framework of psychoacoustics and architectural acoustics, which studied how humans perceive sound in enclosed spaces. Psychoacoustics predates the specific room mode construct.

Reverberation time is an acoustic measurement of how long sound decays in a space. It is operationally defined and quantified by measurement procedures. Remove measurement and reverberation time cannot be determined or used as an engineering parameter.

Transform coding requires quantization of transform coefficients to operate — remove quantization and transform coding collapses into a bare transform, losing its core compression mechanism. The removal test passes: without quantization, there is no transform coding.

Pre-echo as a named artifact concept derives from transform coding — it was identified and characterized within the context of transform-coded audio where block-based transforms and windowing cause quantization error to spread temporally. Remove transform coding and the concept of pre-echo as described here has no referent.

Reverberation time as a metric serves the design, evaluation, and optimization of concert halls. The metric exists to further concert-hall acoustic quality — servant (reverberation-time) points at master (concert-hall). Remove concert-hall application and reverberation-time as a design parameter loses its primary purpose.

Dithering requires quantization to operate — it is the addition of noise prior to quantization to mask quantization artifacts. Remove quantization and dithering has no function or meaning. The removal test passes.

Dithering serves transform coding by masking quantization artifacts introduced during the quantization step of transform-coded audio. The technique exists to improve transform coding quality — servant (dithering) points at master (transform coding). Remove transform coding and dithering in this context has no purpose.

A concert-hall is a specific type of architectural structure designed for musical performances. Concert halls are a specialized class of architecture whose form follows acoustic requirements. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call a concert hall 'a kind of architecture'.

Acoustic-measurement is a specific type of measurement focused on sound and acoustic properties. It applies measurement principles to the domain of acoustics. Law 9: specific→general. A competent speaker would call acoustic measurement 'a kind of measurement'.

Room-mode is a standing wave resonance pattern in an enclosed space. Remove resonance and the concept has no foundation — room modes ARE resonance phenomena in rooms, not merely related to them. The which-came-first test: resonance predates the acoustic concept of room-modes, and the removal test confirms: no resonance = no room-mode concept.

Masking-threshold is the sound-pressure level at which a tone becomes inaudible due to a louder masker at a given frequency. It is fundamentally defined as a function of frequency — remove the concept of frequency and the masking-threshold has no parameters, no domain, no operation. The which-came-first test: frequency (epoch 0) predates masking-threshold (epoch 0.02), consistent with a dependency pointing from newer to older.

Audio-latency as an operational quantity requires signal processing to generate, measure, and control audio streams. Remove signal processing and latency as a controllable audio-system parameter ceases to operate.
Audio-buffer operation requires signal processing to read, write, and manage sample data in real time. Remove signal processing and the buffer cannot be accessed as an audio buffer.
Room-mode as an acoustic concept is a specific application of resonance in enclosed spaces; the concept of resonance predates the specific acoustic room-mode construct.

Acoustic measurement as an operational practice requires signal processing to capture, condition, and analyze sound data; remove signal processing and acoustic measurement ceases to operate as a measurement procedure.

room-mode IS a type of resonance. A competent speaker would call a room mode 'a resonance' — specifically, a resonance pattern in an enclosed space. The note in the rejected DEPENDS_ON edge correctly said 'room modes ARE resonance phenomena' but used the wrong relation; this is INSTANCE_OF.

cepstral-peak-picking IS a type of signal processing technique. It is a specific algorithm for extracting spectral peaks from a cepstrum, built on top of DSP operations (FFT, mel-filterbank, inverse FFT). A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing technique.'

equalization IS a type of signal processing technique. It modifies the frequency content of a signal — specifically adjusting the amplitude of certain frequency bands. A competent speaker would call it 'a signal processing technique.'

root-mean-square IS a type of measurement/statistical measure. It computes the quadratic mean of a signal's samples — a specific mathematical operation used to quantify signal power or magnitude. A competent speaker would call it 'a measurement' (or 'a measure').

frequency-weighting IS a type of measurement technique. It applies a standardized frequency-dependent correction curve to acoustic measurements — e.g. A-weighting for human-perceived loudness. A competent speaker would call it 'a measurement technique' or 'a weighting method used in measurement.'

temporal-centroid IS a type of measurement. It computes the center of gravity of a signal's energy distribution over time — a specific temporal measurement of when a sound's energy is concentrated. A competent speaker would call it 'a measurement' of temporal energy distribution.

codec IS a type of algorithm. A codec is a specific algorithm (or algorithm family) for encoding and decoding information. A competent speaker would call a codec 'an algorithm' — specifically, an encoding/decoding algorithm.

Room-mode as an acoustic concept DEPENDS_ON frequency — a room mode is a standing wave pattern defined by its resonant frequencies. Remove frequency and room-mode ceases to operate: without frequency as a parameter, there is no concept of a standing wave pattern in an enclosed space.

An audio-buffer DEPENDS_ON memory — a buffer is by definition a region of memory allocated to hold audio data temporarily. Remove memory and the buffer ceases to operate: without a memory substrate, there is no mechanism to hold the data.

Cepstral-peak-picking DERIVED_FROM cepstrum — the technique of picking cepstral peaks requires the cepstrum concept as its substrate. Cepstrum (the concept of the 'pectrum' domain, older) existed first and fed into cepstral-peak-picking (which operates on cepstra to find peaks).

Codec SERVES compression — codecs are designed and maintained for the sake of compression (encoding data to reduce size, decoding to restore it). The codec is the servant; compression is the master purpose.

Codec is a specific application of algorithm design for encoding and decoding information. The concept of algorithm predates codecs, and codecs fed from algorithmic theory. Which-came-first test holds.

Mel-filterbank DEPENDS_ON filter-bank — the mel-frequency bank is a specific arrangement of filters on the mel scale. Remove the general concept of a filter bank (the structure of overlapping bandpass filters applied in parallel) and the mel filterbank has no structural substrate to operate on.

Mel-frequency-cepstrum DERIVED_FROM cepstrum — the mel-frequency variant applies the mel scale to the cepstrum computation. The cepstrum concept (the 'pectrum domain via inverse FFT of log spectrum) existed first and general; mel-frequency-cepstrum is a specific warping of that older concept. Which-came-first: cepstrum (epoch ~0.05) predates mel-frequency-cepstrum (epoch ~0.08).

Cepstral-analysis DEPENDS_ON spectral-envelope — cepstral analysis is fundamentally the technique of extracting and representing a signal's spectral envelope via the cepstrum. Remove spectral-envelope and cepstral analysis loses its target: there is no envelope to analyze.

Cepstral-peak-picking DEPENDS_ON fft — computing the real cepstrum requires taking the FFT of the signal, then the log, then the inverse FFT. Remove FFT and the entire cepstral computation collapses: there is no way to obtain the cepstrum without it.

Cepstral-peak-picking DEPENDS_ON windowing — cepstral analysis applies a window function to segment the signal before FFT computation. Remove windowing and the signal has no proper framing for cepstral computation, causing spectral leakage that corrupts the cepstrum.

Griffin-Lim is a specific iterative algorithm for phase retrieval that grew out of phase vocoder principles. Phase vocoder existed first and fed into Griffin-Lim development. Which-existed-first test satisfied.

Phase retrieval as a formal problem class grew out of phase vocoder techniques for reconstructing signals from magnitude spectrograms. Phase vocoder predates the generalized phase retrieval formulation and fed into it.
Spectral centroid is a specific measurement of the spectral center of gravity of a signal; a competent speaker would call it a measurement of timbre.
Spectral flux measures the rate of change of spectral energy between successive frames; it is a specific audio measurement used for onset detection.
Spectral rolloff is a measurement of the frequency below which a specified percentage of total spectral energy lies; it is a specific audio measurement.

Latency-compensation requires measuring the delay it seeks to offset; without a measurement of latency, the compensation cannot be computed or applied, so remove measurement and compensation stops operating.
Latency-compensation is a specific signal processing technique used to adjust timing in audio systems; a competent speaker would call it a signal processing method.

Spectral flux is built and maintained for the sake of onset detection — its design purpose is to measure frame-to-frame spectral change to locate note onsets. The servant points at the master purpose, Law 8d.

Spectral centroid is built for the sake of timbre characterization — it provides a single number summarizing spectral shape, used to estimate perceived timbre brightness. Purpose is timbre analysis, Law 8d.

Jitter-buffer is a specific technique for smoothing timing variations in media streams; a competent speaker would call it a signal processing method applied to networked audio/video. Specific points to general.

Cepstral-peak-picking is a specific algorithm designed and maintained for the purpose of estimating pitch from audio signals. Its design intent is pitch estimation; it serves that master purpose, Law 8d.
Pitch estimation is a specific signal processing technique for estimating fundamental frequency. A competent speaker would call it a kind of signal processing. Law 9 specific→general.

Phase retrieval is a specific signal processing problem class concerned with reconstructing a signal from magnitude information alone. A competent speaker would call phase retrieval a kind of signal processing technique. Law 9 specific→general.

An audio-buffer is a specific data structure used in digital audio systems to hold samples for processing and playback. It is a concrete instance of signal processing infrastructure, used to manage sample data in real time. A competent speaker would call an audio buffer a kind of signal processing component. Law 9 specific→general.

Latency-compensation is built and maintained for the sake of reducing or correcting audio latency; its designed purpose is to make audio-latency manageable in real-time systems. Servant points at master purpose, Law 8d.

Pitch estimation as an operational technique requires frequency information to compute fundamental frequency; remove frequency measurement and pitch estimation stops operating as a method for determining pitch. Removal test satisfied, Law 8.

Buffer-size as an operational parameter requires an audio-buffer to exist to define its size; remove the buffer and the size parameter ceases to operate as a configurable property of that buffer. Removal test satisfied.

Jitter-buffer is a specific kind of audio-buffer designed for network streaming to smooth arrival-time variation. It is a specific implementation of the general audio-buffer concept, meeting Law 9 INSTANCE_OF test: a jitter-buffer is a buffer.

Codec is a specific kind of software implementing encoding and decoding algorithms for data compression and decompression. It is a software artifact, meeting Law 9 INSTANCE_OF test: a codec is a software.

Pitch estimation is a specific measurement technique for determining the fundamental frequency of a signal. It quantifies a physical property (pitch/fundamental frequency) of an acoustic signal. Law 9 INSTANCE_OF: specific→general.
Audio-codec is a specific type of codec optimized for audio signals. Codec is the general concept of encoding/decoding; audio-codec specializes it for audio. Law 9 INSTANCE_OF: specific→general.
Buffer-size is a specific measurement — it measures the capacity or extent of a buffer. A buffer size quantifies how much data a buffer can hold. Law 9 INSTANCE_OF: specific→general.
jitter-buffer is a specialized audio-buffer designed to absorb network jitter; it is a kind of audio-buffer with timing compensation.

Audio-latency as an operational parameter requires measurement to be quantified and controlled; without measurement of delay, latency cannot be assessed, compensated, or operated upon as a system property. Removal test satisfied.

A jitter-buffer's core mechanism is managing buffer size to absorb network timing variation. Without configurable buffer-size, a jitter-buffer cannot operate — the buffer size IS its fundamental parameter. The removal test passes: remove buffer-size and the jitter-buffer has no mechanism to function.
Buffer-underrun is a specific kind of failure-mode in digital audio playback systems, characterized by buffer exhaustion leading to audible dropout.
A buffer-underrun cannot occur without an audio buffer present to underrun; removing the audio buffer eliminates the possibility of underrun in playback.

Pitch estimation is designed to provide fundamental frequency estimates that speech recognition systems use for phoneme and prosody analysis; the technique is maintained for the sake of recognition performance
Room mode analysis is performed to design and tune concert halls for uniform low-frequency response; the acoustic modes are studied and controlled for the sake of hall performance

A jitter-buffer is designed to absorb timing variations to prevent buffer-underrun. The concept of buffer-underrun is fundamental to the jitter-buffer's operation — without the concept of data running out during playback, the jitter-buffer has no purpose.

pitch-estimation uses cepstral-analysis as a core technique for robust pitch detection. The cepstrum separates fundamental frequency from spectral envelope, which is essential for accurate pitch estimation in audio. Remove cepstral-analysis and this pitch estimation method stops operating.

latency-compensation techniques like buffer management directly manipulate buffer-size parameters to absorb timing variations. Without the concept of buffer-size as a tunable parameter, latency-compensation stops operating.

room-mode analysis requires acoustic measurement to detect and characterize resonant frequencies in spaces. Remove acoustic-measurement and you cannot determine room-modes, which is what room-mode as a concept is about.

latency-compensation is designed to prevent buffer-underrun in real-time audio systems. Remove the concept of buffer-underrun and latency-compensation loses its entire purpose — it stops operating as a concept.

binary-tree is a specific kind of tree data structure where each node has at most two children. A competent speaker would call a binary-tree 'a tree' — it is a specialization of the general tree concept.

sample-rate-conversion is a specific kind of signal processing: a named procedure that transforms a discrete-time signal between sampling rates via filtering + resampling. A competent DSP practitioner calls it 'a signal-processing technique' — kind-of (Law 9), nearest kind is signal-processing. Not an output (unlike spectrogram) and not a sub-step; it is a full pipeline stage.

Audio-dropout is a specific kind of failure-mode in digital audio playback, characterized by audible gaps or silence due to data loss or processing interruption. A competent engineer would call an audio dropout a failure mode of the audio system.

Sample-rate-conversion as a resampling procedure requires anti-aliasing filtering to prevent aliasing artifacts; remove the anti-aliasing filter mechanism and the conversion stops operating as a correct procedure.

Audio-codec depends on codec: remove the general concept of a codec (encoding/decoding mechanism) and the audio-codec stops operating as an audio codec. The audio-codec is a codec specialized for audio data.

Cepstral peak-picking depends on spectral analysis: the technique operates on spectral data produced by cepstral/spectral analysis to identify peaks in the cepstral coefficient space. Remove spectral analysis and the input data for peak-picking ceases to exist.

Linear-model depends on regression: the linear model is a statistical framework built on regression analysis. Remove regression and the linear model stops operating as a statistical fitting and prediction tool. The model is literally a regression model.
